|| śāṃkarī vyākhyā ||
|| śrīvanaśaṃkarīvanaśaṃkarābhyāṃ namaḥ ||
bhāradvājaṃ kulaṃ yasya śākhā yasya ca vāh‌vṛcī|
ramākhyā jananī, pūjyo raṅgabhaṭṭābhidhaḥ pitā|| 1 ||
jyāyān bhrātā naraharirmīmāṃsādvayapaṇḍitaḥ|
jagad‌gurupadārūḍho vidyāśaṃkarabhāratī|| 2 ||
nāma bibhratkāravīrapīṭhādhīśo virājate|
yasyaivaṃ vaṃśavṛttaṃ sa śaṃkaraḥ śāstryupādhibhūt|| 3 ||
natvā dakṣiṇakedāraṃ smṛtvā gurupadāmbujam|
vyākhyāṃ bhūṣaṇasārasya sugamāṃ tanute'lpadhīḥ|| 4 ||
iha khalvavajigamiṣūṇāmavagamāya bhaṭṭojīdīkṣitapraṇītā vaiyākaraṇasiddhāntakārikā vyācikhyāsū raṅgojībhaṭṭātmajaḥ kauṇḍabhaṭṭanāmā sudhīḥ paṇḍitaḥ sarvasyāpi kāryasyāntarāyavyāptetvaṃ manyamānaḥ prāripsitasya vaiyākaraṇasiddhāntaviṣayakagranthasya pracāraparisamāptyādipratibandhakapratyūhavyūhapraśamanāya kṛtaṃ sakalajagatkartṛbhūtagaurīpraṇātmakaśrīlakṣmīramaṇastutirūpaṃ maṅgalaṃ śiṣyāsikṣaṇārthaṃ granthādau nibadhnāti-śrīlakṣmīramaṇamiti| śrīḥ sarasvatī, lakṣmīrharipriyā| tayo ramaṇaḥ| ramata iti ramaṇaḥ| nandyāditvātkartari lyuḥ| `śrīśca te lakṣmīśca pantyau' iti mantre śrīśabdena sarasvatī, natu lakṣmīḥ| lakṣmyāḥ pṛthagupādānāt| nanu śivasya hṛdayaṃ viṣṇurviṣṇośca hṛdayaṃ śivaḥ| viṣṇurudrāntaraṃ yacca yo brūte mūḍhadhīstu saḥ|| ityādivacobhyo hariharayorbhedasyānarthāvahatvātkavelaviṣṇoḥ stavane pārthakyena śivaviṣṇoḥ stavane ca bhedaḥ pratīyeteti tannirasanadvārā'bhedapratipattyarthaṃ lakṣmīramaṇasyābhedena viśeṣaṇamāha-gaurīramaṇeti| gaurī pārvatī tasyā ramaṇaḥ śivaḥ, stasya rūpaṃ svarūpaṃ tadasyāstīti matvarthīya iniḥ| anye tu tu gaurīramaṇaṃ rūpayati svābhinnatayā pradarśayatīti supyajātāviti tācchīlye kartari ṇiniriti vyācakṣate| tadbījaṃ tu `rasādibhyaśca' iti matūb‌vidhānasyāta iniṭhanau, ityādisvānyamatvarthīyanivṛttyarthatayā rūpaśabdasya rasādigaṇe paṭhitatvāttasmādinipratyayo durlabha iti| anena viśeṣaṇena hariharayorabhedaḥ spaṣṭa evoktaḥ| tathā ca gaurīramaṇābhinnaṃ lakṣmīramaṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ naumi staumītyarthaḥ| ṇu stutāviti pāṇinismaraṇāt| stutiśca sarvotkṛṣṭaguṇavattvena pratipādanam| lakṣmīramaṇaṃ sarvotkṛṣṭaguṇavattvena pratipādayāmītyarthaḥ| sphoṭarūpamiti| lakṣmīramaṇaviśeṣaṇametat| sphuṭati prakāśate'rtho yasmāditi vyatputtyā sakalārthaprakāśakaṃ tattvaṃ sphoṭaḥ| tacca tattvaṃ vedānteṣu varṇyamānaṃ sakalajagannidānaṃ māyāśabalitaṃ brahmaiveti sphoṭo brahmetyarthaḥ| tadrūpaṃ tatsvarūpaṃ sakalajagannidānabhūtabrahmābhinnamiti yāvat| etādṛśaṃ lakṣmīramaṇamityarthaḥ| jagato viśeṣaṇaṃ vā| asmin‌pakṣe sphuṭati vyaktībhavati ghaṭapaṭādyartho yasmāditi sphoṭo vācakaḥ śabdaḥ| rūpyate bodhyata iti rūpamarthaḥ| tayoḥ samāhāradvaṃdve napuṃsakaikavacanam| vācyavācakā(nāmarūpā)tmakametatparidṛśyamānaṃ sarvaṃ jagadyato vivartate, yata iti ādyāditvātṣaṣṭhyarthe tasiḥ, yasya vivarto bhavati taṃ lakṣmīramaṇamiti saṃbandhaḥ| yasya kasyācidekasya nāmarūpātmakasya vastuna utpatteranyasmātpāmarādapi saṃbhavādityuktaṃ sarvamiti| vivarto nāmātāttviko'nyathābhāvaḥ| sa ca pūrvarūpāparityāgenāsatyanānākārapratibhāsaḥ| yathā śuktikāyāṃ rajatasya rajjvāṃ vā sarpasya pratītiḥ| atra śuktī rajjurvā svasvarūpamaparityajyaivānyarūpeṇa rajatarūpeṇa sarparūpeṇa vā pratibhāsate| yatra yadaviṣṭānaṃ svayamavikṛtaṃ sadevānyathā bhavati sa vivarta iti bhāvaḥ| tāttviko'nyathābhāvaḥ pariṇāmaḥ| pūrvarūpaparityāgenānyathābhavanam| yatra yadadhiṣṭhānaṃ svayaṃ vikṛtaṃ sadeva anyathā bhavati sa pariṇāma ityarthaḥ| yathā dugdhasya dadhyātmanā pariṇāmaḥ atra dugvaṃ svayaṃ vikṛtaṃ sadeva pūrvarūpaṃ parityajyaivānyathā bhavati dadhyātmanā pariṇamate| etena bhagavato lakṣmīramaṇasya vivartādhiṣṭhānatvarūpaṃ sarvajagānnidānatvamuktam| tena sarvotkṛṣṭatapā stutyarhatvamāveditam| sphoṭasya vaiyākaraṇopāsyatvena samuciteṣṭadevatāyāḥ stutirūpaṃ maṅgalaṃ ca sūcitam|| 1 ||
idānīṃ vyākaraṇaśāstravyākhyātṛtvenātiśreṣṭho yaḥ śeṣastadviśiṣṭaṃ devaṃ stauti-
śeṣāśeṣārtheti| śeṣasya śeṣākhyanāgasya mahābhāṣyakārasya, aśeṣāḥ kṛtsnā ye'rthā vācyādayaḥ sphuṭā asphuṭāśca mahābhāṣyasthāsteṣāṃ lābhārthaṃ pratipattaya ityarthaḥ| śeṣabhūṣaṇaṃ--śeṣo'nanto'laṃkāratvena paryaṅkatvena vā bhūṣaṇaṃ yasya taṃ śivaṃ śeṣaśāyinaṃ viṣṇuṃ ca prārthaya iti saṃbandhaḥ| nanu śeṣārthalābhāya śeṣa eva prārthyatāṃ na śivādirityāśaṅkya tadviśeṣaṃ nirvakti-aśeṣaphaleti| aśeṣāṇāṃ kṛtsnānāmaihikāmuṣmikāṇāmapavargaparyantānāṃ phalānāṃ dātāramiti tṛjantasya tṛnnantasya vā śeṣaṣaṣṭhyantena samāsaḥ| aśeṣaphaladātṛtvaṃ ceśvarasya `yādṛgiva vai devebhyaḥ karoti tādṛgivāsmai devāḥ kurvanti' labhate ca tataḥ kāprānmathaiva vihitān hitān, ityādiśrutismṛtiṣu prasiddham| nanu pratibandhakāṃhobahutve kathamiva śeṣāśeṣārthalābhaḥ syādityāśaṅkāṃ dūrīkartuṃ tadviśeṣaṇamāha--bhavābdhīti| bhavaḥ saṃsāraḥ, sa evābdhiriti mayūravyaṃsakāditvātsamāsaḥ| yadvā bhavo'bdhirivetyupamitasamāsaḥ| bhavābdhestaraṇaṃ tatra tarīṃ naukāṃ sādhanamiti yāvat| `tarati śokamātmavit' iti śruteḥ| tathā cānanyasādhyā yo'nekaduḥkhaparamparārūpasaṃsārasya nivṛttistatra yaḥ samarthastasya pratibandhakaduritanivṛttau sutarāṃ sāmarthyamastīti kimu vaktavyamiti bhāvaḥ| tathā ca pratibandhakaduritanivṛttyā'nāyāsanaiva śeṣāśeṣārthalābhaḥ syāditi na tatra saṃśayaleśamapyavagāhate manmana ityāśayaḥ|| 2 ||
atha tātkālikanikhilapaṇḍitamūrdhanyaṃ svapitṛvyaṃ bhaṭṭojīdīkṣitaṃ tatkīrtyanuvṛttyarthaṃ stauti--
vāgdevī sarasvatī matsvārasyajñapaṇḍitaśreṣṭhapuruṣalābhena sadā''nanditā satī yasya jihvāgre narīnarti punaḥ punaratiśayena vā nṛtyaṃ karoti taṃ pitṛvyaṃ piturbhrātaraṃ bhaṭṭojidīkṣitaṃ kauṇḍabhaṭṭo'haṃ tatkṛtakārikāṇāṃ vyākhyānabhūtasyāsya bhūṣaṇasārākhyagranthasya siddhaye niṣpratyūhaṃ parisamāptaye'dhyeyatvenānekajanasaṃbandharūpapracārāyaca naumi stavīmītyarthaḥ| atra yato'yaṃ kauṇḍabhaṭṭaḥ svabuddhisthavaiyākaraṇabhūṣaṇasārākhyagranthasya siddhaye pitṛvyaṃ bhaṭṭojīdīkṣitaṃ stavīti tato'yaṃ pitṛvyo bhaṭṭojīdīkṣitaḥ kauṇ‍bhaṭṭasya vidyāpradātā gururiti jñāyate| vidyāpradātṛgurośca dṛṣṭānto naiva dṛṣṭastribhuvanajaṭhare sad‌gurorjñānadāturityabhiyuktoktyā sarvātiśāyiśreṣṭhatvāvagamādeva janmapradapitṛvandanātpūrvaṃ pitṛvyavandanaṃ yujyate| anyathā janmapradatvena dvijatvasaṃpādakavratabandhakartṛtvena ca pitṛvyāpekṣayā pituḥ pūjyataratvātpitṛvandanātpūrvaṃ pitṛvyavandanaṃ na saṃgacchetoti bhāvaḥ| jihvāyā rasajñatvāttad‌dvārā'sya sakalasārasvatarasābhijñatvamāviṣkartuṃ yasya jihvetyuktam| vāgdevyā jihvāgre nartanaṃ ca jhaṭityevānavarataṃ pravāharūpeṇa śabdārthasphoraṇam| etena lokottaraṃ pāṇḍityaṃ vaktṛtvaṃ cā''voditamiti|| 3 ||
vyākaraṇaśāstrapravartakapāṇinyādimunitrayādinamanarūpaṃ maṅgalaṃ nibadhnan prekṣāvatāṃ pravṛttisiddhaye'dhikāriviṣayasaṃbandhaprayojanākhyamanubandhacatuṣaṭyaṃ pradarśayañchiṣyāvadhānāya cikīrṣitaṃ nivedayati--
pāṇiṃnikātyāyanapatañjalimunīn, raṅgojibhaṭṭanāmānaṃ pitaraṃ, ḍhuṇḍhiṃ siddhivināyakaṃ praṇamya prakṛṣṭaṃ sāṣṭāṅgatvaguṇaviśiṣṭanamaskāraṃ kṛtvā gautamajaiminivacanavyākhyātṛbhirdūṣitān siddhāntān--vaiyākaraṇasiddhāntān-dhātoreva bhāvanāvācakatvaṃ tiṅāmeva ca kartrādivācakatvamityevaṃrūpānityarthaḥ| upapattibhiryuktimiḥ prakaṭaye, siddhāntānāmupapannatve yuktīḥ prakāśaye, ityarthaḥ| teṣāṃ--gautamajaiminīyavacovyākhyātṝṇāmādhunikatārkikamīmāṃsakānāṃ vaco yuktiśūnyatvenānupapattidoṣagrastamiti ca sthāpaye, ityarthaḥ| namaskāraśca svaniṣṭhāpakṛṣṭatānirūpitaparaniṣṭhotkṛṣṭatābodhanānukūlaḥ karaśiraḥsaṃyogātmako, namaḥśabdoccāraṇātmako vā vyāpāraḥ| vyākhyātṛbhirdūṣitāniti| vyākhyātṛśabdaprayogeṇa jaiminigautamādimunināṃ pāṇinyādibhiravirodha eveti sūcyate| pāṇinirādiryeṣāṃ te ca te munayaśceti bahuvrīhigarbhaḥ karmadhārayaḥ| bahuvrīhiśca sarvādīnītivattad‌guṇasaṃvijñānaḥ| tena pāṇinerapi namaskāryatvalābhaḥ| gautamajaiminīyavacanāni tu nyāyasūtrāṇi mīmāṃsāsūtrāṇi ca| pitṛvyasya vidyāpradagurutvena sūcanātsvapitū raṅgojibhaṭṭasyāvidvattvamāśaṅkyetātastaṃ viśinaṣṭi-dvaitadhvāntetyādi| dve ita āśrayatvena prāpto dvīto bhedaḥ, tasyedaṃ jñānaṃ dvaitam| anekatvāvagāhijñānamiti yāvat| tadevā''cchādakatvād‌dhvāntaṃ tamo moha iti yāvat| tasya nivāraṇaṃ nirasanaṃ, tat--ādi prathamaṃ phalaṃ yasyāḥ sā, etādṛśīṃ, puṃbhāvavāgdevatāṃ--puṃso bhāva ākāro yasyāḥ sā puṃbhāvā, puruṣākṛtiketyarthaḥ| sā cāsau vāgdevatā ca sarasvatī tadrūpamityarthaḥ| vāgdevatāṃ pitaramityanayorajahalliṅgatvāt `strī pradhānaṃ' itivatsāmānādikaraṇyam| anenādvaitapratipādakottaramīmāṃsāyāṃ sarvātiśāyinaipuṇyaṃ sūcitam| ḍhuṇḍhimityapi pitṛviśeṣaṇam| tadyathā--na kevalaṃ vāgdevatāsvarūpo'pituṃ mahāgaṇapatisvarūpo'pīti| anyathā pitṛnamanānantaraṃ mahāgaṇapatinamanamatyasaṃgataṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ| `siddhāntānupapāttebhiḥ prakaṭaye' ityuktyā vaiyākaraṇasiddhāntā viṣayaḥ, viṣayagranthayoḥ pratipādyapratipādakabhāvaḥ saṃbandhaḥ, tajjijñāsuradhikārī, tajjñānaṃ ca phalamiti sūcitamiti bodhyam|| 4 ||
pratyūhaprācuryaśaṅkyā punarapi gaṇeśādinamanarūpaṃ maṅgalaṃ vidadhatsvakīrtyanuvṛttaye svanāma svacikīrṣītagranthasya ca nāma nibadhnāti--natvā gaṇeśeti|
gaṇānāṃ śivagaṇānāmīśo niyantā gaṇeśastasyetyarthaḥ| yadvā bhaktagaṇānāmiḥ kāmaḥ, kāmetyupalakṣaṇaṃ krodhādīnāmapi| tathā ca kāmakrodhādiṣaḍ‌vargaṃ śyati tanūkarotīti gaṇeśaḥ| tasya pādābjaṃ pādāvevābjaṃ kamalaṃ, atiśayaśliṣṭatvādekavacanam| gṛṇātyajñānaṃ nāśayati jñānopadeśadvāreti guruḥ| kṛgroruccetyauṇādikaḥ kuḥ| nigūḍhamarthaṃ gṛṇātyupadiśatīti vā guruḥ| saro'mṛtasarastadvatī sarasvatī| vyākaraṇaṃ śāstramadhīyate vidanti vā vaiyākaraṇāsteṣāṃ bhūṣaṇamalaṃkāramiva śobhādāyakamityarthaḥ| tadetadanvarthaṃ granthanāma| arthaprakriyāpratipādakamamuṃ granthamanadhītya kevalaśabdaprakriyāgranthādhyayanena vaiyākaraṇā analaṃkṛtā iva na paripūrṇatayā śobhanta iti yāvat| etena vyākaraṇaśāstrādhyetṝṇāmetad‌granthasyāvaśyopādeyatvaṃ sūcitam| anenaiva kauṇḍabhaṭṭena mahāviduṣā naiyāyikamīmāṃsakaproktārthapratipādanarītyupapādanatatkhaṇḍanapuraḥsaraṃ suvistṛtaṃ pāṇḍityapracuraṃ yad‌vyākhyānaṃ kṛtamasti tadeva `vaiyākaraṇabhūṣaṇaṃ' ityucyate, kvacittu vistṛtatvād' bṛhadbhūṣaṇaṃ' ityuktam| taduttamādhikāriṇāmevopakārakaṃ, na madhyamādyadhikāriṇāmityālocya teṣāmapyupakārārthaṃ sārabh‌tān siddhāntānādāya saṃkṣepatastadupapādanenedaṃ vyākhyānaṃ niramāyītyasya `vaiyākaraṇabhūṣaṇasāraḥ' ityeva nāma suprasiddham| nāmaikadeśe nāmagrahaṇamiti nyāyena vaiyākaraṇabhūṣaṇamityuktaṃ mūle| ubhayatrāpi vyākhyeyabhūtāḥ kārikāḥ svagurubhaṭṭojidīkṣitapraṇītāḥ samānā evetyagre sphuṭībhaviṣyatīti bodhyam|| 5 ||
idānīṃ vyākhyānamūlabhūtakārikākṛdbhaṭṭojidīkṣitaścikīrṣitasvagranthapratibandhakavighātāya samuciteṣṭadevatāsmaraṇarūpaṃ maṅgalamācaratītyāha--prāripsitetyādi| prārabdhumiṣṭo yo grantha- `phalavyāpārayordhātuḥ' ityādikārikāsamūharūpaḥ, tatra pratibandhakāni yāni duritāni teṣāmupaśamo nāśastasmā ityarthaḥ| atrā''hatya pratibandhakopaśamanāyetyuktatvādalaukikāvigītaśiṣṭācārānumitaśrutipramāṇakasya maṅgalasya na samāptāvupayogaḥ, nāstikagranthe vinaiva maṅgalaṃ samāptidarśanena maṅgalasya samāptyupayogitvābhāvāt| kiṃtu kāryamātre pratibandhakābhāvasya kāraṇatayā klṛptatvātpratibandhakanāśa eva maṅgalasyopayogaḥ| samāptistu navanavonmeṣaśālimatibuddhyādiryā granthaviracanasāvadhanasāmagrī tayaiva sidhyatīti sūcitam| phaṇismaraṇeti| mahābhāṣyasthasakalasiddhāntaprāptaye, iṣṭadaivataṃ śeṣākhyaḥ phaṇī, mahābhāṣyakārasya śeṣāvatāratvāditi phaṇismaraṇarūpaṃ maṅgalaṃ samucitameveti bhāvaḥ| nanvathāpi maṅgalasya granthādau niveśane kiṃ prayojanamiti jijñāsāyāmāha--śiṣyaśikṣārthamiti| granthārambhasamaye śiṣyairapi tādṛśanibaddhaśloke paṭhite sati te'pi, `maṅgalādīni maṅgalamadhyāni maṅgalāntāni hi śāstrāṇi prathante vīrapuruṣakāṇi āyuṣmatpuruṣakāṇi ca bhavanti adhyetāraśca vṛddhiyuktā yathā syuḥ' iti mahābhāṣyakāroktamaṅgalaphalabhājo bhaveyurityevamarthamityarthaḥ| cikīrṣitamiti| kārikāvalīrūpaṃ grantham| pratijānīta iti| kartavyatvena bodhayatītyarthaḥ| pratyupasargaviśiṣṭajñādhātoḥ kartavyatvena bodhānukūlo vyāpāro'rthaḥ| tatra kartavyatvena bodho viṣayatāsaṃbandhena cikīrṣitagranthaniṣṭhaḥ| tādṛśabodhānukūlavyāpāraśca granthakāraniṣṭhaḥ| sa ca vyāpāraḥ `mayā amukagranthaḥ kriyate' ityevaṃśabdaprayogarūpaḥ|
kenod‌dhṛta ityuddharaṇakriyākartṛjijñāsāyāmāha-asmābhiriti| śabdakaustubhakartṛtvena bhaṭṭojidīkṣitānāṃ suprasiddhatvādasmābhirityasya bhaṭṭojidīkṣitairityarthaḥ| tatra--śabdakaustubhe| iha--kārikāvalīrūpe gramthe| tathā ca śabdakaustubhe yena yo'rtho nirṇītastenaiva so'rthaḥ iha--kārikāvalīgranthe saṃkṣepeṇa kathyate ityarthasya pratyāsattyā lābhācchabdakaustubhakārikāvalīgranthakartroraikyāvagamādvaiyākaraṇasiddhāntakārikā bhaṭṭojidīkṣitakṛtāḥ, iti paryavasyati| etena kārikāvalīgranthakarturatiśayitapāṇḍityaprakāśanadvārā tatkṛtakārikāvalīgranthasyāvasyopādeyatvaṃ sūcitam| śabdakaustubhoddharaṇe'vaditvena bhāṣyābdherupādānasya prayojanamāha--śabdakaustubhoktetyādinā nirāsāyetyantena granthena| ādhunikotprokṣitatvanirāsasya phalamāha--anyatheti| uktavaiparītye| ādhunikotprekṣitatvanirāsasyākaraṇe ityarthaḥ| tanmūlakasya--śabdakaustubhamūlakasya| asyāpi--kārikāvalīgranthasyāṣi| ādhunikotprekṣiteti| ādhunikenedānīṃtanenārvācīneneti yāvat| utprokṣita udbhāvito yaḥ śabdakaustubhastatsāratvāpattau--tatsāratvaniścayāpattāvityarthaḥ| pāṇinīyānāṃ pāṇinimuniproktaśāstrāghyetṝṇām| anupādeyatāpatteriti| tathā cāvaśyopādeyatvakathanamevā''dhunikotprekṣitatvanirāsasya phalamiti bhāvaḥ| tatra nirṇīta ityukteḥ prayojanaṃ darśayati--ito'pītyādidhvanayitumityantena| devatāntarasattve'pīha phaṇina eva grahaṇaṃ tu śeṣākhyaphaṇyavatāratvāvdyākaraṇaśāstrapravartakācāryābhyarhitatvācca pratipādyaviṣayānukūleṣṭadevatātvaṃ prakṛte mahābhāṣyakārasyaiveti sūcayitumiti bodhyam|| 1 ||
pratijñātārthamiti| pratipādyatvena bodhitārthamityarthaḥ| āha-brūte-

|| phalavyāpārayoriti ||
phalaṃ ca vyāpāraścaitayorarthayorvācakatvena dhātuḥ smṛtaḥ| phalavyāpārayorvācako dhātuḥ| phalavyāpārau ca dhātuvācyāvityarthaḥ| tiṅastu āśraye smṛtāḥ| pratyāsattyā phalāśraye karmaṇi vyāpārāśraye kartari ca vācakatvena tibādayaḥ smṛtāḥ| karmakartārau tibādivācyāvityarthaḥ| bhāvārthakatiṅāṃ dhātvarthānuvādakamātratvānna te'tra grāhyāḥ| phalaṃ prati vyāpāraḥ pradhānam| phalanirūpitaviśeṣyatāvān vyāpāraḥ, phalaṃ ca tadviśeṣaṇamityarthaḥ| tiṅarthastu, kartṛkarmaṇī pratyāsattyā phalavyāpārayorviśeṣaṇam| phalavyāpārau viśeṣyau kartṛkarmaṇī ca tadviśeṣaṇe ityarthaḥ| ityatīva saṃkṣiptaḥ kārikārthaḥ|
nanuyalliṅgaṃ yadvacanaṃ yā ca vibhaktirviśeṣyasya| talliṅgaṃ tadvacanaṃ saiva vibhaktirviśeṣaṇasyāpi|| ityabhiyuktokterviśeṣyaviśeṣaṇavācakapadayoḥ samānavacanakatvaniyamalābhātsmṛtā ityasya viśeṣyavācakapadottaravacanaviruddhavacanāntasya dhāturityatraikavacanānte viśeṣye'nvayo na syādata āhadhāturityatretyādyanvaya ityantam| ananvitārthakavibhaktyādityāgenānvayayogyavibhaktyādikalpanaṃ vipariṇāmaḥ| smṛtaśabdottaramekavacanaṃ prayujyoccāraṇaṃ vacanavipariṇāmo'tretyarthaḥ| viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇavācakapadayoḥ samānavacanakatvanimamādeva `śuklaḥ paṭāḥ' ityādau viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāvena nānvayabodhaḥ| na caliṅgasaṃkhyāvibhede'pi viśaṣaṇaviśeṣyatā| vibhaktiḥ punarekaiva viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayoḥ|| iti nyāyāt `vedāḥ pramāṇam' ityādāviva prakṛte'pi smṛtā iti dhāturityatra viśeṣaṇaṃ syāditi vācyam| yatra viśeṣyavācakapadottaravibhaktibodhyasaṃkhyāviruddhasaṃkhyāyā vivakṣā''vaśyakī tatraiva tannyāyapravṛtteḥ| yathāviśeṣyavācakapadaṃ `pramāṇam' iti, tatratyavibhaktibodhyasaṃkhyāekatvaṃ tadviruddhasaṃkhyā vedā iti bahutvasaṃkhyā tadvivakṣāyāstatrā''vaśyakatvena lakṣaṇasaṃgatiḥ| vedāḥ pramāṇamityava vedeṣu ekajātīyapramāṇatvaṃ bodhayitumiṣṭam| tacca vedagatabahutvasaṃkhyāvivakṣāṃ vinā'nupapannāmityādi lumañjūṣāyāṃ subarthavicāre śeṣe draṣṭavyam| prakṛte smṛtā iti bahutvasaṃkhyāvivakṣāyāṃ kāraṇābhāva iti bhāvaḥ|
phalavyāpārayoriti dvivacananirdeśena phale vyāpāre ca dhātoḥ pṛthak‌śaktiriti sūcitaṃ, na tu phalāvacchinnavyāpāra ekā śaktiḥ| tathā sati viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāve vinigamanāviraheṇa vyāpārāvacchinnaphale caikā śaktiriti śaktidvayakalpanāsāmye'pi phalāvacchinnavyāpāratvaṃ vyāpārāvacchinnaphalatvaṃ ceti guruśakyatāvacchedakadvayakalpanāpatteḥ| kiṃ ca phalasya vyāpārasya ta viśiṣṭaviṣayaikaśaktyopasthitatvātpadārthaikadeśatvena taṇḍulaṃ pacatītyādau phale taṇḍulasya, caitreṇa taṇḍulaḥ pacyate ityādau vyāpāre caitrasya cānvayo na syāt| padārthaḥ padārthenetinyāyāt| yatra viśeṣaṇānvayaścikīrṣitastatretarāviśeṣaṇatvena(itaranirūpitāvitaviśeṣaṇatvānāpannatvena) jñāyamānatvasya niyamāt| viśiṣṭaviṣayaikaśaktyā'rthopasthiterviśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāvāpannatvenaivānubhavāt| ata eva ghaṭapadāt ghaṭatvaviśiṣṭaghaṭaviṣayaikaśaktyupasthitaghaṭatve nityatvaviśeṣaṇābhiprāyeṇa nityo ghaṭa iti prayogo na bhavati| padārthaikadeśe ghaṭe nīla iti viśeṣaṇānvayastu bhavatyeva| ghaṭasyetarāviśeṣaṇatvena jñāyamānatvāt| evaṃ rājapuruṣa iti vṛttāvapi rājñi ṛddhasyeti viśeṣaṇānvayo na bhavati| rājñaḥ puruṣaviśeṣaṇatvena jñāyamānatvāt| sundaro rājapuruṣa iti puruṣe sunda iti viśeṣaṇānvayo bhavatyeva| puruṣasyetarāviśeṣaṇatvena jñāyamānatvāt| ṛddhasya rājñaḥ puruṣa iti vākye tu ekārthībhāvābhāvena viśeṣaṇānvayakāle rājña itarāviśeṣaṇatvena jñāyamānatvādrājñi ṛddhasyeti viśeṣaṇānvayo bhavati| vākye pṛthak‌padārthopasthityanantaramākāṅkṣādivaśādviśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāvenānvayaḥ| vṛttau tu viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvāpannaiva padārthopasthitiriti viśeṣāt| etadeva padārthaḥ padārthenānveti na tu padārthaikadeśeneti nyāyatātparyam| anyathā rājñaḥ puruṣa iti vākye'pi rājñaḥ puruṣe'nvayo na syāt| puruṣatvaviśiṣṭapuruṣaviṣayaikaśaktyupasthitapuruṣasya padārthaikadeśatvāditi bodhyam|
tatra phalāṃśa utsargato vyāpāraviśeṣaṇam| janyajanakabhāvaḥ, saṃsargaḥ phalānukūlo vyāpāra iti viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyaviśeṣyabhāvenaitayoranvayaḥ| nanu haripadādupasthitayosūryasiṃhayoḥ parasparaṃ viśeṣaṇaviśeṣya(ādhārādheya)bhāvenānvayabodhānanubhavāt, `vā syādvikalpopamayorevārthe'pi samuccaye' iti kośādvāśabdopasthitavikalpāḥ dyoraryayoḥ parasparaṃ viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāvenānvayasyādṛṣṭatvācca vibhinnapadopasthitayorevānvaya iti niyamāṅgīkārāvasyakatvenaikapadopasthitayoḥ phalavyāpārayostathā'nvayo na syāditi pṛthak‌śaktisvīkāro'yukta iti cenna| paramate laḍādyarthakṛtivartamānatvādyoḥ svamate'pi tiṅarthāśrayasaṃkhyayoñca parasparamanvayadarśanena ca tādṛśaniyamasya saṃkocanīyatayā vyutpattivaicitryā phalavyāpārayoḥ parasparānvayāṅgīkāre bādhakābhāvāt| atha pṛthak‌śaktipakṣe gamanamiti padātsvātantryeṇa phalasya pratītyā gamanaṃ na vyāpāra iti pratītyāpattistadvāraṇāyaikaśaktipakṣa evāṅgīkartumucita iti cettadapi na| prathamopasthitatvenāntaraṅgatvātphalavyāpārayostāvatprathamato viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvenānvayo bhavati paścāttvarthāntareṇa| tataśca phalasya svātantryeṇānupasthitergamanapadād‌vyāpārasyaiva phalaviśeṣaṇakasya viśeṣyatayā pratītirna viparītasyeti gamanaṃ na vyāpāra iti pratītyanāpatteḥ|
ṛmaprāptaṃ phalāṃśamācaṣṭe phalaṃ viklittyādīti| viklittiḥśithilībhāvo'vayavavibhāgaviśeṣastatsaṃyogo vā| tasya ca viklittitpādiviśeṣarūpeṇa vācyatā na tu phalatvena sāmānyarūpeṇa| tattadviśeṣarūpeṇaiva tadvodhasyānubhavasiddhatvāt dhātutvādikamajānatāmapi kāvyajñādīnāṃ tathā bodhācca| ata eva vākyārthapradarśanāvasareviklittyanukūla utpattyanukūla ityādiviśeṣarūpeṇaiva phalabodha ucyamānaḥ saṃgacchate| yadyapi loke yaduddeśena kriyāpravṛttistvattvaṃ phalatvaṃ tathā'pyatra pāribhāṣikaṃ tad‌gṛhyate| anyathā pākoddeśyāyā bubhukṣānuvṛtteraniṣpattāvapākṣīditi prayogānāpatteḥ| tathā paropakārāya satāṃ pravṛttayaḥ| paropakārāya vahanti nadya ityādau paropakārarūpaphalasya vyāpāravyadhikaraṇasya sattvātpravṛttyādikriyāṇāmakarmikāṇāmapi sakarmakatvāpatteḥ| kiṃciduddiśyaiva loke kriyāpavṛttidarśanena sakarmakākarmakavyavahārasya durbodhatvācca|
viklittyādiniṣṭhaṃ pāribhāṣikaphalatvaṃ ca`kartṛpratyayasamabhivyāhāre taddhātvarthajanyatve sati taddhātvarthaniṣṭhaviśeṣyatānirūpitaprakāratāśrayatave ca sati taddhātvarthatvam' iti| taṇḍulaṃ pacatītyatra pac‌dhātvarthaph‌tkārādivyāpārajanyatve sati tādṛśavyāpāraniṣṭhaviśeṣyatānirūpitaprakāratāpannatvaṃ pac‌vātvarthe viklittau vartata iti kṛtvā lakṣaṇasamanvayaḥ| evaṃagnermāṇavakaṃ vārayatītyādau saṃyogānukūlavyāpārābhāvānukūlavyāpārarūpe dhātvarthe saṃyogānukūlavyāpārābhāve lakṣaṇasamanvayātphalatvamūhyam| atra `kartṛpratyayasamabhivyāhāre' ityupalakṣaṇaṃ na tu viśeṣaṇam| na kartṛpratyayasamabhivyāhāre yasyārthasya phalatvaṃ, karmapratyayasamabhivyāhāre'pi tasyaivārthasya phalatvaṃ bhavatīti bodhyamiti yāvat| āḥ karmapratyayasthale pacyate taṇḍulaḥ pakvastaṇḍula ityādau viklittyāderviśeṣyatve'pi no aphalatvāpattiḥ| atra prathamaviśeṣaṇadale janyatve satītyetāvanmātroktau vibhāgajanyasaṃyogādirūpe patatyādyarthe vibhāgasya kṛtīsādhyatvena janyatvātphalatvāpattiḥ syāttadvāraṇāya janyatve nirūpakatāsaṃbandhena dhātvartho viśeṣaṇam| dhātvarthanirūpitajanyatve satītyarthaḥ| niruktavibhāgasya ca dhātvarthanirūpitajanyatvābhāvānnātiprasaṅgaḥ| nanvevamapi vibhāgasya uttaradeśasaṃyogānukūlavyāpārarūpagamyādiyatkiṃciddhātvarthajanyatvātphalatvāpattistadavasthaiveti cenna, dhātostaditi viśeṣaṇāt| pratyāsattyā yaddhātvarthatvaṃ yaddhātvarthaniṣṭhaviśeṣyatānirūpitaprakāratāpannatvaṃ vā taddhātvarthanirūpitajanyatve satītyarthaḥ| tathā ca niruktavibhāge patidhātvarthasaṃyoganiṣṭhaviśeṣyatānirūpitaprakāratāpannatve'pi patidhātvarthatve'pi ca patatidhāthvarthanirūpitajanyatvābhāvānna phalatvam| nanvevaṃ prayāgātkāśīṃ gacchatītyādau gamyādyarthavyāpārajanyatvādvibhāgasya phalatvāpattiriti cenna| taddhātvarthatvamiti viśeṣyopādānāt| taddhātujanyopasthitiviṣayatvamityarthaḥ| uttaradeśasaṃyogānukūlo vyāpāro gamyādyarthaḥ| tatra pūrvadeśavibhāgamantarottaradeśasaṃyogasyātyantāsaṃbhavena nāntarīyakatayā vibhāgasyottaradeśasaṃyogānukūlavyāpārarūpagamidhātvarthajanyatve'pi gamidhātūpasthitiviṣayatvābhāvānna phalatvamiti bhāvaḥ| nanvevamapi parṇaṃ patatītyatra vibhāgajanyasaṃyoge patatidhātvarthavibhāgajanyatve sati taddhātvarthatvātphalatvāpattiriti cet| tadvāraṇāya taddhātvarthaniṣṭhetyādisatyantaṃ dvitīyaviśeṣaṇam| tataśca niruktasaṃyogasya patatidhātvarthajanyatve'pi patatidhātvarthatve'pi ca patatidhātvarthaniṣṭhaviśeṣyatānirūpitaprakāratāpannatvābhāvānna phalatvam| evaṃ ca patatidhātvarthe vibhāgasaṃyogayormithaḥ phalatvavāraṇāya satyantaṃ viśeṣaṇadvayam| tena vṛkṣātparṇaṃ bhūmau patatītyādau vibhāgāśrayasya vṛkṣādeḥ, saṃyogāśrayasya bhūmyādeśca na karmatvamityūhyam| idaṃ ca kvacidakarmakadhātau vyāpāramātraṃ dhātvartha iti matena| phalavyāpārayordhāturiti prāyovādābhiprāyeṇa| tanmatānaṅgīkāre tu satyantaṃ dvitīyaviśeṣaṇaṃ na deyamiti vodhyam| tena taddhātvarthajanyatve sati taddhātvarthatvam| ityeva phalalakṣaṇam| atra janyatvaṃ cā''ropitānāropitasādhāraṇaṃ grāhyam| teneśvarastiṣṭhati, patye śete, ityādau nāvyāptiḥ| īśvarasthiteḥ patyuddeśyakaśayanādeśca vastuto dhātvarthājanyatvātsthitau śayanādau ca janyatvāropāt| sthityanukūlo vyāpārastiṣṭhaterarthaḥ| śīṅādeśca śayanaviṣayako'dhyavasāyo'rtha iti jñeyam| ādiśabdāt `āste' ityasya grahaṇam| gāṃ payo dogvītyādau cāntaḥsthitadravadravyaniṣṭhavibhāgānukūlavyāpārānukūlavyāpāro duhararthaḥ| tatra gopaniṣṭhataddhātvarthavyāpārajanyatvāttaddhātvarthanirūpitaprakāratāpannatvāttaddhātvarthatvācca goniṣṭhavyāpārasya phalatvaṃ, vibhāgasyāpi goniṣṭhataddhātvarthavyāpārajanyatvāttaddhātvarthaniṣṭhetyādiviśeṣaṇaviseṣyobhayayuktatvācca phalatvaṃ bodhyam| ādipadādajāṃ grāmaṃ nayatītyādi| nanvevamagnermāṇavakaṃ vārayatītyādau saṃyogānukūlavyāpārābhāvasyeva saṃyogasyāpi māṇavakaniṣṭhataddhātvarthavyāpārajanyatvāditritayayuktatvātphalatvāpattiriti cedastu nāma| nahi tāvanmātreṇa kaściddoṣo bhavati| uttaradeśasaṃyogānukūlavyāpārānukūlavyāpāre nīdhātvarthe'jāniṣṭhataddhātvarthavyāpārajanyatvādiviśiṣṭasaṃyogarūpaphalāśrayatvād‌grāmasyevāgnerapi karmatāyāṃ dvitīyāpattiriti tu na vācyam| karmasaṃjñāyāmabhāvapratiyogivyāpārajanyaphalasyāgrahaṇāt| anyathā vāraṇārthānāmiti sūtraṃ karturīpsitatamamityasyāpavādaḥ syāt| tataśca māṇavakamityatrāpi dvitīyānāpatteḥ| taṇḍulaṃ pacatītyādau karmasaṃjñāyāścaritārthatvāt| paśya mṛgo dhāvatītyādau dṛśidātvarthaniṣṭhaviśeṣyātānirūpitaprakāratāpannatve'pi dhāvanāderna phalatvam| dṛśidhātvarthanirūpitajanyatvābhāvād‌dṛśidātvarthatvābhāvācca| svāśrayavyakteryathā prādhānyamanubhavavalātsvīkriyate tathā''khyātavācyakartrākṣiptabhāvanāyāḥ prādhānyamanubhavasiddhamupapādayituṃ śakyamityarthaḥ| anena vācyārthasyaiva prādhānyamiti niyamasya vyabhicāro darśita iti bhāvaḥ| anekamanyapadārthe, ityanuśāsanena piṅge akṣiṇī yasyā iti vigrahadarśanāt‌pradhānaṣaṣṭhyartha eva bahuvrīheḥ sādhutvaṃ pratipādyate| ṣaṣṭhyarthaśabdena ca prakṛtyarthopasarjanako vibhaktyarthaḥ saṃbandha eva pratīyate| uktaṃ cāruṇādhikaraṇebahuvrīhiḥ samāso'yaṃ matubarthe vidhīyate| asyātreti ca saṃbandhe matvarthīyaḥ pravartate|| iti| tathā ca pradhānaṣaṣṭhyarthe matupo vidhāne'pi gomantamānayetyādau puruṣānayanadarśanena saṃbandhākṣiptadharmiṇi eva prādhānyānubhavabalādvācyārthasyaiva prādhānyamiti niyamasya vyabhicāraḥ spaṣṭa eveti bhāvaḥ| pākaṃ karotīti| bhāvanārthakakṛdhātunā vivaraṇādbhāvanāyā ākhyātavācyatvamiti cet| karotītyākhyātena karturapi vivaraṇasya jāyamānatvena pacatītyatratyā''
khyātasya bhāvanāyāṃ śaktiruta kartarītyaniścayaḥ syādityarthaḥ| karturvivaraṇaviṣaye śaṅketena ceti| pacatītyatratyākhyātasya bhāvanārthakakṛdhātunā yadvivaraṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tacchabdārthavivaraṇaṃ, karotītyatratyākhyātena yatkarturvivaraṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tattu na śabdārthavivaraṇaṃ kiṃtu pacatītyataḥ karturbodho jāyatāmiti tātparyaviṣayībhūtākṣepalabhyakarturvivaraṇamiti kṛtvā''khyātasya bhāvanāyāmeva śaktirniściteti na pūrvaktāniścayāvasara iti bhāvaḥ| karturvivaraṇamaśabdārthavivaraṇamityatra dṛṣṭāntamāhapākamiti| pac dhātorviklittimātravācakatve'pi pākamiti karmaṇi dvitīyāśravaṇāttadgatakarmatvasya yathā tātparyato vivaraṇaṃ kṛtaṃ na śabdārthavivaraṇaṃ tadvadityarthaḥ| nanupākamiti dvitīyayā'śabdārthakarmatvavivaraṇādaśabdārthasyāpi saṃsargasya vivaraṇadarśane'pi tadatiriktasyāśabdārthavivaraṇasyādṛṣṭatvād‌dṛṣṭāntāntaramāhaitaretareti| dhavakhadirāvityādītaretarayogadvaṃdvaghaṭakapadāvācyasya samuccayāṃśasya vigrahavākyasthacakāradvayena vivaraṇavadityarthaḥ| tathā cāśabdārthavivaraṇaṃ na tadākhyātārthanirṇāyakamityarthaḥ| tādṛśārthavivaraṇasyā''khyātārthanirṇāyakatve guhyamāṇe tu bhāvanāyāḥ śabdārthatvavirahe'pi tātparyaviṣayībhūtatvenā''kṣepalabhyatvādvivaraṇopapattau satyāṃ bhāvanāyā apyākhyātavācyatvaṃ bhavadabhīṣṭaṃ sidhyetkiṃtu kartureva vācyatvaṃ bhavedityarthaḥ| karturevā''khyātavācyatvamāvaśyakamityāhakiṃ ceti| yathā caitraḥ paktetyādau caitreṇābhedānvayabodasyānubhavasiddhatvātkṛtāṃ kartrādivācitvamāvaśyakaṃ tathā devadattaḥ pacatītyādau devadattābhinnakartṛko vartamāno viklittyanukūlo vyāpāra itiśābdabodhād devadattādinā'bhedānvayabodhānubhavādākhyātānāmapi kartrādivācitvamāvaśyakamityarthaḥ| tathā ca bhāvanāyā ākhyātavācyatvaṃ sutarāṃ durlabhaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ| nanu yatra viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyavācakapadayoḥ samānavibhaktikatvaṃ tatraivābhedānvaya iti niyamaḥ| samānavibhaktikatvaṃ ca viśeṣaṇavācakapade viśeṣyavācakapadottaravibhaktisajātīyavibhaktimattvam| sājātyaṃ ca vibhaktitvavyāpya(suptvyāpya) prathamātvadvitīyātvādidharmeṇa grāhyam| ata eva `nīlo ghaṭam' iti vākyānnābhedānvayabodhāpattiriti śaṅkatena cābhedetyādinā taccātra nāstītyantena| tacceti| abhedānvayabodhaniyāmakasamānavibhaktikatvaṃ cetyarthaḥ| atreti| devadattaḥ pacatītyādau nāstītyarthaḥ| prathamāvibhaktitiṅvibhaktyoḥ suptvyāpyadharmeṇa sājātyābhāvāt| tathā cābhedānvayabodhaniyamakābhāvādevābhedānvayabodhāsaṃbhavānnā''khyātasya kartrādivācakatvaṃ yuktamiti bhāvaḥ| samānavibhaktikatvaniyamasya vyabhicāraṃ darśayitumāhasomeneti| atra lakṣaṇāṃ vinā somasya yāgārthatvaṃ yogenābhedānvayaścānupapannamiti somapadasya matvarthe somavapi lakṣaṇayā somavatā yāgeneṣṭaṃ bhāvayediti viśiṣṭavidhānādvākyabhedaprasaṅgo'pi neti nyāyaprakāśādau mīmāṃsakairnirdhāritam| tatra tṛtīyātiṅ‌vibhaktyoḥ suptvavyāpyadharmeṇa sājātyābhāvādabhedānvayabodho na syāt| mīmāṃsakaistu so'ṅgīkṛta eveti samānavibhaktikatvāniyamasya vyabhicāro duṣparihara ityarthaḥ|
stokaṃ ṣacatīti| phalasyāpi vyapadeśivadbhāvena phalāśrayatvātkarmatvam| ata eva tatsamānādhikaraṇe stokamityatra dvitīyā bodhyā| atra dhātvarthavyāpārajanyaphale stokapadārthasyābhedenānvayaḥ spaṣṭa eva| atrāpi pūrvavanniyamasya vyabhicāra ūhyaḥ|
nanu samānavibhaktikanāmārthayārebhedānvaya ityabhiyuktokternāmārthayorevābhedānvaye samānavibhaktikatvaṃ niyāmakaṃ nānyatretyata āharājapuruṣa iti| rājapadaṃ rājasvatvavatparaṃ lakṣaṇayā| tādṛśasya rājapadārthasya puruṣeṇābhedānvayaḥ| rājanirūpitasvatvavadabhinnaḥ puruṣa iti bodhāt| atra pūrvapade vibhaktoraśravaṇādviśeṣyābhāvaprayukto viśiṣṭābhāvaḥ| ādyodāharaṇadvaye tu vibhaktyoḥ sattve'pi viśeṣaṇībhūtasājātyābhāvaprayukto viśiṣṭābhāva iti viśeṣaḥ| evaṃ ca samānavibhaktikatvaniyamasya nāmārthadvayaviṣayakatve'pi vyabhicāraḥ sutarāṃ durvāra iti bhāvaḥ tathā ca devadattaḥ pacatītyādāvabhedānvayabodhasya niṣpratyūhatvādabhedānvayabodhopapattaye kartrādau śaktirākhyātasyāvaśyaṃ gale patatīti tātparyam|
nanu bhāvanaivā''khyātavācyā'stu devadattaḥ pacatītyādau jāyamānā devadattākhyātārthayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyapratītistvanyathānupapattyā'khyātasya kartarilakṣamayopapadyetetyāśayena śaṅkatena ceti| sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ padayorekadharmipratipādakatvam| tathā ca lakṣaṇayaivābhedabodhanirvāhe kartaryākhyātasya śaktisvīkāro nirarthaka iti bhāvaḥ| lakṣaṇayā karturuktatvātsāmānādhikaraṇyasya nirvāha kriyamāṇe| piṅgākṣyādiyaugiketi| yogo'vayavaśaktiḥ, tatpuraskāreṇārthābhidhāne pravṛttānāṃ śabdānāmityarthaḥ| dravyavācitvānāpattoriti| lakṣaṇayaiva dravyabodhanirvāhād‌dravyavācitvaṃ na syādityarthaḥ| kiṃ tu saṃbandhavācitvameva yuktaṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ| ityāditaddhitānāmapīti| vaiśvadevītyādisamudāyaghaṭakataddhitānāmapi dravyavācitvaṃ na syāditi bhāvaḥ|
yogikaśabdānāṃ saṃbandhavācitvameva viśadayatianekamanyetyādi| anekamanyapadārtheanekaṃ prathamāntamanyasya padasyārthe vartamānaṃ vā samasyate sa bahuvrīhirityarthakenoktasūtreṇa piṅge akṣiṇī yasyā iti vigrahapradarśanāddhetoryasyā iti padopasthitapradhānaṣaṣṭhyartha eva bahuvrīheḥ sādhutvalābhādityarthaḥ| ṣaṣṭhyantena ca prakṛtyarthopasarjanakaḥ ṣaṣṭhyarthaḥ saṃbandha eva pratīyate iti `yasyāḥ' iti anyapadārthamantarbhāvya piṅgākṣiśabdayorvṛttiḥ| ataḥ pradhānasaṃbandhārtha eva bahuvrīheḥ sādhutvaṃ labhyata iti tātparyam| uktaṃ cāruṇādhikaraṇe vārtikebahuvrīhiḥ samāso'yaṃ matubarthe vidhīyate| asyātreti ca saṃbandhe matvarthīyaḥ pravartate|| iti| devatārthakataddhitasyāpi viśve devā devatā asyā iti vigrahe ṣaṣṭhyarthasaṃbandhasyaiva prādhānyadarśanātsaṃbandhasyaiva vṛttivācyatvamavasīyate|
nanūktarītyā pradhānaṣaṣṭhyarthasaṃbandhasyaiva bahuvrīhyadivṛttivācyatvamastu kā hāniriti cedāhatathā ceti| aruṇayetyādivākye dravyānukteriti| ākṛtyadhikaraṇanyāyenāruṇapadasyā''ruṇyaguṇa eva śaktikalpanāt piṅgākṣyādipadasya niruktarītyā pradhānaṣaṣṭhyarthasaṃbandha eva śaktikalpanācca dravyānukterityarthaḥ| svavākyeti| svaṃ krayaṇabhāvanā| tatpratipādakaṃ yadaruṇayā piṅgākṣyetyādivākyaṃ tādṛśavākyagatapiṅgākṣyaikahānyanyeti bahuvrīhivṛttivācyadravya evā''ruṇyasyānvaya ityevaṃ pratipādakasyāruṇādhikaraṇasyocchedāpāttirityarthaḥ|
itthaṃ hyaruṇādhikaraṇamjyotiṣṭome śrūyate`aruṇayā piṅgākṣyaikahāyanyā somaṃ krīṇāti, iti| atrāruṇoti prakṛtibhāgaḥ| krīdhātuścābhidhātrī śrutiḥ| krīṇātītyatratyākhyātapratyayo vidhātrī śrutiḥ| aruṇayeti tṛtīyāpratyayo vibhaktirūpā viniyoktrī śrutiḥ| aruṇāśabdastvāruṇyaguṇamātravācako lāghavāt| na tvāruṇyaguṇaviśiṣṭaṃ dravyamabhidhatte| guṇaviśiṣṭe'rthe'ruṇāśabdasya śaktisvīkāre gauravāpatteḥ| ananyalasyasyaiva śabdārthatvāt| āśrayadravyasyā''kṣepeṇa lābhasaṃbhavāt| tathā cātrāruṇayeti tṛtīyā śrutyā prakṛtyarthasyā''ruṇyaguṇasya somakrayasādhanatvaṃ pratīyate| taccānupapannam| krayo nāma kaṃcitpadārthaṃ dattvā kasyācitpadārthasya grahaṇam| dānaṃ grahaṇaṃ ca vāsohiraṇyādimūrtapadārthasyaiva saṃbhavati| na tvamūrtasya guṇamātrasya| tasyā''śrayībhūtād‌dravyānniṣkṛṣya dānādyasaṃbhavāt| tatastṛtīyāśruterviniyojakatvābhāvena prakaraṇasyātra viniyojakatvaṃ vaktavyam| prakaraṇaṃ ca grahacabhasādyakhiladravyeṣvāruṇyaguṇaṃ niveśayati| tatraiṣā'kṣarayojanāaruṇayetyetatpṛthagvākyam| tatra tṛtīyāśrutyā prākaraṇikāni sādhanadravyāṇi sarvāṇyanūdya prātipadikena guṇo vidhīyateyāni jyotiṣṭome sādhanadravyāṇi tāni sarvāṇyaruṇāni kartavyānītyevaṃ pūrvapakṣayitvā, piṅgākṣyekahāyanīśabdayoḥ piṅge akṣiṇī yasyāḥ, ekaṃ hāyanaṃ yasyā iti cānyapadārthe vihitena bahuvrīhisamāsena dravyavācitvāt| dravyaṃ cātra gaurave| gavā te krīṇānīti mantraliṅgāt| piṅgākṣyaikahāyanyeti ca padadvaye tṛtīyāśrutirdravyasya krayaṇakriyāsādhanatvaṃ bodhayati| tathā'ruṇayeti tṛtīyāśrutirapyāruṇyaguṇasya krayasādhanatvaṃ bodhayati| tacca dravyadvāramantareṇa na saṃbhavatītyarthāpattyādravyāvacchedakatvaṃnāma svāśrayatvena dravyagrahaṇam| svaśabdena guṇagrahaṇam| tathāca guṇaśabdena tādṛśaguṇāśrayībhūtadravyaṃ grāhyam|dravyāvacchedakatvaṃ kalpyate| dravyaṃ cātra svavākyagataikahāyanyeva saṃnihitatvāt| tathā cā''ruṇyaguṇaviśiṣṭaikahāyanyā somaṃ krīṇātītyarthaḥ paryavasyatīti siddhānta uktaḥ| so'saṃgataḥ syāt| piṅgākṣyādipadānāmuktarītyā pradhānaṣaṣṭhyarthasaṃbandhārthakatvena teṣāṃ dravyavācitvābhāvāt|
atredaṃ bodhyam| yadyapi yasyetyādyanyapadārthe prakṛtyarthopasarjinaḥ ṣaṣṭhyarthaḥ saṃbandhaḥ pradhānatayā pratīyate tathā'pi citragurdevadatta iti bahuvrīhisamāse sāmānādhikaraṇyānurodhācchabdaśaktisvabhāvācca ṣaṣṭhyarthasaṃbandhopasarjanaḥ prakṛtyarthaḥ pradhānamityevaṃ viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāvavyatyāsaṃ vṛttau prakalpya piṅgākṣyādibahuvrīherdravyavācitvaṃ nirvāhyam|
mīmāṃsāvārtikakṛto'pi
sarvatra yaugikaiḥ śabdairdravyamevābhidhīyate|
nahi saṃbandhavācyatvaṃ saṃbhavatyatigauravāt|| ityāhuḥ|
ayaṃ bhāvaḥsaṃbandho hi saṃbandhidvayanirūpyaḥ saṃbandhibhyāṃ bhinnaścetyanubhavasiddham| tatra citragirityādāvanuśāsanānurodhena saṃbandhasya sāṃsargikaviṣayatayā vācyatvaṃ kalpanīyam| tathā cātra gorūpasyaikasya saṃbandhinaḥ prātipadikāduktatve 'pi saṃbandhasyobhayanirūpyatvena saṃbandhyantarabhānaṃ vinā bhānāyogād‌dvitīyasaṃbabandhino'pi vācyatvaṃ kalpanīyamiti śaktidviyakalpanāpattyā'tigauravād bahuvrīhau saṃbandhamātravācyatvaṃ na saṃbhavatītyarthaḥ| āvasyakadvitīyasaṃbandhinaivā'kṣepātsaṃvandhabodhopapattāvanyalabhyatvena saṃbandhavācyatvāsaṃbhavaśca| taduktaṃsaṃbandhinaiva saṃbandhaḥ pratyetuṃ yadi śakyate| punastasyābhidhāśaktiṃ kaḥ śruteḥ parikalpayet|| iti| evaṃ ca piṅgākṣīvaiśvadevītyādiyaugikapadānāmuktarītyādravyavācitvamavaśyamaṅgīkāryamiti|
ata eva citragosaṃbandhīti samāsārthaḥ| yatsaṃbadhinyaścitrā gāva iti vigrahārthaḥ| vṛttau viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāvavyatyāsa ityuktatvād vṛttyarthapradarśanārthekalpite citrā gāvo yamyeti vākye'pi viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāvavyatyāsāccitragosaṃbandhītyevārthaḥ| viśeṣyapaviśeṣaṇabhāvavyatyāsapradarśanāyaiva citrā gāvo yasya sa iti prayujyate vṛddhaiḥ| tata e ca na vṛttivigrahayoḥ samānārthatvabhaṅga ityuktaṃ laghumañjūṣāyāṃ nāgeśabhaṭṭairiti jñeyam|
tathā''ruṇyasyāmūrtasya sākṣātkrayasādhanatvāsaṃbhave'pi svāśrayībhūtadravyadvārā paramparayā tasya krayasādhanatvasaṃbhavāt| yathā'ruṇeti strīpratyaya āruṇyaguṇāśrayībhūtagorūpadravyagataṃ strītvaṃ dyotayan paramparayā'ḍa'ruṇyaguṇasya strītvena saṃbandhaṃ bodhayati tathā'ruṇayeti tṛtīyāpratyayo'pyāruṇyaguṇāśrībhūtasya gorūpadravyasya krayasādhanatvaṃ dyotayan paramparayā''ruṇyaguṇasya krayasādhanatvaṃ bodhayatīti na kiṃcidanupapannamiti|
mūlayukteriti| dravyavācakatvasādhikā yā mūlayuktiḥasādhāraṇayuktiḥsāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ piṅgākṣī goḥ, vaiśvadevī āmikṣetyatrānubhavasiddhaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ, tasya ākṣepādinopapatteḥ sattvādityarthaḥ| evaṃ ca yogikānāṃ piṅgākṣyādipadānāṃ, vaiśvadevyādighaṭakapratyayasya ca na kiṃcid‌dravyavācakatvasādhakaṃ, tatmatīterākṣepādinopapatteriti teṣāṃ dravyavācitvaṃ na syādityevamādi vistareṇa nirūpitaṃ vaiyākaraṇabhūṣaṇe tattata evāvagantavyamiti|
nanu laḥ karmaṇi, iti pāṇinisūtreṇa lakārāṇāṃ kartrādyarthe śakteruktatvāt `āśraye tu tiṅaḥ' ityanupapannamata āhabodhakateti| bodhajanakatārūpā śaktirityarthaḥ| tiṅ‌kṣveveti| tiṅ‌niṣṭhaiva vyavahārakāle prayogadaśāyāṃ tiṅāmeva sattvena tebhya eva kartrādyarthabodhasyānubhavasiddhatvādityarthaḥ|
vākyārthajñāne padārthajñānasya kāraṇatvādādau padārthanirupaṇamiti saṃgatiṃ pradarśayan vākyārthaṃ viśeṣya nirūpayitumāhaphale pradhānamiti| phaleviklittyādau vyāpāraḥ pradhānaṃ viśeṣya ityarthaḥ| phalanirūpitaprādhānyavān vyāpāraḥ phalaṃ ca tadviśeṣaṇamityarthaḥ| āśraye tviti| phalāśraye vyāpārāśraye ca| phalavyāpārayordhātulabhyatvādāśrayamātramarthaḥ| ananyalabhyo hi śabādārtha iti nyāyāt| tathā cā''śrayatvameva śakyatāvacchedakam| tiṅa iti| ādeśino lakārasyārthena tiṅo'rthavattvamādāyedaṃ bodhakatvaṃ, prayoge lakārābhāvena tibādibhya eva kartrādyarthabodhasyānubhavasiddhatvāttiṅa eva tatra śaktirityabhiprāyeṇa vā| tiṅarthaiti| kartṛkarmasaṃkhyākālāḥ| tatreti| kartrādyarthānāṃ madhye| kartā vyāpāre viśeṣaṇamādhārādheyabhāvasaṃbandhena vyāpāranirūpitaviśeṣaṇatāvān kartetyarthaḥ| kartṛniṣṭho vyāpāra iti bodhāt| evameva karma phale viśaṣaṇaṃ phalanirūpitaviśeṣaṇatāvatkarmetyarthaḥ| taṇḍulādiniṣṭhā viklittyādiriti bodhāt| saṃkhyeti| kartṛpratyayasamabhivyāhāre kartari saṃkhyāyā viśeṣaṇatvenānvayaḥ| karmapratyaye karmaṇi saṃkhyāyā viśeṣaṇatvenānvaya ityarthaḥ|
nanu dhātvarthasya phalavyāpārātmakasya prakṛtyupasthāpitatvena tasyāpi pratyāsannatayā tatra kuto na saṃkhyāyā viśeṣaṇatvenānvayaḥ| kiṃ ca saṃkhyāyāḥ pratyayārthatvāt prakṛtyarthe dhātvartha eva tadanvayasya nyāyyatvātsubarthasaṃkhyāyāḥ prakṛtyartha evānvayasya dṛṣṭāvāccā''khyātārthasaṃkhyāyā api dhātvartha evānvaya ucita ityāśaṅkāṃ nirākurvan kartrādau saṃkhyānvaye dhaurādeśena vā dhāvatīti rūpaṃ sidhyati| dhāvanaṃ nāmottaradeśasaṃyogānukūla utkaṭavegavān vyāpāraḥ| laḍarthaḥ kartā| tatra mṛgasyābhedenānvayaḥ| tathā ca mṛgābhinno yo laḍarthaḥ kartā tanniṣṭho deśaviśeṣasaṃyogānukūlo vegavattaro vyāpāra ityevaṃ vyāpāramukhyāviśeṣyakaḥ śābdabodho vaiyākaraṇamate| tathā paśyetyatra loṇmadhyamapuruṣaikavacanaṃ dṛś dhātoḥ paśyādeśaśca| dṛś‌dhātvarthaścākṣuṣajñānānukūlo vyāpāraḥ| tathā ca yuṣmadarthābhinnaloḍarthakartṛniṣṭhaścākṣuṣajñānākūlo vidhiviṣayo vyāpāra iti bodhaḥ pṛthak| ekapadārthe'parapadārthasaṃsargaḥ saṃsargamaryādayā bhāsate na tatra saṃsargārthakaśabdāpekṣeti mṛgakartṛkadhāvanakriyāyāḥ karmatvena dṛśikriyāyāmanvaye mṛgābhinnalaḍarthakartṛkaścākṣuṣajñānānukūlo vidhiviṣayo vyāpāra ityekavākyatayā bodhaḥ| tatra dhāvanasya dṛśikriyākarmabhūtasya dhātuvācyatayā dhātośca prātipadikasaṃjñāviraheṇa na tasmād dvitīyāprasaktiḥ| pacati bhavatipacikriyā bhavatīti, pakṣyati bhavatibhaviṣyantī pākakriyā sūkṣmarūpeṇa uttaradeśasaṃyogānukūlavegavattakhyāpāravān mṛga iti bodhāttāṭṭaśabodhe viśeṣyabhūtasya mṛgasya dṛśikriyāyāṃ karmatayā'nvayaḥ kartavyaḥ syāt| sa ca na saṃbhavati| karmabhūtasya mṛgasya prātipadikārthatayā paśyetyatratyatiṅā tadanabhidhānena cānabhihitādhikārīyakarmaṇi dvitīyeti dvitīyāpattivirodhāt| ayaṃ bhāvaḥdhāvanaṃ prati viśeṣyabhūto mṛgaḥ| sa ca dṛśikriyāṃ pratisākṣādviśeṣaṇaṃ dṛśikriyā cātra pradhānam| tathā ca dhāvatītyatratyatiṅā mṛgarūpasya karturuktatvādabhihite prathameti mṛgapadottaraṃ prathamā prāptā, atha ca darśanakriyānirūpitakarmatvāttaduttaraṃ dvitīyā ca prāptā| tatra prathamā'ntaraṅgā, mṛgo dhāvatītyekavākyāśritatvāt| dvitīyā tu bahiraṅgā, paśya mṛgo dha vatītyubhayavākyāśritatvāt| tataśca dvitīyāṃ bādhitvā prathamopasthitatvenāntaraṅgatvāt pūrvaṃ prathamāntārthamukhyaviśeṣyakaśca śābdabodhaḥ| tathā ca naiyāyikamate paśya mṛgo dhāvatītyasyetthaṃ śābdabodhaḥuttaradeśasaṃyogānukūlavyāpārānukūlakṛtimānamṛgaḥ| paśyetyatra ca tamityadhyāhṛtya mṛgaśabdād dvitīyāpattāvityarthaḥ| laṭaḥ śatṛśānacāviti sūtre'prathamāntena samānādhikaraṇasya laṭaḥ sthāne śatṛśānacorvidhānānmṛgapadottaraṃ dvitīyāprabuttau dhāvatītyatra prakriyādaśāyāṃ laṭaḥ sthāne nityaṃ śatā prasajyeta| tathā ca tibādyapravṛttibhiyaiva dvitīyā na kariṣyata iti śaṅkakāśayaḥ| siddhāntī tu śatṛprasaṅgo na dvitīyāpravṛttipratibandhakaḥ| kiṃ tu karmaṇo'bhihitatvaṃ pravṛtte'patyirthaḥ| mṛgasya dṛśikriyāyāṃ karmatayā'nvaye sati karmaṇo'nabhihitatvena mṛgapadottaraṃ dvitīyāpravṛtterduṣpariharatvād dhāvantaṃ mṛgaṃ paśyetyevaṃma vākyasyaiva yogyatvātpaśya mṛgo mṛgapadottaraṃ dvitīyāyā aprasaktyā paśya mṛgo dhāvatīti prayogasaṃbhavamāśaṅkya nirākurutena ca paśyetyatretyādinā| paśyeti darśanakriyāyāṃ karmatayā mṛgasya nānvayaḥ| kiṃtu tatra tamiti svatantraṃ karmādhyāhāryam| tathā ca yo mṛgo dhāvati taṃ paśyetyarthātpaśya mṛgo dhāvatīti prayogasaṃbhava iti saṅkāśayaḥ| adhyāhāro na yuktaḥ| tathā sati mṛgo dhāvatītyekaṃ vākyaṃ taṃ paśyeti ca dvitīyamiti vākyabhedarūpagauravāpātādityarthaḥ| kiṃ ca paśya mṛgo dhāvatīti vākyānmṛganiṣṭhotkaṭadhāvanakarmakaṃ darśanamityekavākyatayā bodhasya sarvānubhavāsiddhād‌ dṛśikriyāyāṃ karmatāsaṃbandhena mṛganiṣṭhotkaṭadhāvanasyaivānvayaḥ pratipādayitumabhīṣṭaḥ| sa ca vyāpāramukhyaviśeṣyakabodavādināṃ vaiyākaraṇānāṃ mate sāmīcīnyenopapadyate| uttaradeśasaṃyogānukūlaṃ mṛgābhinnalaḍarthakartṛniṣṭhamutkaṭadhāvanamityevaṃ dhāvatītyasmādviśeṣyatayā pratītasyotkaṭadhāvanasya darśanakriyāyāṃ karmatayā'nvayāt| kartrādestiṅ‌vācyatvamaṅgīkṛtya pratyayārthaprādhānyavādināṃ mate prathamāntamukhyaviśeṣyakaśābdabodhavādināṃ tārkikāṇāṃ mate ca nopapadyate| uttaradeśasaṃyogānukūlavyāpārānukūlakṛtyāśrayamṛgakarmakaṃ darśanamiti śābdabodhodayānmṛgapadottaraṃ prasaktadvitīyāyāḥ parihārārthaṃ darśane tamiti karmādhyāhāraḥ| tatra tamiti tacchabdena kevalamṛgasya dhāvanānukūlakṛtyāśrayamṛgasya vā parāmarśe'pi pratipipādayiṣitasya mṛganiṣṭhotkaṭadhāvanakarmakaṃ darśanamityarthasya tadvākyātpratītyanupapatteḥ| nanūtkaṭadhāvanakriyāviśiṣṭamṛgasya tacchabdena parāmarśe sati `vidhipratiṣedhau viśeṣaṇamupasaṃkrāmataḥ sati viśeṣye bādhe' iti nyāyena śikhī dhvasya ityatra viśeṣyabhūte śikhini dhvaṃsānvayaṃ parityajya tadviśeṣaṇabhūtaśikhāyāṃ dhvaṃsānvayaparyavasānavanmṛganiṣṭhotkaṭadhāvanakriyāyā eva karmatayā darśane'nvayasya paryavasānena na niruktavivakṣitārthānupapattiriti cenna| dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikayorvaiṣamyāt| tathā hi śikhī dhvasya iti dṛṭānte viśeṣyabhūte śikhāviśiṣṭe puruṣe pratyakṣeṇa dhvaṃsānvayasya bādhāttadviśeṣaṇe śikhāyāṃ dhvaṃsānvayaparyavasānaṃ yuktam| dārṣṭāntike paśya mṛgo dhāvatītyatra tu viśeṣyabhūte mṛge darśanakriyākarmatvasya bādhābhāvena viśeṣyabhūtamṛgasyaiva karmatāsaṃbandhena ākhyātārthakartrādiviśeṣyaśābdabodhasvīkartṛmate prathamāntārthaviśeṣyakabodhavādimate ca bhāṣyakṛtsaṃmataikavākyatānupapattirūpadoṣaghrauvye cetyarthaḥ| bhāvanā saṃkhyākālādyatirikto kāryakāraṇabhāvo'vaseyaḥ| devadattastaṇḍulaṃ pacatītyasmāddevadattābhinno yo laḍarthaḥ kartā tanniṣṭhastaṇḍulaniṣṭhaviklittyanukūlo vyāpāra iti bodhasyānubhavasiddhatvāt| yadyapyayaṃ vyāpāraḥ phūtkāratvāditattdviśeṣarūpeṇa dhātuvācyastathā'pi dhātūnāmanekārthatvātkadācitsāmānyarūpeṇāpi dhātuvācyo bhavati| ata eva vākyārthapradarśanasamaye viklittyanukūlo vyāpāra iti sāmānyarūpeṇa bodha svīkartavyaḥ|
nanu dhātvarthavyāpārasya kṛtpratyayārthaṃ pratyeva viśeṣaṇatvaṃ natu tiṅarthaṃ pratīti anubhūyamānaniyamasaṃpattaye bhāvanāprakārakaśābdabodhe jananīye kṛtpratyayajanyopasthitiḥ kāraṇamityevaṃ bodhopasthityoḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvo'vaśyamaṅgīkaraṇīyaḥ| tathā ca pacati bhavatītyāditaḥ kriyāprakārakakriyāviśeṣyakaḥ śābdabodo'tyantāsaṃbhavī| kriyāprakārakabodhe hetubhūtāyāḥ kṛtpratyayajanyopastiterabhāvādityāśaṅkya nirācaṣṭebhāvanāprakāraketi| yathā gantetyādāvanyadeśasaṃyogānukūlavyārāśraya iti pratyayārthamukhyaviśeṣyakaśābdabodhasya sarvānubhavasiddhatvādbhāvanā tadvaddhātvarthabhāvanāprakārakabodhe jananīye dhātvarthabhāvanāniṣṭhaprakāratānirūpitaviśeṣyatāsaṃbandhena dhātujanyabhāvatopasthitiḥ kāraṇamityapi kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ kalpyaḥ| ākhyātārthakartṛprakārakabodhe jananīye viṣayatāsaṃbandhena dhātujanyabhāvanopasthitiḥ kāraṇamityuktaṃ, kiṃ tu dhātumātrasya vyāpāravācitvaṃ na dṛśyate naśyatītyādau vyāpārapratīterananubhavāt| tathā ca tatroktakāryakāraṇabhāvavyabhicāra ityāśayenā''haghaṭo naśyatītyatreti| ayaṃ bhāvaḥnaś dhātorna kevalaṃ nāśo'rthaḥ| kiṃ tu `ṇaśa adarśane' iti dhātupāṭhātadarśanānukūlo vyāpāro'rthaḥ| sa ca vyāpāraḥ pratiyogitāsahitanāśasāmagrīsamavadhānam| atra nāśasāmagryāḥ pratiyogitāsāhityaṃ ca nirūpakatāsaṃbandhena bodhyam| tathā ca ghaṭaniṣṭhā yā pratiyogitā, tannirūpikā yā nāśasāmagrī tatsamavadhānameva vyāpāra ityarthaḥ| nāśasāmagrī ca śanaiḥ śanaiḥ kramikāvayavaviśaraṇādirūpā| evaṃ ca ghaṭābhinnāśrayako'darśanānukūlo vyāpāra iti bodhānna kāryakāraṇabhāvabhaṅga ityarthaḥ| ata evanaś dhātoradarśanānukūlavyāpārārthakatvādeva| tasyāṃ satyāmitiḥ krameṇāvayavaviśaraṇādyātmikāyāṃ sāmagryāṃ satyāmityarthaḥ| avayavakṣaraṇātprakādarśanānukūlavyāpārasattvaparyantaṃ naśyati, vyāpārātyaye naṣṭaḥ, vyāpārasya bhāvitve naṅ‌kṣyatīti prayoga upapadyate ityarthaḥ| devadatto jānāti, icchatītyādau vākyārthabodhaṃ varṇayatidevadattābhinnāśrayaka ityādi| sa cavyāpāraścetyarthaḥ| antata āśrayataiveti| antato gatvā vicāre kriyamāṇe jñānecchādinirūpitā''śrayataiva tadanukūlo vyāpāra ityarthaḥ| jñānecchādīnāmāśrayamantarā'nupalambhāttadupalambhajanakatvenā''śrayataiva vyāpāraḥ| āśrayatāprāpakā ye vyāpārāstadāropādāśrayajñānaṃ paurvāparyasattavād‌vyāpāratvamityarthaḥ| vastuta ātmamanaḥsaṃyogo'pi jñānecchādyanukūlavyāpāraḥ saṃbhavatīti bodhyam|| 2 ||
atha kva phale āśrayānvayaḥ kva ca vyāpāra iti prasaṅgasaṃgatyā tattātparyagrāhakaṃ vaktuṃ bhūmikāmāracayatinanvākhyātasyetyādinā| `āśraye tu tiṅaḥ smṛtāḥ' ityanenā''khyātasya nāma kevalasya tiṅaḥ atha sāmānyata uktaṃ dhātorvyāparavācitvaṃ sādhakabādhakavicārema draḍhayituṃ bhūmikāmāracayatievamityādi| āśraye tu tiṅa sbhṛtā ityādiniruktarītyā vākyārthaṃ nirūpyetyarthaḥ| nanu sāmānyato bhāvanāyā avācyatvamityanvayena dhātuniṣṭhavācakatānirūpitavācyatvābhāvo bhāvanāsaṃbapandhīti vadataḥ prābhākarādīn pratītyarthaḥ| yadvā bhāvanāniṣṭhavācyatānirūpitavācakatvābhāvo dhātau iti vadata gacchatigamanaṃ karoti, iṃtyevaṃ vyāpārārthakakṛñā pacyādidhātuvivaraṇasyaiva pramāṇatvamiti pradarśayannāhapacatipākamutpādayatītyādi| nanu vyāpāro bhāvanā saiveti kārikāyāṃ yā kriyā saiva bhāvanā saiva cotpādanā, ityukte'pi kriyāyā bhāvanātvasiddhau kimarthaṃ vyāpārapadaṃ niveśitamityata āhavyāpārapadaṃ ceti| ayatnānāmiti| kṛtipadavācyo yaḥ prayatnastadbhinnānāmapi phūtkārādivyāpārāṇāṃ tattadviśeṣarūpeṇa bhāvanāpadavācyatvasiddhyarthaṃ vyāpārapadamupāttam| kriyāśabdena tu bhāvārthakaśapratyayavyutpannena kṛtiśabdavadyatnārthakena kṛtereva cetanamātraniṣṭhāyā bhāvanāpadavācyatvaṃ labhyeta na tu cetanācetasādhāraṇānāṃ vyāpārāṇāmiti bhāvaḥ| kriyāpadaṃ ca tādṛśavyāpārāṇāṃ dhātuvācyatvaṃ kriyāpadavācyatvaṃ ca bodhayitumityarthaḥ| ata eveti| tena tena rūpeṇa vyāpārasya dhātuvācyatvādeva| bodhaḥ sarvasiddha iti| sarvānubhavasiddhasya viśeṣarūpeṇa bodhasyāpahnavo'yukta iti bhāvaḥ| evaṃ vyāpārasya viśeṣarūpeṇa dhātuvācyatvādeva caitraḥ pacatīti vākyajanyabodhadaśāyāṃ caitraḥ phūtkārādimānna veti saṃśayo na jāyate, sāmānyarūpema bodhe tu asti nāstītyanyatarakoṭiniścayābhāvena saṃdeho durvāra iti bhāvaḥ| atha phūtkāratvādīnāṃ gurutvānnānātvācca vācyatāvacchedakatvasvīkāro'yukta iti tadapekṣayā laghutvādekatvācca kṛtitvasyaiva dhātuvācyatāvacchedakatvasvīkāra ucita iti naiyāyikasaṃmataniyamadvārā dhātoḥ kṛtivācakatvaṃ sādhayannāśaṅkate taṭasthaḥna caivamityādisādhvītyantena| evamiti| uktarītyā phūtkārādibyāpārāṇāṃ dhātuvācyatve| eṣāṃphūtkāratvādīnām| śakyatāvacchedakatve svīkṛte satīti śeṣaḥ| gauraveti| teṣāṃ gurutvādanekatvāccetyarthaḥ| kṛtitvameveti| phūtkāratvādyapekṣayā kṛtitvasyapravṛttitvarūpakṛtitvamiṣṭasādhanatājñānanirūpitakāryatāṃvacchedakatayāsiddho jātiviśeṣaḥ|laghutvājjātitvenakatvāccetyarthaḥ| evakāreṇa phūtkāratvādervyāvṛttiḥ| tadavacchedakamiti| dhātuvācyatāvacchedakaṃ vaktavyamityarthaḥ| tathā ca viklittyanukūlā kṛtirdhāṃtvartho'stviti śaṅkābhiprāyaḥ| kṛtiśca yatna eva| nanvevaṃ kṛterdhātuvācyatve ratho gacchatītyādāvacetane rathādau yatnasya bādhād‌vyāpārādipratītiḥ sarvānubhavasiddhā kathaṃ nirvāhyetyata āharatho gacchatītyādāviti| jānātītyasya devadatta ityādiḥ| ādipadādicchati naśyatītyādiparigrahaḥ| vyāpāratvādītyādinā''śrayatvapratiyogitvayoḥ parigrahaḥ| sa ca lakṣaṇayetyarthaḥ| naiyāyikarītiriti| lakārāṇāṃ kṛtau śaktirlāghavānna tu kartari, kṛtimataḥ kartṛtvena tatra śaktau gauravāditi manyamānairnaiyāyikairvyāpāre āśrayatve vā lakṣaṇāmaṅgīkṛtya yathā ratho gacchatītyayaṃ prayogaḥ sādhitastadvatkṛterdhātvarthatve'pi śaṅkakena mayā sādhayituṃ śakya ityarthaḥ| atra taṭasthasya kṛterdhātvarthatvasamarthanārthameva naiyāyikarītyanusaraṇaṃ na tvanyāśasamarthana iti bodhyam|
avacchedakatve hītthaṃ niyamaḥsaṃbhavati laghau, gurau tadabhāva iti| mānāntarasiddhe laghudharme'vacchedakatve saṃbhavati sati gurudharme'vacchedakatvaṃ na kalpanīyam| yathā prameyadhūmābhāvapratiyogitāyā avacchedakatvaṃ prameyadhūmatvasamaniyate śuddhadhūmatva evāṅgīkriyate na tu prameyatvaviśiṣṭadhūmatve, laghugurudharmayorubhayorapi śabdaśaktyātmakamānāntarasidadhatvāditi hi tasyārthaḥ, na tu mānāntarāgamye'pi laghudharme kevalalāghavānurodhena tatsvīkāryamiti| tataśca phūtkāratvādyopakṣayā kṛtitvasya laghudharmatve'pi mānāntaragamyatvābhāvād‌dṛṣṭāntabalena ca gurudharme'pyavacchedakatvasvīkārasaṃbhavātprakṛtasthale niruktaniyaprasaṃgatyasaṃbhavenāyuktā taṭasthāśaṅ‌ketyāśayenā''haśakyatāvacchedakatvasyāpīti| yathaā gaṅgāyāṃ ghoṣa ityatra lakṣaṇayopasthitārthagate gaṅgātīratvātmake gurudharme lakṣyatāvacchedakatvaṃ svīkriyate tadvatphūtkāratvādigurudharme'pi śakyatāvacchedakatvasvīkāre bādhakābhāvādityarthaḥ| tayorvaiṣamyeti| śaktilakṣaṇayorubhayorapi padatadarthasaṃbandarūpatvāviśeṣeṇa lakṣyatāvacchedakatvaṃ gurudharme śakyatāvacchedakatvaṃ tu na tatretyevaṃ vailakṣaṇyakaraṇasya pramāṇābhāvenānucitatvātpacatītyato viklittyanukūlo yatna iti bodhasyā''nubhavikānāmanudayācca sarvathā'yuktaṃ taṭasthāśaṅkitaṃ dhātoḥ kṛtivācakatvamiti bhāvaḥ|
nanu na kevalalāghavānurodhena kṛtitvasya dhātuvācyatāvacchedakatvamāśaṅ‌kitaṃ kiṃtu mānāntaragamyatvasaṃbhavasahakṛtenaiva lāghaveneti sūcayaṃstasya mānāntaragamyatvasaṃbhavamāśaṅkatena ceti| ayaṃ bhāvaḥkṛño yatnārthakatvamavaśyameṣṭavyam| yatnajanyatvānusaṃdhānadaśāyāmeva paṭaḥ kṛta iti kṛtavyavahāradarśanāt| yatnajanyatvānusaṃdhānābhāve tu tatrāṅkuraḥ kṛta iti kṛtavyavahāradarśanāt| kiṃ tvaṅkuro jāta ityevamakṛtavyavahāradarśanāt| itthaṃ ca pacatītyetaddhaṭakapac‌dhātoḥ pākaṃ karotītyevaṃ yatnārthakakarotinā vivaraṇāt, kiṃ karotīti yatnaviṣayakapraśne pacatītyuttarasya yatnārthakatvaṃ vinā'nupapatteśca yatna eva dhātorathaṃ iti śaṅkābhiprāyaḥ yatnaśca kṛtireva| saṃbhavedevaṃ yadi kṛño yatnārthakatvaṃ suvacaṃ syāt, tadeva tu durlabhamiti dūre dhātoryatnārthakatvakathanamityabhipretyā''haratha iti| atra rathapadānupādāne gamanānukūlayatnasya caitrādicetananiṣṭhasya vidyamānatvena na tādṛśaprayogahānirato `rathaḥ' ityuktam| aṅkuraḥ kṛta ityetāvanmātroktau yatnāparaparyāyeśvarīyakṛtijanyatvamādāya niruktaprayogopapattirata uktaṃ bījādineti| evaṃ ca rathabījādāvacetane yatnasya sarvathā bādhāttādṛśaprayogāsaṃgatyā naiva kaॉño yatnavācitvamapi tu vyāpāravācitvaṃ vinā niruktaprayogānupapatteḥ kṛño vyāpāre lākṣaṇikatvānna tena yatnārthakatvabhaṅga iti vācyam| saṃbhavati mukhyārthakatve lākṣaṇikārthakalpanāyā anyāyyatvāt| tathā ca bahuśaḥ kṛño vyāpāravācitvadarśanena vyāpāra eva kṛñaḥ śaktiruciteti tādṛśārthakakarotinā dhātorvivaraṇād‌vivriyamāṇavivaraṇayoḥ samānārthakatvaniyamāddhātorvyāpāravācitvamavaśyaṃ svīkaraṇīyamityāśayaḥ| vivaraṇaṃ ca tatsamānārthakapadāntareṇa tadarthakathanam| pacatītyanena samānārthakaṃ yatpadāntaraṃ pākaṃ karotītyākārakaṃ tena pacatītyasyārthakathanamiti bodhyam|
atha kṛño'karmakatāpatteriti kārikottarārdhamavatārayituṃ bhūmikāmāracayatikiṃcetyādinā| bhāvanāyāḥvyāpārarūpabhāvanāyāḥ| avācyatvedhātunirūpitavācyatvābhāve tiṅ‌nirūpitavācyatvābhāve ca satītyarthaḥ| tataśca phalamātrasya dhātvarthatve paryavasanne svajanakavyāpāravyadhikaraṇadhātvarthaphalāśrayatvaṃ, dhātvarthaphalāśrayatvameva vā karmatvaṃ vaktavyam| atra svapadena phalaṃ grāhyam| evaṃ ca utpattyarthakād‌bhūdhātostadanukūlavyāpāravācake ṇic‌pratyaye kṛte ghaṭaṃ bhāvayatītyatra utpattirūpadhātvarthaphalāśrayatvena karmatvādyathā ghaṭapadottaraṃ dvitīyā bhavati tadvad ghaṭobhavatītyatrāpi utpattirūpadhātvarthaphalāśrayatvena karmatvād ghaṭapadottaraṃ dvitīyāpattiḥ syāt| atredaṃ bodyam| ṇijantasthale svajanaketyādi prathamaṃ karmalakṣaṇaṃ, dvitīyaṃ tu śuddhe ṇijante ceti| ghaṭo bhavatītyatra ghaṭapadottaraṃ dvitīyāpattiṃ vārayituṃ śaṅkatena cātra ghaṭasyeti| karmasaṃjñāyā bādhāditi| ghaṭo bhavatītyatra ghaṭasya kartṛtvena pratīteghaṭasyotpattirūpaphalāśrayatve'pi parayā kartṛsaṃjñayā karmasaṃjñāyā bādhānna dvitīyāpattiriti bhāvaḥ śaṅkakasya| yaduktaṃ ghaṭasya kartṛtvaṃ tanna saṃbhavatītyāhaanugateti| cetanācetanaitadubhayavṛttikartṛtvalakṣaṇasya tvayā vaktumaśakyatayā ghaṭasya kartṛtvābhāvād‌durnivārā dvitīyotyarthaḥ| gaṭasyākartṛtvameva pratipādayatikṛtyāśrayatvasyetyādi| yadi tattaddhāttvarthaphalānukūlakṛtyāśrayatvaṃ kartṛtvamucyate tarhi prayatnāparaparyāyāyāḥ kṛteścetanamātraniṣṭhadharmatvenācetane tadabhāvena ghaṭo'stītyādāvavyāptiḥ| kārakacakreti| prakṛtadhātūpāttakriyānvayayogyakārakasamudāyapravartakatvaṃ taditi cetsthālī pacati asiśchinattītyādau sthālyāderacetanasya kārakacakrapravartakatvābhāvenāvyāptireva| abhāvāditi| ghaṭasyācetanatvātkṛtyāśrayatvasya kārakacakraprayoktṛtvasya cābhāva iti bhāvaḥ| tathā ca kṛtyādimata eva kartṛsaṃjñāyā uktatvātkṛtyādyabhāve kartṛsaṃjñāprāṣtyabhāvena karmasaṃjñāyā anapavādatvādvitīyāpattirdurvāretyarthaḥ| mama mate dhātūpāttavyāpārāśrayatvena kartṛtvānna dvitīyā kiṃtu prathamaiveti na doṣaḥ| evaṃ dhātorvyāpārāvācakatvāvādinaiyāyikamataṃ nirākṛtya phalaṃ dhātvarthaḥ, vyāpāraḥ pratyayārtha iti vādinaṃ mīmāṃsakaṃ pratyācaṣṭedhātvarthānukūleti| ayaṃ bhāvaḥsvatantraḥ karteti sūtre svātantryaṃdhātvartha phalānukūlavyāpārāśrayatvaṃ, tacca ghaṭe utpattyanukūlavyāpārasattvenābādhitameveti tādṛśasvātantryameva kartṛtvaṃ mayā manyata iti| tadapi na, ativyāptatvādityāhakārakamātreti| mātra śabdaḥ kārtsnye| karmakaraṇādisarveṣvapi kārakeṣu tattaddhātvarthaphalānukūlayatkiṃcitkriyāśrayatvasattvenātiprasaṅgaḥ| kriyājanakatvasyaiva kārakatvādityarthaḥ| nanu sarveṣu kārakeṣu ghātvarthānukūlavyāpārāśrayatvarūpasvātantryasattve'pi yasya ākhyātopāttavyāpārāśrayatvena svātantryaṃ vivakṣyate tasyaiva kartṛsaṃjñā bhavati iti svatantraḥ karteti sūtrapraṇayanasāmarthyādavagamyate| anyathā parayā kartṛsaṃjñayā bādhādapādānādisaṃjñā nirviṣayāḥ syuḥ| tataśca kāṣṭhaiḥ sthālyāṃ taṇḍūlaṃ pacatītyādau karaṇādikārakaprayogasya vilaya eva syāt| ata eva laghumañjūṣāyāṃ nāgeśabhaṭṭairuktaṃ subarthavicāresarveṣāṃ svasvavyāpāradvārā svātantryeṇaiva kriyāniṣpādakatvātkartṛkārakatvam| atra svātantryetyasya svātantryavivakṣayaivetyatthaḥ tataḥ kena kaḥ kiṃ pacatītyādivivakṣāyāṃ svasvavyāpāravaśena karaṇāditvaṃ bhavatyeveti| harimā'pyuktamniṣpattimātre kartṛtvaṃ sarvatraivāsti kārake| vyāpārabhedāpekṣāyāṃ karaṇāditvasaṃbhavaḥ|| yathā putrajanmani pitroḥ kartṛtve'pi kaḥ kasyāṃ kā ca kasmāditibhedena vivakṣāyāmayamasyāmiyamasmātputraṃ janayatīti vyavahāro'pyupapadyata iti ca| kāraka iti sūtre bhāṣye'pyuktamsthālīsthe yatne kathyamāne sthālī svatantrā, iti| vivakṣitasvātantryavatīti tadarthaḥ| evaṃ ca svātantrsya vivakṣādhīnatvānnātiprasaṅgo nāpi ghaṭo bhavatītyatra dvitīyāprasaṅgaḥghaṭaniṣṭhadhātvarthaphalānukūlavyāpārasyaiva svātantryavivakṣaṇena kartṛsaṃjñāyā aparihāryatvādityata āhaapa cetyādi| ucchinnaḥ syāditi| yadi vyāpārarūpā bhāvanā dhātuvācyā na syāttarhi sakarmako'yaṃ dhāturayaṃ cākarmaka ityevaṃ vibhāgaḥ sarvathā durupapāda ityarthaḥ| siddhāntasaṃmataṃ sakarmakalakṣaṇamāhasvārthaphaletyādi| svapadena dhāturgrāhyaḥ| tathā ca dhātuvācyaṃ yatphalaṃ tādṛśaphalavyadhikaraṇo yo vyāpārastadvācakatvaṃ dhātoścedbhavati tadā so'yaṃ dhātuḥ sakarmaka ityucyate| bhūprabhṛtāvakarmake'tiprasaṅgavāraṇāya svārthaphalavyādhikaraṇeti vyāpāraviśeṣaṇam| tathā ca bhūprabhṛterakarmakadhātoḥ svārthaphalasamānādhikaraṇavyāpāravācakavānna sakarmakatvamityarthaḥ| nanu bhūprabhṛtīnāmapi pacyādidhātvarthaphalavyādhikaraṇavyāpāravācakatvādatiprasaṅgastadavastha eveti cenna| phale svārthetiviśeṣaṇadānāt| svārtho yatphalaṃ tad‌vyadhikaraṇetyarthād‌bhūprabhṛtervyāpārasya pacyādidhātvarthaphalavyadhikaraṇatve'pi svārathaphalavyadhikaraṇatvābhāvānna kṣatiḥ| nanu grāmaṃ gacchati caitraḥ, ityādau gamyādidhātvarthaphalasya saṃyogasya dviṣṭhatvena grāmacaitrobhayavṛttitvāccaitraniṣṭhavyāpārasya gamyādidhātvarthaphalavyadhikaraṇatvābhāvenāvyāptiḥ| tathā ca gamyādidhātoḥ sakarmakatvaṃ na syāditi cenna| phalavyadhikaraṇatvaṃ ca phalatāvacchedakasaṃbandhena yatkiṃcittaddhātvarthaphalādhikaraṇabhinnavṛttitvaṃ vivakṣitam| phalādhikaraṇayordvayarmadhye kiṃcidekaṃ yatphalādhikaraṇaṃ tadapekṣayā bhinnavṛttitvaṃ vyāpārasyeti tadarthaḥ| vyāpārasya yatkiṃcitphalādhikaraṇabhinnavṛttitvaṃ grāhyaṃ natu yāvatphalādhikaraṇabhinnavṛttitvamiti yāvat| tathā ca gamyādivyāpārasya yāvatphalādhikaraṇabhinnavṛttitvābhāve'pi gamyādidhātvarthasaṃyogātmakaphalādhikaraṇayorgrāmacaitrayormadhye yadekaṃ phalādhikaraṇaṃ grāmaḥ, tadapekṣayā bhinno yaścaitrastad‌vṛttivyāpāravācakatvānna sakarmakeṣu gamyāderasaṃgraha ityarthaḥ| na ca ghaṭo bhavatītyatra utpattyanukūlo vyāpāro bhūdhātvarthaḥ| tatra vyāpārasya ghaṭavṛttitvaṃ, phalasya tūtpattyātmakasya kālikasaṃbandhena kālavṛttitvamiti kṛtvā svārthaphalavyadhikaraṇavyāpāravācakatvādakarmake bhūprabhṛtau sakarmakalakṣaṇātivyāptiriti śaṅkyam| phalatāvacchedakasaṃbandheneti niveśanāt| tathā ca phalatāvacchedako yaḥ saṃbandhaḥ, tena saṃbandhena kiṃcidyatphalādhikaraṇaṃ tadapekṣayā yadbhinnaṃ tad‌vṛttitvaṃ vyāpārasya vivakṣitamityarthaḥ| evaṃ ca ghaṭo bhavatītyādau bhūprabhṛtervyāpārasya kālikasaṃbandhena phalādhikaraṇakālāpekṣayā bhinno yo ghaṭastad‌vṛttitve'pi phalatāvacchedakasamavāyasaṃbandhena yadutpattirūpaphalādhikaraṇaṃ ghaṭastad‌vṛttitvena phalavyadhikaraṇatvābhāvānnātivyāptiriti bhāvaḥ| nanu jīvatītyāditaḥ prāṇān dhārayatīti saṃpratyayātprāṇadhāraṇānukūlo vyāpāro jīvaterarthaḥ| tatra vyāpāro devadattādiniṣṭhaḥ| dhāraṇātmakaṃ phalaṃ ca prāṇaniṣṭham| dhāraṇaṃ samavasthāpanam| tathā ca svārthaphalavyadhikaraṇavyāpāravācakatvājjīvatyādāvakarmake'tiprasaṅga iti cetsvārthaphale dhātvarthāmaviṣṭāśrayakatvaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ deyam| dhātvarthāpraviṣṭāśrayakasvārthaphaletyādi lakṣaṇam| dhātvarthe'praviṣṭo'nantarbhūta āśrayo yasya phalasyeti tadarthaḥ| tathā cātra dhāraṇātmakadhātvarthaphalāśrayasya prāṇasya dhātvarthe'ntarbhūtatvānnātiprasaṅga iti bhāvaḥ| evamavivakṣitakarmakatvābhāvavattvamapi svārthe viśeṣaṇaṃ deyam|
vivigamanāvirahātprakārāntareṇa sakarmakatvaṃ lakṣayatisvārthavyāpāretyādi| svārthaḥdhātvarthaḥ, dhātuvācya ityarthaḥ| etādṛśo yo vyāpārastad‌vyadhikaraṇaṃ yatphalaṃ tadvācakatvaṃ sakarmakatvamityarthaḥ| vyāpāravyadhikaraṇatvaṃ ca vyāpārānadhikaraṇavṛttitvaṃ vodhyam| dhātuvācyo yaḥ phūtkārādivyāpārastadadhikaraṇaṃ devadattādi, tadanadhikaraṇaṃ yattaṇḍulādi, tad‌vṛttiviklittyādiphalavācakatvātpacyādau lakṣaṇasamanvayaḥ| phalatāvacchedakasaṃbandhaniveśanādi pūrvavadvodhyam|
asaṃbhavīti| niruktaṃ siddhāntasaṃmataṃ sakarmakatvamanyathānupapannamiti dhātorvyāpārarūpabhāvanāvācakatvamavaśyamaṅgīkaraṇīyamiti bhāvaḥ| prakārāntareṇa sakarmakatvasya vyavasthitatvamāśaṅkya pratyācaṣṭeanyatamatvaṃ tattvamityādinā| sakarmakatvenābhimatā yāvanto dhātavastān pratyekaṃ prātisvikarūpeṇa parigaṇayya tāvatsamudāyaghaṭakatvarūpamanyatamatvaṃ tadeva ca tattvaṃ sakarmakatvamiti ata eveti| kṛño ynamātrārthakatvasyāniṣṭatvādavetyarthaḥ| nanu tarhi kṛñaḥ kīdṛśārthakatvamiṣyate tadāhakiṃ tūtpādanamiti| utpādanapadasyotpattyanukūlayatnādyarthakatvenotpattirūpaphalasahitaṃ yatnādi ityādinā| yasmātkṛño vyāpārasthānikayatnamātramartho na, kiṃtūtpattyanukūlayatnādirevetyata ityarthaḥ| karmavatsyāditi| tathā ca phalasyotpattirūpasya karmasthatayā karmavatkarmaṇeti yatra karmamātravṛtti phalaṃ sa karmasthakriyakaḥ| yathā pacati bhinattītyādau| na hi viklittidvidhābhavanādikaṃ kathamapi kartṛgataṃ bhavatīti| yatra tu kartṛkarmobhayavṛtti phalaṃ bhavati sa atiprasaṅgamudbhāvya nirākartuṃ bhūmikāmāracayatievamiti| svārthaphalavyadhikaraṇetyādereva sakarmakatvavyavahāraprayojakatayā siddhāntasaṃmatatvena kriyate dhaṭaḥ svayamevetyatra karmavadbhāvasiddhyarthaṃ karoterutpattirūpaphalasahitayatnavācitvāṅgīkāre ityarthaḥ| kṛñāderiti| ādipadena pacyādisaṃgrahaḥ| jānātītyāderapīti| ādipadena gamyādeḥ saṃgrahaḥ| viṣayāvacchinnāvaraṇabhaṅgādiphaleti avacchedakatāsaṃbandhena viṣayaniṣṭhāvaraṇabhaṅgarūpaphaletyarthaḥ| āvaraṇabhaṅgādītyādipadena saṃyogādigrahaṇam| anyatheti| uktavaiparītye| āvaraṇabhaṅgādiphalāvācakatve, ityarthaḥ| anāpatteriti| svārthaphalavyadhikaraṇetyādeḥ sakarmarakatvavyavahāraprayojakasya tatrāvidyamānatvādityarthaḥ| tathāceti| āvaraṇabhaṅgādiphalavācakatve satītyarthaḥ| kiṃ na syāditi| kriyate ghaṭaḥ svayamevetyatra yathā ghaṭa utpattirūpaphalāśrayastathā''varaṇabhaṅgarūpaphalāśrayo'pi bhavatītyato jñāyate ghaṭaḥ svayameveti kiṃ na syādityarthaḥ| tathā ca svārthaphaletyādirūpaṃ sakarmakatvaṃ siddhāntasaṃmatamapi svīkartumayogyaṃ bhavatīti gūḍhābhiprāyaḥ| kiṃ ca gamyate grāmaḥ svayamevetyādiprayogāpattirūpo doṣo'pītyāśaṅkyā''ha
nirvartye cetyādi| nanu nirvartyavikāryakarmaṇoḥ karmavadbhāvo bhavati na prāpyakarmaṇītyatra kiṃ bījamityata āhasiddhānto'treti| karmavatkarmaṇeti sūtre bhāṣya ityarthaḥ| tatra hi dhātorekāca ityato yaddhātukarmaṇi prāyaḥ kriyākṛtaviśeṣo naivopalabyate taddhātukarmaprāpyaṃ karmeti phalitam| vakṣyata iti| kriyākṛtaviśeṣāṇāmityādivākyapadīyenetyarthaḥ| karmasthaviśepotpādakakriyārthakatvarūpaṃ tādṛśaṃ karma nirvartyaṃ vikāryaṃ vā bhavati| ghaṭaṃ karotītyādau svarūpalābhātmako viśeṣaḥ| somaṃ sunotītyādau tu cūrṇībhāvarūpo viśeṣa iti jñeyam| yatra tu karmadarśanena karmabhagataḥ kriyākṛtaviśeṣaḥ kaścidapi naivāvagantuṃ śakyastatprāpyaṃ karmeti ata uktaṃkenacidadṛṣṭaḥ, kenacidgata iti karmadarśanena jñātuṃ sarvathā'śakyamiti| tadevamatretthamanvayavyatirekaprayogaḥyatra gameḥ parigrahaḥ| tathā ca dṛśadhātvarthanirūpitaghaṭarūpakarmaṇaḥ, gamadhātvarthanirūpitagrāmātprakakarmaṇaśca prāpyakarmatvādityarthaḥ| noktātiprasaṅga iti| na karmavadbhāvāpattiriti bhāvaḥ| dhātoḥ phalavācakatvasādhakamanyeṣāṃ yuktyantaramāhadhātunāmiti| phalāvācakatve dhātūnāṃ kevalavyāpāravācakatā paryavasyati| saṃyogarūpaphalabhāne gamadhātoḥ, vibhāgarūpaphalabhāne ca tyajadhātoḥ samabhivyāhārasya niyāmakatvācca grāmaṃ gaclatītyatra na vibāgabodhaprasaṅgaḥ| nāpi vṛkṣaṃ tyajatītyatra saṃyogabodhātiprasaṅgaśca| tyajigamyoriti| tādṛśārthakayāvaddhātūpalakṣaṇam| paryāyatāpattiḥ, evaṃ samanantaroktayuktibhiḥ phalavyāpārayorvācyatve sādhita `tiṅ‌pratyayavācyaiva bhāvanā' iti maṇḍanamiśrānuyāyimatamāśaṅkya nirākartuṃ bhūmikāmāracayatievaṃ sidhyatvityādinā| vācyatvamiti| uktayuktibhirvyāpārasya tiṅantajanyabodhaviṣayatve siddhe'pi dhātuvācyatve'nirmayaḥ, pacatītyatra prakṛtipratyayayordvayoḥ krameṇa pākaṃ karotīti padadvayena vivaraṇadarśanādbhāvanāyāstiṅ‌vācyatvasyāpi vaktuṃ śakyatvāditi bhāvaḥ| na dhātoriti| pacatītyataḥ pākānukūlā bhāvanetyevaṃ prādhānyena pratīyamānavyāpārasya pratyayārthasya prādhānyamiti niyamādākhyāta(tiṅa)vācyatvasyaiva vaktumucitatvena dhātuvācyatvaṃ naiva vaktuṃ śakyamityarthaḥ| pratyayārthasya prādhānyamiti niyamasya tiṅupāttasaṃkhyāyāstadupāttakartari viśeṣaṇatayā'nvayātsaṃkhyādau vyabhicaritatvādāhatadāgame hīti| paśunā yajetetyatraikavacanopāttaikatvasya karaṇatvena na kriyāyāmanvayaḥ, kiṃtu prakṛtyarthe, `pratyayānāṃ prakṛtyarthānvitasvārthabodhakatvamiti vyutpatteriti svīkāre ekatvasya yāgāṅgatvābhāvāttadabhāve'pi yāgāvaiguṇyāttadavivakṣitameva syāditi pūrvapakṣe prāpte`tadarthastuśabdavatśabdavācyaṃ yathā bhavati tathopalakṣyate ekatvaṃ, hiyataḥ'tadāgameekavacanaśravaṇe dṛśyate'tastasyāṅgatvajñānaṃ, yathā'nyeṣāṃ viśeṣaṇānāṃ paśulauhityādīnāmiti| tathā ca viśiṣṭasya śrutyā'ṅgatvabodhanena paśuvācitvavacchabdabodhyasyāsya viśeṣaṇasyāṅgatvopapattiriti bhāvaḥ| evaṃ ca tatra yathā ekavacanāgame ekatvaṃ dṛśyate'tastadarthatvamevaṃ pacatītyādāvākhyātaśravaṇe sati vyāpārabodhāttasya tadarthatvamevāṅgīkāryamanyathoktanyāyavirodāpatteriti bhāvaḥ|

vyāpārastad‌vyadhikaraṇaṃ yatphalaṃ tadvācakatvaṃ sakarmakadhātutvamityarthaḥ| nanu phalasamānādhikaraṇavyāpāravācakabhavatītyādeḥ ṇvul‌tṛjātīnāmiva ghañāderapi kartṛvācitvaprāptau tadbādhanārthaṃ `bhāve' iti vidhāyakānuśāsanamapīti bhāvaḥ| gauravamityantena granthena tasmādityanena sūcito'bhiprāyasthahetusamudāyaḥ spaṣṭīkṛtaḥ| dūṣayatidūṣaṇodbhāvanena pratyācaṣṭena tvasāvityādinā| asau kṛdhātusthiṅāṃ vyākhyānaṃvivaraṇaṃ na bhavatītyarthaḥ| tadvivaraṇaṃ tu karotītyetad‌ghaṭakastipratyaya ityāśayaḥ| kṛdhātostiṅ‌vivaraṇatvābhāve hetumāhapakvavānityādāviti| siddhānte hi pakvavānityatra pac‌dhātvartho na karmakārakaṃ kiṃtu kriyārūpa eva| karma tu taṇḍulaḥ| prakṛtipratyayārthayoḥ pratyayārthasyaiva
