dhātupadārthajñānāsaṃbhavāttadanyatamatvarūpadhātutvasya suraguruṇā'pi jñātumaśakyatvāt| ata evābhiprāyādāhaastu yathākaramiti| vyāpārasaṃtāna iti| yathā cullyadhiśrayaṇamārabya cullydhaḥśrayaṇaparyanto vyāpārasamūhaḥ kriyetipadavācya ityarthaḥ| evaṃ bhvādiṣu sarvatra dhātuṣu kriyāpadavācyo vyāpārasamūha ūhyaḥ| phalavyāpārayordhāturityuktatvāt| tādṛśakriyāvācakatve sati bhvaudigaṇapaṭhitatvamityeva bhāṣyānasāri dhātutvalakṣaṇamastitvatyarthaḥ| bhūvādaya iti sūtrārthaviṣaye śaṅkatenanu sattādīniti| sattāviklittyādayo ye phalāṃśāstadanyatamavācakatve sati gaṇapaṭhitatvaṃ dhātutvamityarthaḥ| lakṣaṇamiti| bhūvādaya iti sūtrajavākyārthaṃrūpamityarthaḥ| sattādiphalavācakatvena vāśabdasādṛśyaṃ gṛhyate, na kriyāvācakatveneti tātparyam| phalāṃśānyatamavācakatvetyupādāne sūtravaiyarthyaśaṅkā'pi nodetīti bhāvaḥ| nanu kriyāvacano dhāturiti bhāṣyavyavahāraḥ kathaṃ saṃgamanīyaḥ? phalāṃśasya kriyātvābhāvādata āhadhātvarthatvāditi| yatkiṃcinniṣṭhavyāpārātmakakriyājanyaphalavācitvāddhātvarthaphalasyāpi gauṇaḥ kriyātvavyavahāra iti cennaitadbhadramityāhaanyatamamadhya ityādinā| vikalpārthakasya vikalpayatīti prayogasya darśanādvikalpasyāpyanya tamamadhye praveśāvaśyakatvena gaṇapaṭhitavāśabdasādṛśyādvikalpārthakavetyavyavasyāpi bhvādigaṇe praveśāvaśyakatvena tatra dhātutvātivyāpterduruddharatvāditi bhāvaḥ|| 11 ||
śaṅkatenanviti asyaiveti| bhvādigaṇapaṭhitatve sati kriyāvācakatvasyaiva dhātutve ityarthaḥ| evakāreṇa phalamātravācakatvasya vyāvṛttiḥ| kriyāpratītyabhāvāditi| asti bhavati vidyate ityāditaḥ sattārūpaphalasyaiva pratītirjāyate, na tu tadatiriktāyā vyāpārarūpakriyāyāḥ| ata eva kiṃ karotīti kriyāpraśne pacatītyuttaravadastītyuttaraṃ na, astītyataḥ kriyāpratītyabhāvādityarthaḥ| adhātutvaprasaṅga iti| astyādīnāṃ kriyāvācakatvābhāvāddhātutvaṃ na syādityarthaḥ| tataśca laḍādirna syādata āhaastyādāviti| dharmibhāgesattādirūpe dharmiṇo bhāga ityarthaḥ| sattādiphalarūpadharmaghaṭito'rtho dharmī| dharmī ca sakarmakasthale karmapadārthastaṇḍulādiḥ| akarmakasthale tu phalasya kartṛniṣṭhatvātkartṛpadārtho devadattādireva dharmī bodhyaḥ| vastusad bhāvyaṃ bhāvanāpratītijanakaṃ na bhavatītyata āhabhāvyatveneti| bhāvanārūpavyāpāraniṣpadyatvenetyarthaḥ| vivakṣita iti| vaktumiṣṭatva ityarthaḥ| phalaniṣpādakavyāpārasya jijñāsitatva iti phalito'rthaḥ| tadeva jijñāsāsthalaṃ pradarśayitumāhasa tato gato na veti gamidātorgatyarthākarmaketi kartari ktaḥ| vibhāgānukūlo vyāpāro'tra gamidhātvarthatatpradeśāvidhikavibāgānukūlavyāpāravānna veti saṃpratyayāt| tathā cātra praśne patīyamānāṃ vyāpāraviṣayakajijñāsāṃ sattānukūlavyāpārakathanadvārā nivartayitumuttaramāhamahatā yatnenāstīti| pratīyata eveti| atra yatnapadopādānādyatnajanyā satteti kathanādas dhātoḥ sattānukūlo vyāpāro'rthaḥ pratīyata evetyarthaḥ| na ga ityarthaparyavasānājjijñāsānivṛttirbhavatītyastītyasya praśrottaratvaṃ ca| sutarāmiti| utpattyādyarthavivakṣāyāmastyādīnāṃ vyāpāravācakatvadhrauvyamiti śeṣaḥ| utpattyanukūlavyāpārapratītestatra sarvānubhavasiddhatvāt| sattārthakatve kvacideva vyāpārapratītiḥ, utpattyādyarthakatve tu sarvatraiva vyāpārapratītiriti bodhanāya sutarāmiti ratabantoktiḥ| utpattyādītyādipadena parābhavatītyatra parābhavasya saṃgrahaḥ| astyāderutpattyarthakatve rāmāyaṇaprayogaṃ pramāmayatirohitaoo iti| āsīt, abhavat, ityanayorudapadyatetyarthaḥ| sattārthakatve'nubhavavirodhaḥ| vaṃśāvalyāmutpattyarthasyaivānubhavasiddhatvāditi bhāvaḥ| astyādeḥ sattāsamānādhikaraṇavyāpāravācakatve pramāṇāntaramapyāhakiṃ ceti| laḍādivyavasthā na syāditi| astyādervyāpārāvācakatve vartamāne laṭ, bhūte luṅ, bhaviṣyati lṛṅ, ityevaṃ laḍādervyavasthā na syādityarthaḥ| vartamānādikālavṛttitvena vivakṣāyāṃ vartamāne laḍityādinā laḍādividhānādityarthaḥ| vartamānatvādīnāṃ kālagatatvena sarvānubhavasiddhatvādvartamānādiśabdāḥ kālaviśeṣabodhakāḥ| tasyā evetyevakāreṇa phalaṃ vyāvartyate| phale vartamānatvādyananvayasya prāgupapādanīditi bhāvaḥ| tatraiva mānamāhakriyābhedāyetyādi| bhedāyeti caturthī tādarthye, tumarthāditi vā bodhyā| vartamānatvādiviśiṣṭakriyāyā itarakriyāto vyāvartanāya laḍādibodhyaḥ kāla ityarthaḥ| kriyābhedāyetyasya sarvaṃ vākyamiti nyāyena sāvadhāraṇatvāllaḍādibodhyaḥ kālaḥ kriyāyā eva bhedakaḥ| ataḥ kriyāyāmeva kālānvayaḥ| saptiṅarthasaṃkhyā tu sarvasya = ākhyātapratipadikārthasya bhediketi vākyapadīyārthaḥ| bhūvādisūtre bhāṣye'pyuktaṃnāntareṇa kriyāṃ bhūtabhaviṣyadvartamānāḥ kālā vyajyante| astyādibhiścāpi bhūtabhaviṣyadvartamānakālā vyajyante' iti| asti, abhūt, bhaviṣyatīti kālaviśeṣāvagamāditi bhāvaḥ| tasmādyadyatra kriyā na syāttarhi laḍādikamapi na syāditi bodhyam| tathā ca bhāṣyakārādyanubhava evāstyādīnāṃ vyāpāravācakatve pramāṇamityāśayaḥ| anyatrāśeṣabhāvādityuttarārdhamavatārayituṃ śaṅkatenanviti| evamiti| dhātorvyāpāravācakatve satītyarthaḥ aśeṣabhāvāditi| śeṣabhāvaḥpṛthagbhāvaḥ| bhinnādikaraṇaniṣṭhatvaṃ, tadabhāva ekādhikaraṇaniṣṭatvaṃ tasmāt, bhāvanāphalayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyādityarthaḥ| sā vyāpārarūpā bhāvanā| tathāspaṣṭaṃ na prakāśate| tatspaṣṭatva iti| bhāvanāyāḥ spaṣṭaṃ pratibhāna ityarthaḥ| doṣa iti| tathā ca dūratvādikamiva phalabhāvanayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ vyāpārarūpabhāvanāyāḥ svaṣṭapratītā pratibandhakamityarthaḥ| praśna iti| vyāpāraviśeṣaviṣayakapraśna ityarthaḥ| pacatītyuttaravaditi| pacidhātorvyāpāraviśeṣavācitvasya suprasiddhatvāttasya praśnottaratvaṃ yujyata ityarthaḥ| uttaramapi syāditi| astyādīnāṃ vyāpāravācitve'pi astītyasyottaratvaṃ neṣyate, vyāpārasāmānyavācitvāttasya, kimuta vyāpārāvācakatva iti śaṅkakāśayaḥ| siddhāntī vyāpārasāmānyavācitve'pi tasyotaratvamiṣṭamevetyāhaiṣṭāpatteriti| tadeveṣṭāpattisthalaṃ darśayatiāsannavināśamityārabhyottarasya sarvasamatatvādityantena| tathā cāstyādīnāṃ vyāpāravācakatvamavaśyakamiti bhāvaḥ| itaratraāsannavināśabhinne| susthatayā niścita iti| sattānukūlavyāpāraniścaye sati kiṃ karotīti praśno'nyāviṣayaka evetyavadhāraṇāttatrāstītyuttaraṃ netyarthaḥ|| 12 ||
śaṅkatenanviti| evamiti| asyādyakarmakāṇāṃ vyāpārarūpabhāvanāvācakatve, ityarthaḥ| phalaniyatatvāditi| phalānukūlavyāpārasyaika bhāvanāśabdavācyatvāphalasya bhāvanāśabdārthakukṣipraviṣṭatvena bhāvanāyāḥ phalaniyatatvagityarthaḥ| karmatvāditi| prakṛtadhātūpāttapradhānabhūtavyāpāraprayojyaphalāśrayasyetyarthaḥ| kriyāvācakatva iti| akarpakāṇāmapi phalānukūlavyāpāravācakatva ityarthaḥ| sarveṣāṃsakarmakākarmakobhayeṣāṃ phalānukūlavyāpāravācakapacyādivatsakarmakatvāpattirityāśaṅkāṃ manasikṛtyā''haphalavyāpārayoriti| nanu phalavyāpārayorekavṛttitvasyākarmakatāniyāmakatve grāmaṃ gacchati, vṛkṣaṃ tyajītyatra vyāpāravattajjanyasaṃyogavibhāgarūpaphalasyāpi kartṛvṛttitvena phalavyāpārayorakaniṣṭhatvād‌gamyādīnāmapyakarmakatvāpattirityanusaṃdhāyā''haekamātraniṣṭhātāyāmti| eketarāvṛttitve sati ekavṛttitvamekamātraniṣṭhatvamityarthaḥ| ekamātretyasya prakṛtopayuktaṃ phalitārthamāhabhinnādhikaraṇeti| phalavyāpārayorbhinnādhikaraṇavṛttitvābhāve, iti yāvat| mātraśabdāntarbhāvasya phalapāhatena gamyādāviti| nātivyāptiriti| gamyāderakarmakatvavyavahāro netyarthaḥ| uktalakṣaṇalakṣitamakarmakadhātuṃ darśayatiyathā bhvādiriti| dharmibhede, iti| phalavyāpārau dharmau, tadāśrayabhūtau padārthau dharmiṇo, tayorbhede phalavyāpārāśrayayoḥ pṛthakteve dhātuḥ sakarmaka ityarthaḥ| phalavyāpārayorāśrayabhedaḥ sakarmakatvavyavahāraprayojaka iti bhāvaḥ| tena saṃyogatadanukūlavyāpārayorāśrayaikye'pi gamyādau nāvyāptiḥ| as dhātoḥ phalānukūlavyāpāravācitve vākyapadīyaṃ pramāṇayatiātmānamātmaneti| ātmānasattām| ātmanāsvena| bibhratsattānukūlavyāpāravān bhavannastīti vyapadiśvatevyavahriyate| tathā ca`ḍubhṛñ dhāraṇapoṣaṇayoḥ' iti pāṇinismaraṇātsvadhāraṇānukūlo vyāpāro'stītyatrāpyavagamyate| svatvaṃ cātra sattaiva| mriyatau sattātyāgānukūlavyāpārasyevātra tadvaiparītyena sattādhāraṇānūkūlavyāpārasya spaṣṭaṃ pratipatteriti bhāvaḥ| nanvevamasteḥ sakarmakatvaṃ syādityāśaṅkya tannirākarotitena karmaṇeti| svadhāraṇarūpaphalāśrayabhūtena karmaṇā'steḥ sakarmakatvaṃ na vaktavyamityarthaḥ| tatra hetumāhaphalāṃśeneti| svadhāraṇātmakaphalatadanukūlavyāpārayorekakartṛmātraniṣṭhatvādityarthaḥ| nanvevamātmānaṃ jānāti, icchatītyādau jñānecchādirūpaphalasyaikakartṛmātraniṣṭhatvena sakarmakatvānupapattimāśaṅkya nirākartumāhadvāvātmānāvityādinā| ayaṃ bhāvaḥātmana ekatve'pyātmabhedaḥ kalpyate| ekaḥ śarīrāvacchinno'parastvantaḥkaraṇāvacchinna iti| tayoḥ karmatvakartṛtve darśayatitatrāntarātmetyādinā| antarātmāantaḥkaraṇāvacchinnaḥ kartā vyāpārāśraya ityarthaḥ| śarīrātmāśarīrāvacchinnaḥ karmaphalāśraya ityarthaḥ| evaṃ caupādhikabhedamādāya phalavyāpārayorbhinnādhikaraṇaniṣṭhatvākṣaterna sakarmakatvānupapattirnāpyakarmakatvāpattiśceti bodhyam| evaṃ `ātmānamātmanā hanti sṛjatyātmāmānamātmanā' ityatrāpyaupādhikabhedasattvānna sakarmakākarmakalakṣaṇāvyāptyativyāptī iti draṣṭavyam| avedamavadheyam| evaṃ hi jīvatinṛtyatītyādeḥ sakarmakatvāpattiḥ| prāṇadhāraṇagātravikṣepādirūpaphalasya tadanukūlavyāpāravyadhikaraṇatvasattvāt| dhāraṇasya prāṇaniṣṭhatvādvikṣepasya gātraniṣṭhatvāvdyāpārasya ca tadbhinnadevadattaniṣṭhatvātphalasya vyāpāravyadhikaraṇatvādityarthaḥ| tasmātphalāśrayāvācakatve sati phalavyadhikaraṇavyāpāravācakatvamityevaṃ sakarmakatvalakṣaṇaṃ vācyam| tataśca jīvatyādeḥ phalavyadhikaraṇavyāpāravācakatve'pi `jīvaprāṇadhāraṇe' nṛtī gātravikṣepe' sraṃsu dhvaṃsu adhaḥpatane' ityanuśāsanātphalāśrayāṇāṃ prāṇagātrādhaḥpradeśānāmapi vācakatvena phalāśrayāvācakatvābhāvānna sakarmakatvamiti| ata evāsteḥ svadhāraṇānukūlavyāpārārthakatve'pi svarūpaphalāśrayavācakatvānna sakarmakatvamiti jñaiyam|| 13 ||
vyāpārasya dhātuvācyatve śaṅkatenanviti| asattvabhūteti| kriyāntarākāṅkṣānutthāpakatāvacchedakavaijātyarūpasādhyatvena vyāpārarūpakriyāyā dhātuta upasthitau satyāmityarthaḥ| pāka iti| ityādighañantasthale'pītyarthaḥ| tatpratyayeti| tena sādhyatvarūpeṇa pratītyāpattirityarthaḥ| nanu ghañante tathā pratītiriṣṭaiveti cedāhana ceṣṭāpattiriti| aniṣṭhāpattau hetumāhakṛdabhihiteti| kṛtpratyayavācyo bhāvodhātvartho, dravyavatdravyadharmeṇa kriyāntarākāṅkṣotthāpakatāvacchedakavaijātyarūpasiddhatvarūpeṇa tulyaṃ prakāśate bhāsate, ityarthaḥ| bhāṣyavirodhāditi| niruktabhāṣyādbhāvārthakakṛdantālliṅgasaṃkhaayādyanvayitvarūpasiddhatvenaiva kriyāyāḥ pratīterlābhādityāśaṅkyā''ākhyātaśabda iti| ākhyātaśabda ityasya vivaraṇamāhapaśya mṛga ityādi| tathā cā''khyātaśabda iti bahuvrīhiḥ| sa cāpi ākhyātarūpau śabdau yasminnityākhyātaśabdayordvivacanāntayorbodhyaḥ| bhāgāmyāmityasya tiṅantābhyāmiti vivaraṇadarśanāt| vākyaṃ cānyapadārthaḥ| tatraiva tiṅantadvayasaṃbhavāt| ata eva lāghave'pi na karmadhāraya iti sūcitam| evaṃ cā''khyātaśabde ityasyatiṅantasamudāye ityarthaḥ| apavyākhyānamiti| ākhyātaśabde karmadhārayaṃ svīkṛtya bhāgābhyāmityasya prakṛtipratyayarūpabhāgābhyāmiti vyākhyānamaśuddham| bhāgadvayasattvāditi| pacatītyatrāpi prakṛtipratyayarūpabhāgadvayasattvādityarthaḥ| tathā ca pāka ityatreva pacatītyatra siddhāvasthāpannatvena kriyāpratītyāpatterbhāgadvayasya kriyāvācakatvābhāvena dṛṣṭāntāsaṃgatyāpatteśceti bhāvaḥ| anye tu sādhyatvasādhanatvābhyāṃ pratītimātre'yaṃ dṛṣṭāntaḥ| yathā pacatītyatra tiṅante dhāturūpaprakṛtya sādhyatvena svārtho bodhyate, sādhanatvarūpasvārthastiṅā, tathā pāka ityatra dhātunā sādhyatvena kriyā pratyāyyate, pratyayena siddhatvarūpeṇetyarthaḥ| idameva vyākhyānaṃ helārājīye dṛśyata ityāhuḥ| sādhyasādhanarūpateti| yathākramaṃ paśyabhāgena sādhyarūpatā, dhāvatibhāgena sādhanarūpatā yathā śāstre prakalpitetyarthaḥ| tatra sādhyatvamāhakriyāntarākāṅkṣānutthāpaketyādi| sādhanatvaṃ tukārakatvenānvayitvamiti| ayaṃ bhāvaḥpaśyetyatra kriyāyāḥ sādhyatvaṃ svasmin kārakāṇāmanvayaḥ svasya vā kārakatvenānyatrānvayitvābhāvaḥ| dhāvatītyasyāḥ sādhanatvaṃ tu kārakatvenānyasminsvasyānvayaḥ| itthaṃ pacati bhavatītyatrāpyekakartṛkā vartamānā yā pacikriyā ekatatkartṛkā vartamānā bhavanakriyetibodāttatrāpyūhyam| evaṃ ca paśya mṛgo dhāvatītyādau ekamṛgābhinnāśrayikā yā vartamānā dhāvanakriyā tadviṣayakaṃ yadiṣṭasādhanībhūtaṃ darśanaṃ tadanukūlā bhāvaneti bodha iti| nanu ākhyātavācyakriyāyāḥ kartṛtvakarmatvasvīkāre kārakatvenānyatrānanvayitvarūpaṃ tasyā asattvarūpatvaṃ bhajyeteticenna| `kriyā na yujyate liṅgakriyānādhārakārakaiḥ| asattvarūpatā tasyā iyamevāvadhāryatām|| liṅgaṃ ca kriyānādhārakāṇi ca taiḥ kriyā na yujyate, iti haryukteḥ kartṛtvakarmatvetarakārakatvavyāpyarūpeṇānanvayitvamasattvarūpatvamityarthasya lābhena tiṅantopasthitakriyāyāḥ kartṛtvakarmatvasvīkāre'pi asattvarūpatvabhaṅgābhāvādityarthaḥ| sa ghañādiṣviti| pāka ityādau prakṛtyā sādhyāvasthāpannā pratyayena tu sādhanāvasthāpannā kriyā pratīyata ityarthaḥ| nanu dhāvatī paśyetyatra kriyayorliṅgasaṃkhyānanvayitvena ṣāka ityatra ca liṅgasaṃkhyānvayitvenobhayatra sāmyābhāvātkathaṃ dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikatvamityata āhaiyān paramiti| ghañādyupasthāpyeti| kriyetyarthaḥ| naivamiti| yādṛśī ghañādyupasthāpyā kriyā tādṛśī tiṅantopasthāpyā kriyā na bhavatītyarthaḥ| tathā ca vaiṣamyād‌dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikabhāvo nopapadyata iti bhāvaḥ| dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikabhāve hi sarvāṃśena sābhyamapekṣitamityevaṃ naiva niyamaḥ| anyathā candramukhādyorapi sarvāṃśena sāmyābhāvātsana syāt| kiṃ ca sarvāṃśena sāmye dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikabhāvavilaya eva| na hi bhavati ghaṭa iva ghaṭaḥ paṭa iva paṭa iti| api tu kiṃcidaṃśanaiva sāmyamapekṣyate, tacca prakṛtasthale'pyastītyāhatathā'pīti| tiṅantopasthāpyā kriyā yathā kārakatvenānyatrānveti tathā ghañādyupasthāpyā'pyanyatra kārakatvenānvetīti kārakatvenānvayitvadharmeṇa dṛṣṭhāntadārṣṭāntikabhāvo'vadheyaḥ| nanu pāka ityādau prakṛtibhūtadhātutaḥ sādhyatvarūpeṇa kriyāpratītau kiṃ pramāṇamata āhaodanasya pāka itīti| karmaṣaṣṭhyā mānatvāditi| ghañ‌prakṛtidhātunā ghañeva siddhāvasthāyā eva kriyāyā abhidhāne kārakāṇāṃ sādhyatvena pratīyamānārtha evānvayaniyamādodanasyākārakatvena tavdyāpyakarmasaṃjñāyā asaṃbhavātkartṛkarmaṇoriti ṣaṣṭhyanupapattereva ghañ‌prakṛtibhūtadhātoḥ sādhyāvasthāpannakriyāvācakatve pramāṇatvādityāśayaḥ| ṣaṣṭhīmupapādayitumāśaṅkatena cādhyāhṛtoti| adhyāhatāstīti tiṅantopasthāpyasādhyāvasthakriyāyāḥ pākena pākasya caudaneneti paramparayā'nvayātṣaṣṭhī syādityarthaḥ| tathā ca ghañante dhātutaḥ sādhyāvasthākriyāyā apratītāvapyupapadyamānayā ṣaṣṭhyā tādṛśadhātoḥ sādhyāvasthakriyāvācakatvaṃ kalpayituṃ na yujyata iti cennetyāhakṛdantena yoga eveti| kṛtpratyayaprakṛtibhūtadhātūpasthāpyākreyānirūpitakartṛkarmavācakādeva kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛtītyanena ṣaṣṭhīvidhānādityarthaḥ| tathā ca kṛtpratyayaprakṛtibhūtadhātoḥ sādhyāvastakriyāvācakatvamantarā sā karmaṣaṣṭhī durlabheti bhāvaḥ| nanvadhyāhṛtatiṅantopasthitasādhyāvasthakriyayā kṛdantasya yogo'stīti tādṛśakriyādvārakaḥ kṛdantayogo'pyastīti na karmaṣaṣṭhyanupapattirityāśayenā''hana lokāvyayeti| niṣedhācceti| adhyāhṛtalādeśaprakṛtibhūtadātūpastāpyakriyānvaye ṣaṣṭhīniṣedhāccetyarthaḥ| `kṛdyogā ca ṣaṣṭhī samasyate' iti vacanavihita odanapāka iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāso'pi kṛdyogaṣaṣṭhyasaṃbhavānna syātpaṣṭhyantasyottarapadārthe'nanvayena sāmarthyābhāvāccetyapi bodhyam| na ca śeṣalakṣaṇaṣaṣṭhyaiva vākyaṃ samāsaścāstviti śaṅkyam| nalapākaḥ śuṇṭhīpāka ityādau nalādikartṛtvādiprakārakabodhasya savānubhavasiddhasya vilayāpattoḥ| tasmātkarmaṣaṣṭhyanupapattireva kṛdantasthale dhātoḥ sādhyāvastāpannakriyārthakatve pramāṇamiti yāvat| nanu bhāvārthakakṛtpratyayaprakṛtibhūtadhātoḥ sādhyāvasthāpannakriyāvācakatve tannirūpitakarmatvasyeva karaṇatvasyāpi saṃbhavātkāṣṭhaiḥ pāka ityapi syādityāśaṅkyeṣṭamevaitaditi pariharannāhaevaṃ rītyetyādīṣṭamevetyantam| tiṅ‌pratyayenaiva sādhyāvasthaāpannatvena vyāpārarūpabhāvanā'bidhīyate, iti manvānā mīmāṃsakāḥ `kāṣṭhaiḥ pākaḥ' iti prayogamaneṣṭamāmananti| evamiti| yathaidanasya karmatāsiddhyarthaṃ pāka ityatra sādhyāvasthāpannavyāpāpāro dhātunocyate tathā phalāṃśo'pi dhātunā sādhyāvasthāpanna evocyata ityarthaḥ| sādhyāvasthaivāsattvāvasthetyucyate vaiyākaraṇaiḥ| ata eveti| phalasmāpi asattvāvasthāpannatayā dhātunocyamānatvādevetyarthaḥ| stokaṃ pacatītivaditi| viklittarūpaphalasyāpi vyapadeśivadbhāvātphalāśrayatvena karmatvāttatsamānādhikaraṇastokādiśabdebhyo yathā dvitīyā bhavati tathā stokaṃ pāka ityatrāpi dhātvarthaphale sādhyatvenopasthite sāmānādhikaraṇyenānvayātstokamiti dvitīyā bhavatītyarthaḥ| upapadyata iti| phalāṃśasya sattvāvasthāpannatvenopasthitau tu kārakāṇāṃ sādhyatvena pratīyamānārtha evānvayaniyamātsāmānādhikaraṇyenānvaye'pi sādhyatvenopasthitārthe'nvayābhāvātstokaṃ pāka iti nopadyeteti bhāvaḥ| nanvekasyaiva dhātvarthasya vuruddhasādhyatvasiddhatvābhyāṃ kathaṃ bhānamiti cenna| yathā saṃbandhibhedādekasyaiva pitṛtvaṃ putratvaṃ ca tathā ekatraiva kārakaliṅgādirūpasaṃbavdhibhedādubhayoḥ saṃbhavena tayorvirodhābhāvādityarthaḥ| vyāpārānvaye tu stokaḥ pāka ityeva| vyāpārasyākarmatayā tadviśeṣaṇe dvitīyāyā aprāpteḥ| phalānvaye dvitīyāṃ bādhitvā kartṛkarmaṇoriti ṣaṣṭhī tu na śaṅkyā| kartṛsāhacaryeṇa dhātvarthe bhedainānvayikarmaṇa eva tatra grahaṇāditi laghuñjūṣāyāṃ nirūpitatvādityarthaḥ|| 14 ||
etadeveti| ekasyā eva kriyāyāḥ sādhyatvasiddhatvābhṣāṃ bhānamevetyarthaḥ| sādhyatvena kriyeti| tatradhañādyante| pratīyata iti śeṣaḥ| sādhyatvena kriyāpratītau bodakamāhadhāturūpeti| dhāturūpaṃ nibandhanaṃ nimittaṃ yasyā ityarthaḥ| śabdaśaktisvābāvyāddhātuvācyā kriyā(phalavyāpārau)sādhyatvena pratīyata iti yāvat| phalavyāpārobhayoḥ sādhyatvena pratītibodhanāya kriyeti sādhāraṇaśabdena nirdeśaḥ| tāntrikaiḥ phalavyāpārayoḥ kriyāśabdena vyavahriyamāṇatvāt| siddhabhāvastviti| siddhatvena pratītistvityarthaḥ| ghañādīti| ghañādirnivandhanaṃ nimittaṃ yasyetyarthaḥ| ghañādivācyā kriyā(phalavyāpārau)siddhatvena pratīyata ityarthaḥ| ādiśabdena ktvātumun‌ktinnādayo grāhyāḥ| ghañādibhirvyāpāraphalayoḥ siddhatvena bodhane pramāṇābhāvamāśaṅ‌vaya pariharatina cetyādinā mānatvādityantena| pāka ityukta iti| pāka ityādiśravaṇe dhātvarthaghañarthakriyayorabhedānvaye satyapi kartavyo vā nāśanīyo vā tiṣṭhati vā jāyate vā raśyati vetyādijāyamānapākasādhyakriyāntarākāṅkṣāyā eva mānatvādityarthaḥ| dhātūpasthāpyāyāmiti| pacatītyādisthala ityarthaḥ| tadasaṃbhavasyoktatvāditi| pacatītyukte kriyāvagatau punaḥ kriyāntarākāṅkṣāyā ajāyamānatvena kriyāntarākāṅkṣāyā asaṃbhavasyoktatvādityarthaḥ| kriyāntarākāṅkṣānutthāpakatāvacchedakarūpavattvaṃ sādhyatvamityādineti śeṣaḥ| kriyāntarākāṅkṣānutthāpakatāvacchedakarūpeṇopasthite'rthe kriyānvayāsaṃbhavātkriyāntarākāṅkṣāyā asaṃbhava iti bhāvaḥ| anāpatteriti| ghañ‌pratyayena sādhyāvasthāpannāyā eva kriyāprā abhidhāne tasyā liṅgānavayitayā tādṛśadhātvarthaviśeṣaṇavācakastokādiśabdasyāpi puṃstvānupapattyā sāmānye napuṃsakagityasyaivāpatteriti bhāvaḥ| siddhāvasthāpannakriyāyā bodhane tu tādṛśakriyāyā liṅgasaṃkhyādyanvayitayā tatsamānādhikaraṇastokādiśabdasyāpi liṅgasaṃkhyānvayātstokaḥ pākaḥ, ityekatvaṃ puṃstvaṃ copapadyate| etadeva viśadayatitasmāditi| dhātvarthānvaya iti| dhātvarthaphalānvayestokādiśabdebhyo dvitīyā napuṃsakaliṅgatā ca| dhātvarthavyāpārarūpabhāvanāyāmanvaye jyotiṣṭomena bhaktipūrvaṃ yajetetivatprathamāsaṃbhave'pi napuṃsakaliṅgamātram| ghañarthavyāpārānvaye tu vyāpārasya karmatvābhāvena dvitīyāyā aprāpteḥ prātipadikārtheti prathamā puṃliṅgatā ca| ghañarthaphalasya padārthaikadeśatvānna tatra stokādyanvayaḥ| dhātvarthaphalasya padārthaikadeśatve'pi tatretarapadārthānvayo bhavatyeva| anyathā taṇḍulaṃ pacati stokaṃ pacati stokaṃ pāka ityanāpattorityāśayaḥ| ghañādeḥ śaktiriti| liṅgasaṃkhyādyanvayivyāpārārtha, ityarthaḥ| eteneti| ghañādīnāṃ siddhāvasthāpannavyāpāravācakatvāṅgīkāreṇetyarthaḥ| sādhutāmātramiti| mātrapadenārthābhidhāyakatvavyāvṛttyā prayogasādhutvamevetyarthaḥ| apāstaṃkhaṇḍitaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ| nanu siddhāvasthavyāpāre na ghañaḥ śaktirabhyupeyate'pi tu ghañantasya, tathā ca ghañantaśaktyopasthitārthe'nvaye stokaḥ pāka ityupapadyata eveti kātantrapariśiṣṭakārā manyante, tanmatamāśaṅkya pratyācaṣṭena ca ghañanteti| ghañantānupūrvyā iti| siddhāvasthāpannavyāpāre'rthe ghañantarūpasamudāyaśaktau svīkṛtāyāmubhayorānupūrvyāḥ pākatvaṃ yāgatvamityevaṃrītyā nānāśaktatāvacchedakatvāpattyā gauravaṃ bhavatītyato lāghavād `bhāve' ityanuśāsanānurodhācca ghañādereva tādṛśe'rthe śaktimabhyupetya ghañatvādereva śaktatāvacchedakatvāṅgīkārasyocitatvādityarthaḥ| nanu samudāyaśaktirbhavadbhirapyaṅgīkaraṇīyaiva| anyathā'rthavattvābhāvātprātipadikasaṃjñā na syāt| kṛttaddhiteti sūtre'rthavatpadānuvṛtteḥ siddhāntasaṃmatatvāt| pratyayārthasya prakṛtyartha evānvayātsamudāyaśaktyabhāve vibhaktyarthasaṃkhgādyanvayo'pi na syāditi samudāyaśakterāvaśyakatve'pi anuśāsanabalād‌ghaño'pi śaktirāvaśyakyeva| anyathā ṇvulāderapi śaktirna sidhyet| samudāyaśaktyaiva paktetyādau kartrādyarthabodhasaṃbhavāṇṇvulādeḥ svātantryeṇa śaktyabhāva iṣṭa iticenna `kartari kṛt, ityādyanuśātanaviruddhatvāt| janamejayatīti vigrahe ṇyantādejeḥ khaśi khaśaḥ śittvātsārvadātukatve'pi kartrarthakatvābhāvācchabanutpattyā janamejaya ityasiddhayāpatteḥ, khaśo ṅittvena guṇaniṣedhāpatteḥ| tasmād ghañaḥ śaktirabhyupeyaiva| ata eva kṛdabhihitabhāva iti bhāṣyaṃ saṃgacchate iti na tadvirodha ityāśayavānāhaiti dagiti|| 15 ||
nanu yadi kārakāṇāṃ vyāpāra evānvaya iti niyamaḥ syāccettarhyeva odanasyeti karmaṣaṣṭhyanurodhena pāka ityādau dhātorvyāpāravācakatvaṃ sidhyennānyathā, kiṃtu tādṛśe niyama eva kiṃ mānamityāśaṅkyā''nanvityādi| saṃbodhanāntamiti| saṃbodanāntasyeti| saṃbodhanavibhaktyantārthasyetyarthaḥ| yathā arthadvārakaḥ śabdasya viśeṣaṇatvādivyavahārastathā'rthadvārā saṃbodhanāntaśabdasyaiva vā'nvaya ityarthaḥ| kriyāyāmiti| pravartanāviṣaye dhātuvācyavyāpāre'nvaya ityarthaḥ| brūhi devadatteti| iha vibhaktyarthasaṃbodhane devadattarūpaprakṛtyarthanirūpitaṃ viśeṣyatvaṃ, brūhitibhāṣaṇakriyānirūpitaṃ viśeṣaṇatvaṃ ceti siddhāntaḥ| `saṃbodhanapadaṃ yacca tatkriyāya viśeṣaṇam, vrajāni devadatteti nighāto'tra tathā sati' iti vākyapadīyāt| saṃbodhanasya kriyāviśeṣaṇatve hetumāhanighātānurodhāditi| ākhyātaṃ saviśeṣaṇaṃ vākyamiti vākyalakṣaṇe saviśeṣaṇamityasya sākṣātparamparayā ca yadvadviśeṣaṇaṃ tatsahitamityarthaḥ| tenaparamparayetyasyopādānena gabhīrāyāṃ nadyāṃ mīno'stītyasyaikavākyatvaṃ sidhyati| tathā ca devadatteti saṃbodhanapadasya brūhītivacanakriyāyāmanvaye satyevakavākyatvopapattau satyāṃ`āmantritasya ca'iti nighātaḥanudāttaḥ sidhyati nānyatheti bhāvaḥ| nanvekavākyatvābhāve'pi nighātaḥ kuto na sidhyatītyata āhasamānavākya iti| nimittanimittanorekavākyasthatve satītyarthaḥ| devadattasya saṃbodhane, saṃbodhanasya ca kriyāyāmiti devadattasaṃbandhisaṃbodhanaviṣayatvarūpaparamparāsaṃbandhena devadattasya kriyānvayānnimittanimittanorekavākyasthātvamiti bhāvaḥ| evaṃ ca devadattasaṃbandhisaṃbodhanaviṣayastvadabhinnakartṛkaṃ bhāṣaṇamiti tvaṃ brūhi devadattetyasya śābdabodhaḥ| tathā vrajāni devadattatyasmāddevadattasaṃbandhisaṃbodhanaviṣayo matkartṛkaṃ vrajanamiti vodhaḥ| kecittusaṃbodhanavibhaktyantasyānuvādyaviṣayatvādanuvādyasya ca vidheyasākāṅkṣatvādvidheyasya ca kriyārūpatvānnyayasiddho'yaṃ saṃbodhanasya vidheyakriyānvayaniyamarūpo'rthaḥ| taduktaṃ hariṇāsiddhasyābhimukhībhāvamātraṃ saṃbodhanaṃ viduḥ| prāptābhimukhyo hyarthatmā kriyāsu viniyujyate| asyārthaḥ siddhasyasaṃbodhyatāvacchedakarūpeṇa devadattatvādinā siddhasya, saṃbodhanātprākkāle saṃbodhyatāvacchedakarūpasyāstitvamavaśyamapekṣitam, etenoddeśyatve bījaṃ pradarśitam, siddhaṃ hi loke uddeśyatvena prasiddhamiti bhāvaḥ| abhibhukhobhāveti| saṃbodhanam| abhimukhīkaraṇaṃ, svaprayuktaśabdabodhyājñātārthagrahaṇe sādaratvasaṃpādanaṃ, sādaratvasaṃpattyanukūlavyāpāraśca saṃbodhanavibhaktyantaśabdaprayogarūpaḥ| abhimukhībhāvamātramityanena phalanirdeśaḥ, mukhaparāvṛttyādinā saṃbodhyo yadā phalavattvenānumito bhavati tadā kriyā vidhīyate, tadāhaprāptābhimukhya iti| prāptamābhimukhyaṃ sādaratvaṃ yena, sa evārthaḥarthapūrṇa ātmā saṃbodhyaḥsvaniṣṭhavyāpāramayojyo yo bodānukūlavyāpārāśrayaḥ kriyāsubodhanīyakriyāsu, viniyujyate pravartyata iti| tathā ca viniyujyata ityanena saṃbodhanavibhaktyantārthasya pravartanāviṣayavyāpāra evānvaya iti spaṣṭameva bodhitamityāśaya ityāhuḥ| evaṃ casvaprayuktaśabdabodhyājñātārthabodhānukūlavyāpārānukūlavyāpāraḥ saṃbodhanapadārtha iti phalitam| rāma māṃ pāhītyatra lakṣaṇasamanvayaḥsvapadena rāma māṃ pāhītivacanaprayoktā kaścidrāmabhaktaḥ| tena prayukto yaḥ śabdaḥrāma māmityādiḥ, tadbodhyo'jñātaśca yo'rthaḥmāṃ pāhītyasyārthaḥ, tadbodhānukūlo yo'bhimukhībhāvaḥsādaratvasaṃpattirūpo rāmaniṣṭho vyāpāraḥ, tadanukūlobhaktaniṣṭho rāma māṃ pāhīti śabdaprayogarūpo vyāpāra iti| saṃbodhanavibhaktyantārthapravartanāviṣayavyāpārayormitha uddeśyavidheyabhāvenānvayaḥ| abhigukhībhavadrāmoddeśyakapravartanāviṣayo matkarmakaṃ rakṣaṇamiti bodhaḥ| anye tu tādṛśe'jñātārthabodhe prakṛtyarthasya samavetatvasaṃbendhenānvayaḥ| tādṛśārthabodha eva ca viṣayatāsaṃbandhena kriyāyā anvayaḥ| tathāca rāmasamavetājñātārthabodhaviṣayaḥ prārthanāviṣayamatkarmakaṃ rakṣaṇamiti śābdabodhaṃ varṇayanti| rakṣaṇaṃ trāṇaṃ, tacceṣṭalābhaṃ prati sāhāyakācaraṇaṃ, aniṣṭaparihārapūrvakaṃ madiṣṭasaṃpādanānukūlo vyāpāra ityarthaḥ| kriyāsu pravartyata ityuktatvātpravartanāviṣayakriyāyāmeva saṃbodhanāntārthasyānvayaḥ, sa eva ca nighātaprayojaka ityavagamyate| tathā ca vrajāni devadattetyatra vrajanasya pravartanāviṣayatvābhāvātkathamatra bighātasiddheḥ phalatvena kathanam| gamanayogyakālasya prāptivivakṣāyāṃ praiṣātisargamāptakāleṣviti loṭaḥ sattvenavrajānītyato matkartṛkagamanasya kālaḥ prāpta ityarthāvagamāditi cenna| tatra jānīhītyadhyāhārātpravartanāviṣayatvena vivakṣitāyāmavabodhakriyāyāṃ vrajanasya karmatvena, devadattasya coddeśyatvenānvayena samānavākyatvākṣateḥ| tathā cābhimukhībhavaddevadattoddeśyakaṃ matkartṛkaṃ prāptakālavrajanakarmakaṃ pravartanāviṣayo jñānamiti hyasmācchābdabodhaḥ| na ca jānīhītyadhyāhāre tiṅantadvayaghaṭitavākyasyaikatiṅa vākyamiti daribhāṣitaṃ yannighātopayogyekavākyatvaṃ tadabhāvena nighātāsiddhiriti vācyam| vrajāni devadatta jānīhīti samudāyasya yo'rthastasmin vrajāni devadattetyasya vṛttirvākyaikadeśanyāyena| tathā ca śrūyamāṇādeva tādṛśārthabodha iti śrūyamāṇaikatiṅ‌ghaṭitatvena nighātāsiddhirityāśayāt| praviśa piṇḍīmiti hi vākyaikadeśanyāyasyodāharaṇam| tatra `praviśa gṛhaṃ' iti vākyasyārthe vākyaikadeśasya praviśetyasya prayogaḥ, tathā `piṇḍī bhakṣaya' iti vākyasyārthe vākyaikadeśasya piṇḍīmityasya prayogaḥ| tathā ca śrūyamāṇātpraviśetyekasmādeva praviśa gṛhamiti vākyārthasya bodho jāyate| ayameva cādhyāhārapadārthaḥ| na tu sākṣād‌gṛhaṃ bhakṣayetyanayostatra prayoga āvaśyakaḥ| evaṃ caikatiṅ vākyamiti bhāṣyapaṭhitavārtikasya na virodhaḥ| pacati bhavati devadatteti| asya jānīhīti śeṣaḥ| nanvekatiṅiti paribhāṣitavākyasyaiva nighātopayogitve pacati bhavati devadattotyasya tiṅantadvayaghaṭitatvenaikavākyatvābhāvāddevadattetyasya nighāto na syādata āhasūtrabhāṣyoktarītyeti| `pacyādayaḥ kriyā bhavatikriyāyāḥ kartryo bhavanti' iti bhūvādisūtrasthabhāṣya`ākhyātaṃ saviśeṣaṇaṃ vākyaṃ' iti samarthasūtrasthabhāṣyoktarītyetyarthaḥ| ekavākyatāsattvāditi| tatra jānīhīti pravartanāviṣaṣayajñānakriyāyāṃ devadattasyoddeśyatayā, pacikriyākartṛkabhavanasya ca karmatayā'nvayādanekatiṅantaghaṭitasamudāye'pyekavākyatāsattvādityarthaḥ| ekatiṅ vākyamiti svaśāstrīyanigātādikāryamātropayogyeva| ākhyātaṃ saviśeṣaṇamiti tu śāstralokasādhāraṇamiti bhāvaḥ| tena pacati bhavati, pasya mṛgo dhāvatītyādyanekatiṅantaghaṭitasthale, ekatiṅityasyābhāve'pi na kṣatiḥ| samarthasūtrasthabhāṣyoktena `ākhyātaṃ saviśeṣaṇam' ityanena tatra sarvānubhavasiddhaikavākyatvasyopapatteḥ| syādeveti| āṣṭamikena `āmantritasya ca' ityanena padātparasya samānavākyasthasyā''mantritasya vihito nighāto devadattasya bhavedevetyarthaḥ| abhimukhībhavaddevadattoddeśyakaṃ pacikriyākartṛkabhavanakarmakaṃ pravartanāviṣayo jñānamiti hyasmācchābdabodhaḥ| evamanekatiṅantaghaṭitasamudāyasyaikavākyatve bhāṣyakārasaṃmatiṃ pradarśya sūtrakārasaṃmatiṃ pradarśayitumāha`tiṅ‌ṅatiṅaḥ' ityādi| atiṅantātparaṃ tiṅantaṃ nihanyata iti tadarthaḥ| tatra `pacati caikatiṅantaghaṭitasamudāyo vākyamityarthaḥ| nanvekatiṅantaghaṭitasamudāyasyaikavākyatve tiṣṭhati devadattaḥ, pacati caitra ityatra devadattaḥ pacatītyanayorekavākyatve tiṅṅatiṅa iti nighātāpattiriti cenna| viśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭakriyārthakatvaṃ viśeṣaṇaṃ niveśanīyam| viśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭakriyārthakaikatiṅantaghaṭitamityarthaḥ| devadattasya tiṣṭhatītyanenānvayātpacatītyasya ca caitreṇa śayyante, paśya mṛgo dhāvatītyādi| bahuṣu tiṅanteṣvekavākyatāsattvādeva tiṅantebhyaḥ parasya tiṅantasya nighātaniṣedhaḥ| sārthaka ityarthakenoparyuktavākyapadīyena kauṇḍabhaṭṭairuktatvādityarthaḥ| kṛtvorthā iti| atra kṛtvaḥpadaṃ kṛtvorthatādṛgaparaṃ, kṛtvorthasadṛśo'rthoyeṣāmiti uṣṭramukhavatsamāsaḥ| kṛtvasujādirityarthaḥ| kriyābhyāvṛttigaṇana iti| `rsakhyāyāḥ kriyābhyāvṛttigaṇane kṛtvasuc' ityatra abhyāvṛttiḥjanma, utpattiriti yāvat| upasargavaśād `vṛtu vartane iti dhātorupattau vṛttiriti bhāvaḥ| kriyāṇāṃ janmana utpatteryatsaṃkhyānaṃ gaṇanaṃ tatkriyābhyāvṛttigaṇanamityarthaḥ| kriyāśca ekakartṛkāstulyajātīyā evāpekṣitāḥ| bhinnakartṛkāsu bhinnajātīyāsu ca kriyāsu abhyāvṛttipratīterananubhavāt| evaṃ ca saṃkhyāśabdebhyaḥ kriyābhyāvṛttigaṇane vartamānebhyaḥ svārthe kṛtvasuc pratyayau bhavati iti tadarthaḥ| pañcakṛtvo bhuṅkte, ityudāharaṇe nivṛttabhedāyā ekasyā eva bhujikriyāyā āvṛttyā janitā utpattayaḥ pañcasaṃkhyayā gaṇyante| āvṛttikṛtaṃ galabilādhaḥsaṃyogarūpaphalānekatvamicchan bhujikriyāyāḥ pañca utpattyāvṛttīḥ karoti, yathā viklittirūpaṃ phalamicchaṃstadanukūlaṃ phūtkārādivyāpāraṃ karoti tadvadityarthaḥ| galabilādhaḥsaṃyogānukūlavyāpāro bhujikriyeti bhāvaḥ| evaṃ ca pañcaśabdasya pañcasaṃkhyotpattiparatvaṃ saṃkhyāyāḥ kriyābhyāvṛttigaṇana ityuktisvārasyāt, pratyayastu tad‌doyatakaḥ, pañcasaṃkhyotpatteśca svasamabhivyāhṛtakribāyāmevānvayasyaucityātkriyāyoga eva kṛtvasujādeḥ sādhutvaṃ labhyata ityabhiprāyaḥ| evaṃ ca pañcasaṃkhyotpattikā vartamānakālikā ekakartṛkā bhujikriyeti bodhaḥ| evaṃ sakṛtpacati, dviḥ pacatītyādāvapyūhyam| kriyāyoga eva kṛtvasujādeḥ sādhutvādeva dvai ghaṭāvityādivad‌dvirghaṭa ityādikaṃ na bhavati kriyāgaṇanābhāvāditi bodhyam||
kārakāmiti| kartā karma cetyādi kārakaṣaṭ‌kamityarthaḥ| kārakaśabdasya kriyāparatvaṃ darśayituṃ tadyaugikārthamāhakaroti kartṛkarmādibyapadeśāniti| asyāḥ kriyāyā ayaṃ kartā, idaṃ karma, idaṃ karaṇamityevaṃ kriyānirūpitā eva hi kartukarmādisaṃjñā ityarthaḥ| kriyānvayināmeva saṃjñeti| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ dhruvamapāyeityādyuttarasūtre `kriyāyāṃ' ityasyānuvṛttau satyāṃ kriyāyā janakākāṅkṣatayā tatra janakatvena yadapāye dhruvamityasya saṃbandhe kriyamāṇe kriyājanakamityarthasaṃpattyā janakasya janyākāṅkṣatayā janya eva janakasyānvaya ucita iti kriyānvayināmevāpādānādisaṃjñā ityartha iti| anye tu karoti kriyāṃ nirvartayatīti vyutpattidarśanātkriyājanakatvaṃ kārakatvam| tacca kartrādīnāṃ ṣaṇṇāmapyasti| tatra kriyājanakamiti jñāte kā sā kriyetyākāṅkṣodayena kriyāyāścāpi janakākāṅkṣatayā yena yadākāṅkṣyate tattenaivānvetīti niyamāttatraivānvayo yuktaḥ| kriyānvayitvaṃ kārakatvamiti tu na| kārakāṇāṃ bhāvanānvaya ityasya kriyānvayināṃ kriyānvaya ityarthāpattyā'saṃgatyāpatteḥ| tatra prakṛtadhātuvācyavyāpārāśrayaḥ kartā, prakṛtavātvarthapradhānībhūtavyāpāraprayojyapakṛtavātvarthaphalāśrayatvenoddeśyaṃ karma, kartṛniṣṭhavyāpāraprayojyasvaniṣṭhavyāpārāvyavadhānena phalaniṣpādakaṃ karaṇam, sakalakriyākarmasaṃvandhāya kriyāyāṃ yaduddeśyaṃ tatsaṃpradānam, tattatkartṛsamavetatattatkriyājyaprakṛtadhātvavācyavibhāgāśrayamapādānam, kartṛkarmadvārakaphalavyāpārādhāro'dhikaraṇam, iti prāhuḥ|
prathamo vatiriti tena tulyaṃ kriyā cadbati| tulyamiti kriyetyasya viśeṣaṇam| sāmānyābhiprāyaṃ napuṃsakam| tṛtīyāntāttulyamityarthe vatiḥ syādyattulyaṃ sā kriyā cediti tadarthaḥ| brāhmaṇavadadhīte, ityudāharaṇam| atra brāhmaṇaśabdastatkartṛkādhyayanaparaḥ, brāhmaṇakartṛkādhyayanatulyaṃ kṣatriyakartṛkādhyayanamiti vodhaḥ| tatra tasyeveti vatyarthasya kriyānvayitvābhāvātprathamo vatirityuktam| devadattavanmaitraḥ sundara ityatra bhavatītyadhyāhāryam| anyathā sūtre kriyā cediti vyarthameva syāt| evaṃ ca vatyarthasādṛśyasya kriyaivā''śraya iti kriyāyoga eva prathamavateḥ sādhutvaṃ labhyate| dhātusaṃbandhādhikāreti| `dhātusaṃbandhe pratyayāḥ' atra dhātoḥ śabdasya dhātunā śabdāntareṇa saṃbandhāsaṃbhavāddhātupadena dātvartho lakṣyate| saṃbandhasya ca dviṣṭhatvāddhātvarthayoḥ saṃbandha ityarthaḥ| tathā ca `dhātusaṃbandhe, ityadhikṛtya vihitapratyayānāṃ kriyāyoga eva sādhutvaṃ labhyate| yathāyāhi yāhītī yātītyatra yādhātoḥ kriyāsamabhihāre loṭ, tasya hyadeśe `kriyāsamabhihāre dve' iti dvitvaṃ yātītyanupayogaśca| atra yāhi yāhi, iti loḍantārthasya yātīti tiṅantopasthitakriyāyāṃ sāmānyaviśeṣabhāvenānvayāt `punaḥ punaratiśayena vā yadyānaṃ tadabhinnamekakartṛkaṃ vartamānakālikaṃ yānam' iti bodhaḥ| evaṃ paśyan yayāvityatra bhūtakālikadarśanakartrabhinnakartṛkaṃ yānamityarthaḥ| bṛhad‌bhūṣaṇe tu bhoktuṃ pacatītyudāhyataṃ, tatra yadyapi tumunṇvulauo ityuktastumun na dhātusaṃbandhādikāre vihitastathā'pi kriyāvācinyupapada eva vihitatvātkriyāsaṃbandhanimittakatvaṃ tasyākṣatameveti nodāharaṇāsaṃgatiriti bodhyam|
nanvabrāhmaṇamānayetyādau kriyābhinne'pyanvayadarśanādāhaasamastanañiti| kriyayaivānvetīti śeṣaḥ| nanu ghaṭo'yaṃ na paṭa ityatrāsamastasyāpi nañaḥ kriyāyāmananvayena niyamāsaṃgatyāpattirityāśayenāsamastanañityasya vivakṣitamarthamāhasamāsāyogya iti| samāsāyogyatvameva viśadayatiprasajyeti| prasajyapratiṣedhaśabdayoḥ supsupeti samāsaḥ| prasajyaāpādya, pratiṣedhoniṣedha ityarthaḥ| prasajya kriyāguṇau tataḥ paścānnivṛttiṃ karotīti mañjūṣāyāmuktatvāt| tatastamarhatatyirthe tadarhatīti chapratyaye kriyānvayayogya ityarthaḥ| `prasajyapratiṣedhastu kriyayā saha yatra nañ' ityuktatvāt| tiṅantopasthitakriyānvayyeva sarvathā samāsāyogyaḥ, tiṅantena samāsaniṣedhāditi bhāvaḥ| anyathā uttarapadārthānvaye'pyabrāhmaṇa ityādau samāsavikalpena pakṣe'samastatvātkriyānvayaniyamasya vyabhicārāpattirityāśayavānāhayathāśrutagrahaṇāyogāditi| evaṃ ca vyabhicāravāraṇāyāsamastanañityasya tiṅantopasthāpyakriyānvayītyevārtho vivakṣitavya ityabhiprāyaḥ| nanu bhūtale ghaṭo nāstītyatra ghaṭābhāva eva ghaṭābhāvakartṛkāstikriyaiva pratīyate, na tu ghaṭakartṛkāstikriyābhāvaḥ| na ca bhūtalādhikaraṇakaghaṭakartṛkasattābhāva eva nañā bodyata iti vācyam| yatra bhūtale vartamānakālāvacchedena ghaṭasaṃbandhābhāvastatra bhūtalādhikaraṇakavartamānakālikasattāyā aprasiddhyā tādṛśasattābhāvabodhanāsaṃbhavādanubhavavirodhāccetyāśayena śaṅkamāno brūtena cāsamastetyā di mānābhāva ityantam| samādhattena tvaṃ pacasītyādi| kriyāyā eva niṣedhapratīteriti| yuṣmadādyarthābhinnalaḍarthakartṛniṣṭhavartamānakālikapacikriyābhāva iti bodhādityarthaḥ| tathā ca tādṛśabodha evāsamastanañarthasya kriyānvaye mānamiti bhāvaḥ| nañarthābhāvasya pratiyogitayā kriyānvayādeva yuṣmadādestiṅvācyakārakavācitvarūpasāmānādhikaraṇyasattvātprathamamadhyamapuruṣādyupapadyate, upapadyate caikavacanadvivacanādi| nañarthasya pratiyogitayā yuṣmadādyarthānvaye tu tvadabhāvo madabhāvaścāstītivat na tvaṃ pacasītyādāvapi yuṣmadasmadostiṅvācyakārakavācitvarūpasāmānādhikaraṇyasya virahānmadhyamottamayoranupapattirdvivacanabahuvacanānupapattiḥ prathamapuruṣāpattiśca syāditi bhāvaḥ| ghaṭo na jāyata ityatra kriyāniṣedhapratītau yuktimāhaata eveti| jananakriyāyā abhāvapratīrevetyarthaḥ| vidyamāne'pi ghaṭa iti| ghaṭasya vidyamānatādaśāyāmapītyarthaḥ| ghaṭasya vidyamānatve ghaṭābhāvabodhanasyāśakyatayā tatra kriyāniṣedhabodho'vaśyamabhyūpagantavya iti bhāvaḥ| tādṛśaprayoga iti| ghaṭo na jāyata ityetādṛśaḥ prayoga ityarthaḥ| ghaṭāvasthitidaśāyāṃ ghaṭe svakartṛkotpattyanukūlavyāpārābhāvasya sattvāditi bhāvaḥ| asamastanañarthābhāvasya pratiyogitayā nāmārthānvaye tu ghaṭābhāve ghaṭaniṣṭhotpattyanukūlavyāpāravirahāttādṛśaprayogo naiva syādityāśayaḥ| tathā ceti| na tvaṃ pacasītyādāvuktarītyā nañaḥ kriyāpratiyogikābhāvabodhakatvāvaśyakatve cetyarthaḥ| astitvābhāva eveti| ghaṭakatṛkasattāyā evābhāva ityarthaḥ| evakāreṇa ghaṭābhāvo vyāvartitaḥ| nanu ghaṭo na jāyata ityādipūrvoktasthale'nupapattyā kriyāpratiyogikābhāvapratītisvīkāre'pi ghaṭo nāstītyādau ghaṭābhāvapatītireva svīkriyatāṃ bādhakābhāvāt, tathā ca tatraiva nañaḥ kriyānvayaniyamabhaṅga ityāśaṅkya ghaṭābhāvapratītisvīkāre bādhakaṃ pradarśayatina hi `ghaṭo na jāyate| ityādinā| ekatrotpattayanukūlo vyāpāro dhātvarthaḥ, aparatra sattānukūlo vyāpāraḥ| anayormadhye dhātvarthabheda eva viśeṣaḥ, etadatiriktaḥ kaścidapi kiyānapi viśeṣo nāsti| yo'pi viśeṣo'sti so'pi nañarthābhāvapratiyogibhedakalpane'kiṃcitkara ityarthaḥ| tathā cobhayatrāpi kriyāpratiyogikābhāva ityevamekarūpa eva śābdabodhaḥ| `saṃbhavatyekarūpatve rūpabhedo hi dūṣaṇaṃ' iti yuktisiddhābhiyuktokteḥ| satyevaṃ yadi vinā kāraṇaṃ nañarthābhāvapratiyogibhedaḥ kalpyeta tarhi bodhasyaikarūpatvaṃ bhajyeta vairūpyaṃ ca syāditi tadeva vairūpyaṃ ghaṭo nāstītyatra ghaṭābhāvapratītisvīkāre bādhakamityaśayaḥ| nanu bhūtale na ghaṭaḥ, ityatra kriyāvācakavyāhāravirahite vākye bhūtalavṛttighaṭābhāva eva bodhanīyastathā ca tatraiva kriyānvayaniyamabhaṅgo'ta āhatathā ca bhūtale neti| astītyaghyāhāryamiti| astirbhavantīparo'prayujyamāno'pyastīti bhāṣyāt| bhavantīti laṭaḥ saṃjñā, laṭ‌paro'stidhātuḥ prayoktavya iti tadarthāditi bhāvaḥ| adhyāhāre bījamāhaprakāratāsaṃbandheneti| nañarthābhāvaniṣṭhaviśeṣyatānirūpitaprakāratāsaṃbandhena śābdabodhatvāvacchinnaṃ prati dhātujanyabhāvanopasthitiḥ kāraṇamityevaṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvasya klṛptatvādityarthaḥ| atra yatkiṃcinnaṣṭhaprakāratānirūpitanañarthābhāvaniṣṭhaviśeṣyatākaśābdabodhajananaṃ kāryaṃ, tādṛśābhāvaniṣṭhaprakāratānirūpitanañarthābhāvaniṣṭhaviśeṣyatākaśābdabodhajananaṃ kāryaṃ, tādṛśābhāvaniṣṭhaviśeṣyatānirūpitaprakāratāsaṃbandhāvacchinnadhātujanyavyāpārarūpabhāvanopasthitiḥ kāraṇamiti bodhyam| klṛptatvāditi| āvaśyakatvādityarthaḥ| anyathā nañarthābhāvasya kriyānvayaniyamo nopapadyeteti bhāvaḥ| śeṣamiti| āropitatvaṃ nañ‌dyotyamanekamityatraikavacananiyamena tathā yasya ca bhāveneti| yasya ca bhāvenetyanenaitādṛśapadatrayaghaṭitaṃ, ṣaṣṭhī cetyanenaitādṛśapadadvayaghaṭitaṃ ca sūtraṃ lakṣyate ityāśayavānāhayasya ca bhāvena bhāvalakṣaṇamityatreti, ṣaṣṭhī cānādare, itīti ca| atra bhāvaśabdau dhātuvācyakiyāparau| yanniṣṭhakriyayā kriyāntaraṃ lakṣyate tataḥ saptamīti tadarthaḥ| tata ityasya jñāpakakriyāśrayavācakādityarthaḥ| tacca gopadaduhyamānapadayorapyastīti ubhābhyāmapi saptamī bhavati| jñāpakatvaṃ saptamyarthaḥ, tasya ca bhāvalakṣaṇamityukteḥ kriyāyāmevānvaya iti satisaptamyāḥ kriyāyoga eva sādhutvaṃ labhyate| yathā goṣuduhyamānāsu gata iti| duhyamānānāṃ gavāṃ jñāpakatvaṃ jñāpyatvaṃ ca gamanakriyāyāṃ śabdataḥ pratīyate tathā'pi gogatadohanakriyāyāḥ sākṣājjñāpakatā gavāṃ tu tadāśrayatayā| nirjñātakālakriyāyā vetyādau putrādiviṣayako'nādaro'dhikā bhāsata iti jñeyam| tatsvarūpaṃsādhutvasvarūpam| vakṣyateasādhuranumānenetyetavdyākhyānāvasara iti śeṣaḥ| kriyayaivetīti| evakāro'yogavyavacchedārthaḥ| ayogaḥ saṃbandhābhāvaḥ, tasya vyavacchedo nivṛttiḥ| tathā ca niruktāṣṭakasya kriyāyoga eva sādhutvaṃ nānyathetyarthaḥ| nanu kriyāśabdasya dhātvarthamātre prasiddheḥ phalānvayenaivoktāṣṭakasya sādhutve sati na bhāvanānvayaniyamaḥ sidhyatīti na tadanurodhena bhāvanāyāḥ pāka ityādau dātuvācyatvaṃ labhyata ityāśaṅkyā''haayaṃ bhāva iti| bhūvādayo dhātavaḥ, ityādisūtreṣu bāhulyena vyāpārarūpabhāvanāyāḥ kriyāśabdena vyavahārasya kṛtatvādbhāvanāyāṃ kriyāśabdo rūḍhaḥ| kriyetyākārakaḥ śabdo rūḍhyā bhāvanāṃ pratipādayatītyarthaḥ| bhāvanāyāṃ kriyāśabdasya rūḍhisattve tathāprayogaprācuryadarśanameva pramāṇamityaśayena `prāyaśaḥ kriyāśabdenetyuktam| nanu phale'pi kriyāśabdaḥ prayukto dṛśyate, tatkathaṃ bhāvanāyāmeva kriyāśabdasya sāṃketikī śaktirityucyate, ityāśaṅkyā''haphalāṃśe kvācitka iti| kriyāśabde kṛñaḥ śa ceti sūtreṇa karmaṇi śapratyayaḥ| tathā ca kriyate bhāvanārūpavyāpāreṇotpādyate iti vyutpattyā phale yaugiko'yaṃ kriyāśabdaḥ, sa cāpi phaleṃ kvacideva prayuktaḥ| kvācitka ityanena prayogabāhulyābhāva uktaḥ| tena phalāṃśe kriyāśabdasya rūḍhyabhāva ityuktaṃ bhavati| yogāt prakṛtipratyayārthasaṃbandhādāgato yaugikaḥ| avayavaśaktyasahakṛtasamudāyaśaktimātreṇārthapratipādikā rūḍhiḥ, samudāyaśaktinirapekṣāvayavaśaktyā'rthapratipādikā yogaśaktiḥ| avayavārthānusaṃdhānasāpekṣatvena yogārthasya vilambopasthitikatvādvahiraṅgatvaṃ, avayavārthānusaṃdhānānapekṣatvena tuḥrūḍhyarthasya śīghropasthitikatvādantaraṅgatvamityantaraṅgatvaṃhiraṅgabhāvamūlakena yogādrūḍhirbaṃlīyasītinyāyena kriyāśabdena vyāpārarūpabhāvanāyā eva grahaṇāvaśyakatvena bhāvanārūpakriyānvaya evāṣṭakasya sādhutvaṃ pratipādyate na tu phalānvayeneti bhāva iti| saṃjñāśabdasyeti| rūḍhasyetyarthaḥ| anapekṣyeti| prakṛtipratyayātmakāvayavārthamananusaṃdhāyetyarthaḥ| saṃjñāśabdasya prakṛtipratyayārthānanusaṃdhānapravṛttikatvena balīyastve mīmāṃsādhikaraṇaṃ pramāṇīkarotiata eveti| saṃjñāśabdaprābalyāditi| sāpekṣapravṛttikaśabdāpekṣayā nirapekṣapravṛttikaśabdasya balīyastvādityarthaḥ| navame nirṇītamiti| navamādhyāye dvitīyapāde pañcame'dhikaraṇe rathaṃtaramuttarāgranthapaṭhitayoravercorgeyamiti nirṇītamityarthaḥ| taddhi `yadyonyāṃ gāyati taduttarayorgāyati' iti vacane padāntarasāpekṣatvapadāntaranirapekṣatvābhyāmarthapratipādakayordvayoruttarāśabdayormadhye padāntaranirapekṣārthaṃpratipādakottarāśabdagrahaṇanirṇayāya pravṛttam| chandaḥ, uttarā ceti dvau granthau samāgānāmṛkpāṭhārthaṃ staḥ| tatra cchandonāmake granthe nānāvidhānāṃ sābhnāṃ yonibhūtā evarcaḥ paṭhitāḥ| uttarāgranthe tu tṛcātmakāni sūktāni paṭhitāni| ekasmiṃstṛce chandogatā yonyṛk‌prathamā, itare dve uttare| evaṃ sthite `taduttarayorgāyati' rathaṃtarayonyuttarayorṛcorgāyatītyatra dvividhe uttare saṃbhavataḥ| chandogranthe `abhitvā śūra' itīyamṛk rathaṃtarayonitvena paṭhitā| tasyā upari `tvāmiddhi havāmahe' ityādayo bṛhadādisāmnāṃ yonayaḥ paṭhitāḥ| uttarāgrante tu `abhi tvā śūra' iti sūkte tasyā ṛca ūrdhvaṃ `na tvā vām̐ anye' ityeṣā sāmnaḥ kasyāpyayonibhūtā paṭhitā| tatra cchandogranthānusāreṇa bṛhadādisāmāntarayoryānī dve ṛcau rathaṃtarasya svayonyuttare bhavataḥ| uttarāgranthānusāreṇa tṛcagate dvitīyatṛtīye ṛcau svayonyuttare bhavataḥ| tatra taduttarayorityatratyottarāśabdena kiṃ chandogranthānusāreṇa rathaṃtarayonyuttarabhūte bṛhadādisāmāntarayoryonī `tvāmiddhi havāmahe' ityādī dve ṛcau grāhye, uta uttarāgranthānusāreṇa rathaṃtarayonyuttare tṛcagate kasyāpi sāmno'nonibhūte dvitīyatṛtīye `na tvā vām̐ anye' ityādī dve ṛcau grāhye, ityevaṃ saṃdehe prāpte satidvividho hyatrottarāśabdaḥ| tatraiko vyavasthāvācī, aparaśca granthaviśeṣavācī| yaśca vyavasthāvācī so'vadhyaṃśe nityasākāṅūkṣaḥ| uttarayorityukte tatra kasmādityevamavadhaayākāṅkṣāyā niyamena jāyamānatvāt| tasmādavadhivācakapadāntarasāpekṣatvenaivāyaṃ svārthapratipādakaḥ| padāntarānapekṣāyāṃ tvanarthaka eva bhavet| taduktaṃ śābarabhāṣye'sminnevādhikaraṇe`sarve hi saṃbandhiśabdāḥ padāntaramanapekṣamāṇā na kaṃcidapyarthamāhuḥ| tasmādapekṣitaṃ padāntaram| itarathā'paripūrṇārthaṃ vākyamanabhidhāyakameva syātkasyācidapyarthasya'| saṃbandhiśabdāḥnityaṃ saṃbandhyantarasāpekṣāḥ| uttarāśabdasya vaidikaprayogād‌granthaviśeṣe saṃjñātvena vinuyuktasya grahaṇe tu tasya padāntaranirapekṣatvātkevalaṃ śravaṇamātreṇaiva paripūrmasvārthabodhakatvam| tadapyuktaṃ tatraiva`saṃjñāsaṃjñigrahaṇe na punaḥ padāntaramapekṣate, śrutyaiva paripūrṇārtho gṛhyamāṇāsu padāntarāntaryamapekṣitavyaṃ bhavati' iti| evaṃ ca bṛhadādiyonyoruttarāśabdasya pūrvaṛksāpekṣatvādyaugikī pravṛttiriti tayorbilambenopasthitiḥ| uttarāgranthe tu tasya rūḍhyaparaparyāyasaṃjñātvena pravṛttiriti granthasya jhaṭityupasthitiḥ| tataścottarāśabdenātrottarāgranthe paṭhitayoreva śīghramupastitiḥ kṛteti tatraiva rathaṃtaraṃ geyaṃ, na bṛhadādiyonāviti siddhāntitam| evaṃ ca tatra yathā saṃbandhiśabdasya tattatsaṃbandhipratītisāpekṣapravṛttikatvena vilambopasthitikatvāddaurbalyaṃ, saṃjñāśabdasya tu nirapekṣapravṛttikatvena śīghropasthitikatvātprābalyaṃ tathā prakṛte yogārthapratītisāpekṣapravṛttikayaugikāpekṣayā saṃjñāśabdasya yogārthapratītinirapekṣapravṛttikatvātprābalyamiti bhāvaḥ|
nanu phalasyāpi `karmavatkarmaṇā' iti sūtre kriyāśabdena vyavahārādastibhavatividyatiṣu sādhyatvena pratīyamānatvātsattādereva kriyātvopapādanācca palasyāpi kriyāśabdena grahaṇe bādhakābhāva ityāśaṅkayā''hakiṃ ca phalāṃśo'pīti| vyāpāraviśeṣaṇamityarthaḥ| `phale pradhānaṃ vyāpāraḥ' ityuktvāditi bhāvaḥ| kvacittathābhūtānīti| vyāpāraviśeṣaṇānītyarthaḥ| caitrastaṇḍulaṃ pacatītyādau kartṛtiṅante kārakāṇāṃ vyāpāraviśeṣaṇatvena dṛṣṭatvāditi bhāvaḥ| paktetyādau kṛdante kārakāṇāṃ vyāpāraṃ prati viśeṣyatvākvacidityuktam| guṇānāṃ ceti| `guṇānāṃ ca parārthatvādasaṃbandhaḥ samatvātsyāt'asyārthaḥguṇānāṃviśeṣaṇānāṃ, parārthatvātviśeṣyopakāritvāt, samatvātviśeṣyopakāritvarūpasamānadharmatvāt, teṣāṃ parasparaṃ saṃbandho guṇapradhānabhāvenānvayo nasyāditi| tathā ca yathā phalasya viśeṣyopakāritvādviśeṣyabhūte vyāpāra evānvayastathā kārakāṇāmapi viśeṣyopakāritvātsākṣātparamparayā vā vyāpāra evānvayo, na tu kvacidapi phale, viśeṣaṇatvāviśeśānnirākāṅkṣātvācca| kārakatvasya kriyājanakatvarūpatvena janyakriyāṃśa eva teṣāṃ sākāṅkṣatvāditi bhāvaḥ| etannyāyānuguṇaṃ dṛṣṭāntaṃ svayamevā''hasarve sevakā iti| parasparaṃ guṇapradhānabhāvamanāpannāḥ sevakāḥ prādhānyena yathā rājānameva sevante tathā kārakāṇyapi parasparanirapekṣāṇī vyāpārameva viśeṣyatvenāṅgīkurvate, na guṇabhūtaṃ phalāṃśamiti na tatrānvaya ityarthaḥ| kiṃ ca kārakāṇāṃ nityaparatantrāṇāṃ viśeṣyākāṅkṣāyāṃ dhātvarthaphalāṃśasya tathānvayayogyatāyāmapi tasyāpi paratantrasya viśeṣyākāṅkṣāpūraṇasamarthāyāṃ vyāpārarūpabhāvanāyāmevānvayāṅgīkāre laukikanyāyaṃ pradarśayatinahi bhikṣuka iti| yathā hi lokavyavahāre bhikṣuko bhikṣukāntaraṃ na yācate sati bhikṣukādanyasmindātarītyevaṃ dṛśyate tathā kārakāṇyapi guṇabhūtāni guṇabhūtaṃ phalāṃśaṃ viśeṣyatayā nāṅgīkurvate, satyāmaguṇabhūtāyāṃ viśeṣyatayā'ṅgīkārayogyāyāṃ vyāpārātprakabhāvanāyāmityarthaḥ| manvata iti| anena nyāyena kārakāṇāṃ phalānvayaṃ vihāya bhāvanānvayameva mīmāṃsakā api manvata ityarthaḥ| evaṃ ceti| kāraṇāṇāṃ vyāpārarūpabhāvanāyāmevānvaya ityevaṃ niyame cetyarthaḥ| yādṛśaḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ phalitastaṃ darśayativiśeṣyatayetyādi| kārakādīti| kālaphalayorādipadena grahaḥ| kārakādi, prakāroviśeṣaṇaṃ yatretyevamīdṛśe śābdabodhe jananīye, viśeṣyatayākārakādiniṣṭhaviśeṣaṇatānirūpitaviśeṣyatāsaṃbandhena dhātujanyā yā bhāvanopasthitiḥ sā kāraṇamityarthaḥ| caitrastaṇḍulaṃ pacatītyatra lakṣaṇasamanvayaḥcaitrasyābhedasaṃbandhena laḍarthakartaryanvayaḥ| laḍarthakartuśca niṣṭhatvasaṃbandhena bhāvanāyāṃvyāpāre'nvayaḥ, laḍarthakālasyāpi kālikasaṃbandhena vyāpāra evānvayaḥ| tathā taṇḍularūpasya karmaṇo niṣṭhatvasaṃbandhena viklittirūpe phale'nvayaḥ, phalasya cānukūlatāsaṃbandhena vyāpāre'nvayaḥ| caitraṃ prati laḍarthakartā viśeṣyaḥ, vyāpāraṃ prati ca viśeṣaṇam| tathā taṇḍulaṃ prati phalaṃ viśeṣyaṃ vyāpāraṃ prati ca viśeṣaṇam| tathā ca caitrābhinnalaḍarthakartṛniṣṭhaḥ, taṇḍulaniṣṭhaviklittyanukūlo vartamānakāliko vyāpāra iti vyāpāramukhyaviśeṣyakaḥ śābdabodha ityarthaḥ| atra kartṛkārakasya vyāpāre sākṣādanvayaḥ, karmakārakasya tu phale, phalasya ca sākṣāvdyāpāra iti paramparayā vyāpāre karmānvayaḥ| yathā'dhikaraṇakārakasya kartṛkarmadvārā kriyānvayastathā karmaṇo'pi phaladvārā kriyāyāmevānvayo na tu phala iti bodhyam|
nanu yatra vyāpārasya prādhānyeva pratītiḥ, yathā pacatītyādau tiṅante| tatroktanyāyena kārakāṇi vyāpārameva viśeṣyatayā'ṅgīkurvantu nāma, kiṃtu yatra vyāpāro guṇabhūtastatra kathaṃ kārakāṇi viśeṣyatayā vyāpāramahgīkuryurata āhayatrāpi paktetyādi| yatra paktetyādikartrarthakatṛjādyantasthale prakṛtipratyayārtharyoriti nyāyena kartuḥ prādhānyāttadviśeṣaṇībhūtā vyāpārarūpā bhāvanā tatrāpi| niruktakāryakāraṇabhāvānusāreṇa viśeṣaṇībhūtabhāvanāyāmeva kārakānvayaḥ| yathā odanasya paktetyatra odanarūpasya karmaṇo vyāpāra evānvayo na tu phale| tasyāmevetyekāreṇa phalānvayasya vyāvartitatvādityarthaḥ| kiṃ ca dhātvarthaphale kārakānvaye vājapeyādhikaraṇamasaṃgataṃ syāt| taddhi prathamādhyāyasya caturthapāde ṣaṣṭhamadhikaraṇam| phalaṃ dhātvarthaḥ, bhāvanā ākhyātārthaḥ, dhātvarthasya ca karaṇatvena bhāvanāyāmanvayaḥ| evaṃ sthite tatretthaṃ pūrvapakṣaḥ`vājapeyena svārājyakāmo yajeta' ityatra vājapepaॉyaśabdena guṇo vidhīyate| vājasyānnasya peyaṃ dravībhūto rasa iti vyutpattyā bājapeyaśabdo yavāgūparaḥ| tathā ca somena yajetetyatra somarūpaguṇa ivātra yavāgūrūpo guṇo vidhīyate| na ca vājapeyarūpaguṇavatā yāgena svarājyaṃ bhāvayedityarthalābhāya vājapeyaśabde matvarthalakṣaṇā'ṅgīkāryeti vācyam| vājapeyaguṇe svārājyaphale ca yajestantreṇa saṃbandhe sati vājapeyadravyeṇa svārājyāya yatetetyevamarthalābhāt| nanu yāgasya guṇasaṃbandhe sati vājapeyaguṇena yāgaṃ kuryādityevaṃ yāgasya karmakārakatvaṃ bhavati| tathā yāgena svārājyaṃ bhāvayodityevaṃ yāgasya phalasaṃbandhe karaṇakārakatvaṃ bhavati| tatkathamubhayasaṃbandha iti cenna| yajeḥ sādhāraṇatvenobhayarūpatvasaṃbhavāt| yajetetyatra yajadhātunā yāga uktaḥ| pratyayena bhāvanoktā| tayostu samabhivyāhārātsaṃbandhamātraṃ gamyate| tacca karmatvakaraṇatvayoḥ sādhāraṇam| na tatra karmatvavācinī karaṇatvavācīnī vā kācidasādhāraṇī vibhaktiḥ śrūyate| ataḥ sādhāraṇasya yajerubhābhyāṃ yugapatsaṃbandhe sati yathocitasaṃbandhaviśeṣastatra tatra paryavasyati| evaṃ tantreṇa saṃbandhāṅgīkāre vājapeyadravyena yāgaṃ kuryādityarthasya labhyamānatvādguṇavidhitve'pi nāsti matvarthalakṣaṇeti|
siddhāntastuyajestantreṇobhayasaṃbandhāṅgīkāre yāge viruddhatrikadbayāpattiḥ syāt| tathā hiuddeśyatvamanuvādyatvaṃ mukhyatvaṃ ceti trayāṇāṃ dharmāṇāmekaṃ trikam| upādeyatvaṃ vidheyatvaṃ guṇatvaṃ ceti trayāṇāṃ dharmāṇāmaparaṃtrikam| etattrikadvayaṃ mithaḥ krameṇa viruddham| yajetetyatra prtayayavācyamāvanāyāḥ sādhyaṃ svārājyaphalam| sādhanaṃ yāgaḥ| tatrā''dyamuddeśyatvāditrikaṃ sādhyabhūtasvārājyaphalaniṣṭham| dvitīyamupādeyatvāditrikaṃ sādhanabhūtayāganiṣṭham| phalamuddiśya yāga upādīyate| phalamanūdya yāgo vidhīyate| phalaṃ pradhānaṃmukhyaṃ, yāga upasarjanaṃ guṇaḥ| phalasyoddeśyatvaṃ nāma mānasāpekṣāviṣayatvam| yāgasyopādeyatvaṃ nāmānuṣṭhīyamānattram| tāvumau manaḥśarīropādhiko dharmau| anuvādyatvavidheyatvadharmau tu śabdopādhikau| jñātasya kathanamanuvādaḥ| ajñātasyānuṣṭheyatvakathanaṃ vidhiḥ| phalayāgayoḥ sādhyasādhanatvarūpatayā pradhānatvopasarjanatve| evaṃ sati phalatatsādhanayoḥ svārājyayāgayoḥ svabāvaparyālocanāyāṃ yathā phalasyoddeśyatvāditrīkaṃ, yāgasyopādeyavatvāditrikaṃ bhavati| tathā yāgasya vājapeyasya ca sādhyasādhanabhāvaparyālocanāyāṃ yāgasyoddeśyatvāditrikaṃ, vājapeyasyopādepatvāditrikaṃ ca paryavasyati| tataḥ prakṛte yāgasya sādhanatvena sādhyatvena ceti prakāradvayena pratyayavācyabhāvanāyāṃ yugapattantreṇa saṃbandhāṅgīkāre sādhanatvamūlakā upādeyatvādayastrayo dharmā yāge'ṅgīkartavyāḥ| sādhyatvācca tadānīmeva tatraiva yāge uddeśyatvādayastrayo dharmāḥ prāpnuvanti| kiṃ tūpādeyatvādibhiḥ sākaṃ virodhāduddeśyatvādayastrayo dharmāstatra tadānīmeva nāṅgīkartuṃ śakyante| ato'tra yāgasya sādhanatvena sādhyatvena ceti prakāradvayena bhāvanāyāṃ yugapattantreṇa saṃbandho durvaca iti| asminnadhikaraṇe dhātvarthaphalasya yāgasya karaṇatvena bhāvanāyāmanvaye kṛte tatraiva yāge punaḥ kārakāntarānvaye viruddhatrikadvayāpattirdoṣatvenoktā| yadi viśeṣaṇībhūte ghātvarthaphale kārakāntarānvayaḥ syāttarhi trikadvayāpāttirūpadoṣadānamasaṃgataṃ syāditi bhāvaḥ| tasmādviśeṣaṇībhūte dhātvarthaphale kārakāṇāmanvayo naiva bhavati kiṃtu viśeṣyabhūte vyāpāra eva kārakānvaya ityavaśyamaṅgīkāryamityāśayenā''habhūṣaṇe prapañcitamiti| evaṃ ca pāka ityādāvodanasyetyādikārakānvayasiddhaye vyāpārarūpabhāvanāyā ghañante dhātuvācyatvamāvaśyakamiti siddham| prakārāntareṇa kārakāṇāṃ vyāpārānvayaniyamaṃ sādhayatāmanyeṣāṃ vaiyākaraṇānāṃ matamupapādayannāhakecittvityādi| anvayabodhākāṅkṣānivṛttyoriti| anvayabodhasyā''kāṅkṣānivṛtteścetyarthaḥ| adarśanāditi| bhūtale dhaṭa ityatra bhūtalābhinnamadhikaraṇamekatvaviśiṣṭo ghaṭaścetyanvayabodhasya, devadatto ghaṭamityatra ghaṭābhinnaṃ karmetyādyanvayabodhasya ca saṃbhave'pi `sarvaṃ hi vākyaṃ kriyayā parisamāpyate' iti nyāyena vākyadvaye krameṇāstipaśyatītyādikriyāmantareṇa vākyaghaṭakayāvatpadārthānāṃ parasparamanvayabodhājananādākāṅkṣānivṛtterapyadarśanādityarthaḥ| tavadyatirekeṇeti| sattādarśanādikriyādhyāhāreṇa vinā niruktavākyadvayasya sādhutvaṃ na labhyata ityarthaḥ| āhuriti| anena taduktāvasvarasaḥ sūcitaḥ| sa cāpyasādhutvāṃśe| yadi tu kriyāsākāṅkṣāvākye sādhutvaṃ neṣyeta tarhi `gāmityukte kartā kriyā cānirdiṣṭe' ityādibhāṣyokterasādhutāpatteḥ| vākyaghaṭakayāvatpadārthānāṃ mitho'nvayabodha ākāṅkṣānivṛttiśca yogyakriyādhyāhārema nirvāhye ityāśayaḥ| etāvatā kārakāṇāṃ bhāvanānvayaniyamaḥ kathaṃ sidhyatīti cintyamiti bhāvaḥ|| 17 ||
svayamityādi| niruktāṣṭakasya kriyānvaya eva sādhutve yuktimuktvedānīṃ kriyānanvaye pratibandīrūpāṃ tāṃ vaktiyadi pakṣe'pi vatyartha iti| yadi pakṣesaṃdigdhasādhyavati parvatādau, vatyarthaḥsādṛśyamanveti, kārakaṃadhikaraṇādi, nañādiṣunañarthābhāve, taditaranāmārthe ca, anvetītīṣyeta naiyāyikairityarthaḥ| tarhi puṣpebhya ityatra taditarānāmārthe ca, anvetītīṣyeta naiyāyikairityarthaḥ| tarhi puṣpebhya ityatra kārakacaturthīsiddhaye bhavadbhiryā spṛhadhātuprayogakalpanā kṛtā sā parityaktavyā bhavatīti saṃkṣipto'rthaḥ| parvato vahnimāniti| tena tulyamityanena kriyāsādṛśye vihitavateḥ kriyāyāmevānvaya ityevaṃ na niyamaḥ| mahānasavaditi dṛṣṭānte niruktasūtreṇa vihatavatarerthasya sādṛśyasya parvata evānvayo, na kriyāyām| yathā mahānaso vanhimāṃstathā parvato'pīti vivaraṇena mahānasasadṛśaḥ parvata ityarthapratītervatyarthasādṛśyasya parvata evānvayasya dṛṣṭatvādityarthaḥ| tathā saptamyadhikaraṇe cetyādinā vihitasaptamyāderarthasyādhikaraṇādikārakasya kriyāyāmevānvaya ityayamapi niyamo na dṛśaayate| `bhūtale na ghaṭaḥ' ityatra bhūtalavṛttitvābhāvavān ghaṭaḥ, athavā bhūtavṛttirghaṭābhāva ityarthabodhātkārakādhikāravihitādhikaraṇasya nañarthābhāva evānvayapratīteḥ, bhūtale ghaṭa ityatra bhūtalādheyatvavān, bhūtalavṛttirvā ghaṭa ityarthabodhādadhikaraṇakārakasya nāmārtha evānvayaparyavasānādityarthaḥ| evaṃ vatyarthasādṛśyasya saptamyarthasyādhikaraṇakārakasya cānuśāsanamanādṛtya nāmārthānvayāṅgīkāreṇa tayoḥ sādhutvaṃ svīkurudhve cettadatyantāyuktamityāhatyajyatāmiti| caturthyāḥ spṛhīti| puṣpebhya iti caturthyantamātraprayoge spṛhayatītiśabdādhyāhāra eva spṛherīpsita iti vihitacaturthyāḥ sādhutvārthamanusriyate, na tu tatsamānārthakaghātvantaraghaṭitapadādhyāhāro, nāpyarthādhyāhāro naiyāyikaistattyajyatām| anuśāsanavirodhasya taulyādityarthaḥ| ardhajaratīyamiti| ardhaṃ jaratyā ardhajaratī, tatsadṛśamardhajaratīyam| samāsācca tadviṣayāditīvārthe chapratyayaiti vyācakṣate| kiṃtvatrārdhajaratītyekadeśisamāsasyevārthaviṣayatvaṃ kathamiti cintyam| ekadeśisamāsottaraṃ gahāditvādidamarthe cha iti vyākhyāne'pi ekadeśisamāsasya pūrvapadārthapradhānatvājjaratyā ardhasyedamityarthaḥ syātsa tu neṣṭaḥ, kiṃ tu jaratyā ardhamidamityardhasyedaṃśabdasya ca sāmānādhikaraṇyamabhīṣṭaṃ na syādataḥ śivabhāgavata ityatreva yugapad‌vṛttiḥ karaṇīyā| atra śivabhagavacchabdayoḥ pūrvaṃ karmadhāraye kṛte tatastaddhitavṛttau śaivabhagavata iti syāt| ādau taddhitavṛttyā bhāgavataṃ saṃsādhya paścācchivena samāsavivakṣāyāṃ śivasya bhagavatyanvayo na syāt| ntargatatvena bhagavacchabdārthasyaikadeśatvātpadārthaḥ padārtheneti nyāyāt| atastatra śivabhagavacchabdayorbhagavadapatyārthayośca yugapad‌vṛttidvaye kṛte śivasya bhagavato'patyamiti vṛttyarthāvabodhakaṃ vākyaṃ bhavati| tadvajjaratyā ardhenedamarthena ca saṃbandhavivakṣāyāṃ yugapad‌vṛttidvaye kṛte jaratyā idamardhamiti vṛttyarthāvabodhakavākye idamardhaśabdayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ sidhyati| jaratyā idamiti jaratīyaṃ, ardhaṃ ca tajjaratīyaṃ ceti karmadhāraye kṛta idaṃtvena vivakṣitaṃ yajjaratīsaṃbandhi, tadardhamityarthabodhānniruktarītyā'pi ardhedaṃśabdayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ nirvoḍhuṃ śakyam| tataśca yathā jaratyā idamardhaṃ kāmayate, idaṃ netyayuktaṃ tathā kvacitpāṇinyanuśāsanamanustrayate, kvacittyajyate cetyetadapyardhajaratīyasādṛśyādatyantāyuktamiti bhāvaḥ|| 18 ||
evamiti| yathā niruktāṣ‍ṭakasya kriyayauvānvayastatetyarthaḥ| atrā''diśabdena ktvātumunādīnāṃ saṃgrahaḥ| bhāvārthagrahaṇam| inyādīnāmiti| atrā''diśabdena ktvātumunādīnāṃ saṃgrahaḥ| kriyayaiveti| guṇabhūtayā'pi kriyayaivetyarthaḥ| evakāraṇaṃ liṅgasaṃkhaayādyanvayidravyavyavacchedaḥ| anvayaḥ saṃbandha ityarthaḥ| tadāhaavigrahā gatādisthā iti| vivicyeti| viśeṣaṇatāmanāpadyetyarthaḥ| diśeṣyatayeti yāvat| na grahaṇaṃ yasyā ityarthaḥ| etatphalitamāhaguṇībhūteti itaraviśeṣaṇatāpannetyarthaḥ| grāmaṃ gata iti| gam‌dhātorgatyarthākarmaketi kartariktaḥ| prakṛtipratyayārthayoriti ktapratyayārthaḥ kartā viśeṣyaḥ| tadviśeṣaṇaṃ prakṛtyarthaḥ purodeśasaṃyogānukalo vyāpāraḥ| saṃyogānukūlavyāpārāśraya ityarthaḥ| tatra ktapratyayārthakartṛviśeṣaṇībhūtavyāpārajanyasaṃyogāśrayatvena grāmaniṣṭhasaṃyogānukūlavyāpārāśrayaścaitra iti bodhaḥ| tatheti| yathā grāmaṃ gata ityatra ktapratyayārthakartāraṃ prati viśeṣaṇībhūtā gamanakriyā grāmarūpakarmaṇā saṃbadhyate tathā kṛtapūrvītyatrenyarthakartāraṃ prati viśeṣaṇībhūtā kṛdhātvarthakriyā kaṭarūpakarmaṇā saṃbadhyata ityarthaḥ| kṛtapūrvīti| kaṭaḥ pūrvaṃ kṛto'neneti laukikavigrahaḥ| tatra pūrvamiti kriyāviśeṣamaṇam| kṛtapūrvaśabdayoḥ supsupeti samāsaḥ| anenatyanuvṛttau kṛtapūrvaśabdāt `pūrvādiniḥ, sapūrvācca' iti kartarīnipratbayaḥ| tatra karotikrayāpekṣayā kaṭasya karmatvātkaṭamiti dvitīyā| nanu kṛtaḥ kaṭaḥ pūrvamaneneti vigrahe kṛtaśabdasya pūrvaśabdena samāso na saṃbhavati| kṛtaśabdasya kaṭasāpekṣatvena sāmarthyavirahāt| samāsābhāvādeva cenarapyasaṃbhavaḥ| kiṃ ca kṛta iti ktapratyayena kaṭasya karmaṇo'bhihatatvāttato dvitīyā na prāpnotīti cenna| kṛtaam pūrvaam ityalaukikavigrahavākye kaṭasyāsaṃnihitatayā karmatvenānvayāsaṃbhavena kṛñ‌dhātostadānīmakarmakatayā karmaṇi ktapratyayasyāsaṃbhave sati `napuṃsake bhāve ktaḥ' iti bhāve ktapratyaye sati kṛtaśabdasya kaṭasāpekṣatvābhāvātsamāsa iniśca nirbādhau| karmaṇo'bhihitatvābhāvāśca| tataśca kṛtapūrvīti innantasya pūrvakālikakriyākartā `pūrvaṃ kṛtavān' ityarthaḥ paryavasyati| tataḥ karmatvavivakṣayā kiṃ kṛtavān? iti karmajijñāsāyāṃ kaṭasya karotikriyāpekṣayā karmatvāttato dvitīyā| kaṭaniṣṭhakarmatvaṃ ca na ktapratyayenābhihitaṃ, tasya bhāve vidhānāt| nāpīninā, tasya kartari vidhānāt| nanu kaṭamityatra dvitīyāṃ bādhitvā kartṛkarmaṇoriti ṣaṣṭhī syātkaॉdyogasattvāditi śaṅkyam| na ca niṣṭhāyoge niṣedhādeva ṣaṣṭhī na bhavediti vācyam| `napuṃsake bhāve ktasya yoge ṣaṣṭhyā upasaṃkhaayānam' iti vārtikavacanena niṣṭhāyoge ṣaṣṭhīniṣedhasyātrāprasakteriti cenna| tatra kṛd‌grahaṇasāmarthyād vṛttyantarbhāvānāpannakṛdyogasya ṣaṣṭhīprayojakatvāṅgīkārāt| prakṛte ca kṛtetyasya taddhitakvṛttyantarbhūtatvānna tadyogaḥ ṣaṣṭhīprayojakaḥ| tathā ca ṣaṣṭhyabhāve uktarītyā karmaṇo'nabhihitatvād‌dvitīyā sulabhaiva| evaṃ ca kaṭaṃ kṛtavānityatreva kaṭamiti karmaṇa ityarthakartāraṃ prati viśeṣaṇībhūtayaiva karotikriyayā'nvayaḥ| kārakaprakārakabodhaṃ pratītyādiniruktakāryakāraṇabhāvānusārādityarthaḥ| kaṭaniṣṭhotpattyanukūlapūrvakālikakriyākarteti, ekakaṭābhinnāśrayikā yotpattistadanukūlavyāpāravāniti kṛtapūrvīkaṭamityasmādbodhaḥ| inyādibhiriti| inyādyarthakartrādibhirguṇabhūteti yojanā| inyathaṃkartāraṃ prati guṇabhūtā karotikriyā kaṭakarmaṇā saṃbadhyata ddati yāvat| athavā svavācakaprakṛtikaktapratyayārthaṃ prati viśeṣaṇabhūtā karotikriyā inyarthakartrā saṃbadhyate, iti vyākhyeyam| svaṃkriyā, tadvācakaḥ kṛghātuḥ, tatprakṛtikaḥ ktapratyayaḥ, tadartho bhāvaḥ, sa ca liṅgasaṃkhyādyanvitastaṃ prati guṇabhūtā karotikriyeti lakṣaṇasaṃgatiḥ| ktapratyayārthabhāvanirūpitaviśeṣaṇabūtakarotikriyānirūpitamityarthasya kartṛtvamiti yāvat| tena `kartrādau vihitānāminyādīnāṃ kriyayaivānvayaḥ' ityavataraṇagranthānuguṇyaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| nanu gata ityādau kṛd‌vṛttisattvena vṛttau caikārthībhāvarūpasamudāyaśaktyaṅgīkāreṇa gatapadārthaikadeśagamanakriyāyāṃ grāmādikarmaṇāmanvayo durvacaḥ, tatra gamanakriyāyāḥ padārthaikadeśatvādityāśaṅkatena cetyādi| vṛttimātra iti| mātraṃ kārtsnye'vadhāraṇa iti kośānmātraśabdo'tra kṛtsnārthakaḥ| kṛtsnavṛttiṣvityarthaḥ| vakṣyamāṇatvāditi| samāse khalu bhinnaiva śaktiḥityanena vṛttimātropalakṣakasamāsagrahaṇātkṛttaddhitasamāsaikaśeṣasanādyantadhaāturūpāsu pañcasvapi vṛttiṣvekāryobhāvarūpāyāḥ samudāyaśaktervakṣyamāṇatvādityarthaḥ| kathaṃ tatrānvaya iti| padārthaḥ padārthenānveti na tu padārthaiṃkadeśeneti niyamātpadārthaikadeśavyāpāre grāmakarmaṇo'nvayaḥ kathamityākṣepa ityarthaḥ| tathā cāsaṃgatamidaṃ dṛṣṭāntopanyasanamiti bhāvaḥ| samādhattenityasāpekṣeṣvityādi| nityaṃ saṃbandhyantarasāpekṣeṣu śabdeṣu upasarjanatayā vṛttighaṭakeṣu satsvapi teṣu vṛttyekadeśabhūteṣveva tannirūpitaviśeṣaṇasya devadattāderanvayo bhavati| yorājā, ṛddhasya yo rājeti vetyarthabodhājananam| rājño yaḥ puruṣaḥ sa ṛddhasaṃbandhītyeva tatra bodhāt| tacca pratibandhakaṃ nityasāpekṣeṣu nāstītyarthaḥ| taduktaṃ vākyapadīyesaṃbandhiśabdaḥ sāpekṣo śabdaḥ samasyate, samāsaghaṭake ca tasminviśeṣaṇānvayo bhavati, bhavati ca devadattasya yo gururityādyarthaboghaḥ, tādṛśārthabodhānantaramevā''kāṅkṣānivṛtteriti tadarthaḥ| pare tu bhoktuṃ pākaḥ, bhoktuṃ gata ityādyasādhveva| yatra kārye kriyāvācakaśabdaśya grahaṇaṃ tatra prādhānyena sādhyamātrāvasthakriyāvācino grahaṇāt| yatra tu kriyārūpārthasya grahaṇaṃ tatra bhavati| avānṛtavadane'pravṛttiḥ puruṣe upakārastad‌dvārotpatsyamānanarakādyaniṣṭapratibandha eva phalamityevaṃrītyā'nṛtavadananiṣedhasya puruṣārthatvameva sidhyenna kratvarthatvam| tathā ca puruṣakartṛkānṛtavadane sati puruṣasyaiva pratyavāyaḥ, na kratoriti kratāvanṛtavadane katubhreṣaprāyaścittānuṣṭhānarūpasakalayājñikamīmāṃsakācāravirodha āpatedityarthaḥ| nanu nānṛtamiti niṣedhe prakaraṇaprāptasya kratvarthatvasya śrutivirodhe sati bādhyatve kiṃ pramāṇamiti ceducyateaṅgapradhānasaṃbandhabodhakaviniyogavidheḥ sahakāribhūtāni śrutyādīni ṣaṭ pramāṇāni| tatra parasparaviruddhayoḥ pramāṇayorekatropastitau mitho virodhātsamuccayāsaṃbhavenakena dvitīyasya bādho vaktavyaḥ, sa ca valīyaptā durbalasyeti lokaprasiddhamiti śrutyādiṣaṇṇāṃ gadhye kasya balīyastvaṃ kasya ca durbalatvamiti jijñāsāyāṃ `śrutiliṅgavākyaprakaraṇasthānasamākhyānāṃ samavāye pāradaurbalyamarthaviprakarṣāt' iti sūtrayāṃbabhūva bhagavāñjaiminimaharṣiḥ| śrutyādīnāṃ viniyojakānāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ pramāṇānāṃ madhye viruddhayordvayorekatra saṃnipāte pāradaurbalyaṃ paraṃ paraṃ pūrvapūrvād durvaṃlaṃ pūrveṇottarasya bādhaḥ| tatra hetuḥarthaviprakarṣāt, uttarapramāṇasya pūrvapramāṇakalpakatvādarthasya viniyogasyāṅgāṅgitvanirṇayasya viprakarṣādvilambāditi tadarthaḥ| atrottarottarasya durbalatvoktyā pūrvapūrvasya balīyastvaṃ sūcitam| tatra nirapekṣo ravaḥ śrutiḥ| ravaḥ śabdaḥ| kasyacitkvicidviniyoge kartavye yaḥ śabdo viniyojakaṃ pramāṇāntaraṃ nāpekṣate sa śabdaḥ śrutirityucyate| sā hi kasyacitkvacidviniyoge kartavye svottaravartiliṅgadipramāṇapañcakamadhye kimapi nāpekṣate| liṅgādīni pañca viniyojakapramāṇāni tu svasvapūrvavartiyāvatpramāṇāpekṣayaiva viniyogaṃ kurvanti| atasteṣu liṅgādiṣvativyāptivāraṇāya śrutilakṣaṇe nirapekṣa ityuktam| tatra śrutiliṅgayorvirodhe śrutiprābalyodāharaṇaṃ ayamaindrī ṛk| indro devatā'syā ityaindrī| asyāḥ śruterindrarūpārthaprakāśanasāmarthyaṃ dṛśyate| tena ca liṅgenaindryendramupatiṣṭhate iti śrutimanumāya tādṛśānumitaśrutyā'syāṛca indropasthāne niviyogo liṅgapramāṇena saṃbhavati| paraṃ tu aindryā gārhapatyamiti niruktapratyaśrutyā'smā ṛco gārhapatyopasthāne viniyogasya kṛtatvātpratyakṣaśruteścānumitaśrutyapekṣayā balavattvād‌gārhapatyopasthāne viniyogo bhavati| kadācana starīrasīti mantre indraśabdaḥ `idi paramaisvarye' iti dhātvarthānusārātparamaiśvaryaguṇayogena yajñasādhanatvena vā gārhapatyābhidāyako gārhapatyamiti dvitīyā ca viniyokvī śrutiḥ| tatra tṛtīyayā aindryā ṛca upasthānāṅgatvaṃ pratipādyate| dvitīyayā ca gārhapatyasyopasthānāṅgitvaṃ bodhyate| gṛhapatinā saṃyukto gārhapatyo'gniḥ| `gṛhapatinā saṃyukte ñyaḥ'iti sūtreṇa gṛhapatiśabdāt ñyapratyayaḥ| evaṃ sthite yadatra śrutipramāṇena liṅgapramāṇaṃ bādhyate tatrevaṃ yuktirdṛśyateviniyojakeṣu paṭ‌su pramāṇeṣu sākṣādviniyojikā śrutireva| ataḥ śrutiḥ pramāṇamūrdhanyabhūteti sarvairvyavahriyate| liṅgādīni pañca pramāṇāni tu na sākṣādviniyojakāni| arthaprakāśanasāmarthaayaṃ liṅgamityucyate| yathā kadācana starīrasīti mantrasyendrarūpārthaprakāśanasāmarthyam| paraṃ tu tādṛśasāmarthyānusāriṇī `aindryendramupatiṣṭhate' ityevaṃ viniyojikā śrutiryāvanna jñāyate tāvalliṅgamakiṃcitkarameva| ataḥ kadācana starīriti mantrasya kva viniyoga ityevamutpannākāṅkṣā, aindramantrasya kvacitkarmaṇi viniyogasādhanāya svapuraskṛte liṅgapramāṇe svabhāvato vidyamānāṃ prakalpakatvaśaktimuttejayati| tatastalliṅgaṃ svānuguṇāṃ `aindryendramupatiṣṭhate' ityevaṃ viniyojikāṃ śrutiṃ kalpayati| tayā ca śrutyā tatra viniyoga iti liṅgapramāṇaṃ śrutidvārā paramparayā viniyojakam| evaṃ ca śrutiḥ svābhidheyaṃ pratipādya dbitīyakṣaṇa eva viniyuṅkte| liṅgaṃ tu mantrapadānyādau svābhidheyamarthaṃ pratipādayanti| tata ūrdhvaṃ mantrasya sāmarthyaṃ nirūpyate| (nāmamantrasyendraviṣayakakriyāsādhanatvamavagamyate)paścātsāmarthyāvaśātsādhanatvavācinī(aibdramantreṇetyevaṃ tṛtīyā vibhaktiḥ)sādhyatvavācinī(indramityevaṃ dvitīyāvibhaktiḥ) ca śrutiḥ(vibhaktirūpā)kalpyate| sā ca śrutiḥ `aindramantreṇendramupatiṣṭhate' ityevaṃ viniyuṅkta iti caturthakṣaṇaparyantaṃ vilambate| tathā sati pratyakṣaśrutau svāmidheyapratipādanaviniyogayormadhyavartinau sāmarthyanirūpaṇakṣutikalpanavyāpārau na staḥ| evaṃ ca śrutipramāṇena jāyamāno viniyogaḥ sākṣādeva jāyata ityavyavahitaḥ| liṅgapramāṇena jāyamāno viniyogastu śrutiṃ kalpayitvā tad‌dvārā jāyata ityekāntaritaḥ| evaṃ vākyādipramāṇena jāyamāno viniyogo liṅgādi ca śrutiṃ ca kalpayitvā jāyata iti dvitryādyantariti atyūhyam| yathā yathā ca pramāṇasya viniyoge vyavadhānādhikyaṃ tathā tathā tasya durbalatvam| vilambena viniyojakaṃ yatpramāṇaṃ tadapekṣayā śaighryeṇa viniyojakasya pramāṇasya prāḥ balyaṃ yuktyaiva siddhaṃ bhavati| liṅgādyuttarapramāṃ hi svāpekṣayā yāvanti pūrvapramāṇāni tāvanti krameṇa parikalpya tad‌dvārā viniyogaṃ bodhayati| tena caikatrānekapramāṇasaṃvanipāta uttarasya pūrvaṃ bādhakaṃ bhavati| uttarapramāmasya bodho nāma tatrāpravṛttireva| yata uttarapramāṇena vākyena svāpekṣayā pūrvavṛttipramāṇajātaṃ (liṅgaśruti) parikalpya kiṃcidarthaṃ kutracidviniyoktaṃ yadā pravartitavya tadā pūrvavṛttipramāṇajātasya (liṅgaśrutyorya) ātmasvarūpalābhastasmātprāgeva pūrvapramāṇena (liṅgena śrutyā vāḥ so'rthaḥ kutracidviniyojyate| jāte ca viniyoge kva viniyogaḥ, ityākāṅkṣāyā nivṛttatvāduttarapramāṇa(vākya)gatā liṅgādiprakalpakatvaśaktireva vyāhatā jāyata iti sarvathā vyāpāroparamāttatra tasyāpravṛttiriti| evaṃ ca indrarūpārthaprakāśanasāmarthyarūpeṇa liṅgapramāṇena śrutikalpanadvārā yāvadaindramantrasyendropasthāne viniyogaḥ kartavyasyāvat `aindryā gārhapatyamiti pratyakṣayā tṛtīyāśrutyā, aindramantreṇendramitiśrutikalpanātprāgeva aindryā ṛco gārhapatyopasthāne viniyogasya kṛtatvālliṅgapramāṇagatā kalpakatvaśaktireva vyāhanyata iti pratyakṣaśruterbalavattvāttayā liṅgaṃ bādhyate| evaṃ prakṛte nānṛtaṃ vadedityatrā''khyātaśrutyā karturabhidhāne sati, ubhayākāṅkṣārūpaprakaraṇapramāṇena vākyaliṅgaśrutīḥ kalpiyitvā nānṛtamityasya yāvaddarśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇe viniyogaḥ kartavyastāvad vadedityekapadarūpayā śrutyā nānṛtamityasya kartari puruṣe viniyogasya kṛtatvāt kva viniyogaḥ, ityākāṅkṣāyā nivṛttatvāt prakaraṇapramāṇaniṣṭhā vākyaliṅgādiprakalpatvaśaktirvyāhanyata iti śruterbalavattvāttayā prakaraṇapramāṇaṃ bādhyate| tathā cānṛtavadanakriyāniṣedhāśrayaḥ kartetibodhānnānṛtaṃ vadoditi niṣedhasya puruṣārthatvameva syānna kratvarthatvayityāśaṅkya samādhātumāhaiti cenneti| mīmāṃsakamatenā''khyātena bhāvanāyā kartuḥ puruṣasyābhidhīyamānatve'pi nānṛtamiti niṣedhasya na puruṣārthatvaṃ saṃbhavatītyāhatiṅarthastvityādi| ayaṃ bhāvaḥlaḥ karmaṇītyādiśāstraprāmāṇyādākhyātena(tibādipratyayena karturabhidhāne'pi na tasya prādhānyam| bhāvodhātvarthaḥphalavyāpārānyatarūpaḥ, pradhānaṃ yatreti bahuvrīhiḥ| tiṅantaṃ cānyapadārthaḥ| tathā ca tiṅantaṃ bhāvapradhānakaṃtiṅarthaniṣṭhaprakāratānirūpitadhātvarthaniṣṭhaviśeṣyatāśālibodhajanakamityarthakād `bhāvapradhānamākhyātam' iti niruktavacanād‌vyapārarūpabhāvanāyāḥ prādhānyasya, tiṅarthakartrāderviśeṣaṇatvasya cāvagamāt| tataśca prakṛtipratyayārthayoḥ pratyayārthasya prādhānyamiti nyāyasya saṃkoco'vaśyaṃ svīkāryaḥ| tathā ca prakṛtītiṅ‌bhinnapratyayārthayormadhye pratyayārthasya prādhānyamityarthattiṅante'yaṃ nyāyo na pravartate| evaṃ cā''khyātavācyakarturdhātvarthavyāpārātmakabhāvanāṃ prati viśeṣaṇatvādviśeṣaṇasya ca viśeṣyaparatantratvānmama viśeṣaṇaṃ kimiti viśeṣaṇākāṅkṣānudayād' guṇānāṃ ca parārthatvādasaṃbandhaḥ samatvātsyāt'  iti nyāyena nānṛtamiti niṣedhasyāṅgatve(viśeṣaṇatve)na saṃbandho viśeṣaṇabhūte kartari na saṃbhavatītyāhana hi guṇabhūta iti| viśeṣya evāṅgitvasya nyāyyatvādviśeṣaṇe(kartari)nānṛtamiti niṣedhasya viseṣaṇatvena saṃbandhe kṛte viśeṣaṇe(kartari)pradhānyamaprādhānyaṃ cetyekasminviruddhaddhayamāpadyeteti na viśeṣaṇe viśeṣaṇatvena padārthāntarasaṃbandhaḥ kartuṃ yujyate| tadāhaguṇabhūtaḥ kartā niṣedhaṃ svāṅgatvena grahītuṃ nālaṃ na samartha iti| itaraviśeṣaṇatvenopasthite viśeṣaṇatvena padārthāntarānvayasya viruddhatvādeva somena yajetatyatra yāgena bhāvayedityevamākhyātārthabhāvanāyāṃ yāgasya viśeṣaṇatvenānvaye kṛte tādṛśe tatraiva punaḥ somena yāgaṃ bhāvayadityevaṃ somasya viśeṣyatvenānvayo nirākṛto mīmāṃsakaiḥ| nanu dhātvarthabhāvanā'pi kathaṃ niṣedaṃ gṛh‌ṇīyāttasyā api ākhyātārthakartṛsaṃbandhitvādityata āhabhāvanā tviti| pradhānamiti| yato bhāvanā tiṅarthakartāraṃ prati praghānaṃviśeṣyabhūtā'tastasyā viśeṣaṇatvena nañarthaniṣedhe'nvaye bādhakābhāvātsā niṣedhaṃ grahītuṃ samarthaiva| ayaṃ bhāvaḥvadedityatra dhātvarthavadanakriyāṃ prati tiṅarthaḥ kartā viśeṣaṇaṃ vadanakriyā ca viśeṣyaṃ, kartṛniṣṭhā vadanakriyeti bodhaḥ| anṛtamiti vadanasya viśeṣaṇaṃanṛtavadanakriyetyarthaḥ| tādṛśānṛtavadanakriyāyāḥ pradhānabhūtāyā nañarthe viśeṣaṇatayā'nvayaḥ| tathāca kartṛniṣṭhānṛtavadanākriyāniṣedha ityarthe saṃpanne kimartho'yaṃ niṣedha iti niṣedhasya kaimarthyākāṅkṣāyāṃ prakaraṇapramāṇādvākyaliṅgaśrutiḥ kalpayitvā tad‌dvārā niṣedhasya darśapūrṇamāsaprakaraṇe viniyogātkratvarthataiva sidhyatītyarthaḥ| nanvevaṃ rītyā na hiṃsyātsarvā bhūtāni, na kalañjaṃ bhakṣayedityādiniṣedhānāmapi śrutyā puruṣārthatvaṃ na syāt, śrutyupasthitasya kartuḥ kriyāṃ prati viśeṣaṇatvāt| yadi tu na kalañjamityādiniṣedhasthale'nyasyāṅgino'saṃbhavādviśeṣaṇabhūtakarturapi niṣedho'ṅgaṃ bhavatītyucyate tarhi, itaraviśeṣaṇatvenopasthite'rthe viśeṣaṇatvenetarārthānanvaya iti pūrvoktaniyamasya vyabhicārema nānṛtaṃ vedadityatrāpi niṣedhaḥ karturaṅgaṃ syādata āhaastu vedyādi| kratuyuktapuruṣadharma iti| ākhyātasya kartṛvācakatve padaśrutyā nānṛtaṃ vadediti niṣedhasya puruṣārthatvaṃ prāpnoti, prakaraṇena ca kratvarthatvam| tatraikasyaiva kasyacitkvacidviniyogārthaṃ prāptayordviyoḥ pramāṇayoryadyavirodhaḥ saṃbhavati tarhi tatra virodhakalpanamanyāyyam| virodhe hi balābalavicāreṇa prabalena durbalasya bādhaḥ kartavyo bhavatīti māhagauravam| avirodha tu kasyāpyabādhenobhayoḥ samāveśaiti lāghavam| prakṛte nānṛtamiti niṣedhaṃ viniyoktaṃ prasaktayoḥ śrutiprakaraṇayormadhye śrutistaṃ puruṣe viniyuṅkte, prakaraṇaṃ tu kratāviti virodho bhāsate tathā'pi sa ābhāsa eva| yataḥ kratāvapi puruṣasaṃbhavena śrutiprakaraṇayoravirodhe sati ubhābhyāṃ kratuyuktapuruṣadharmatvaṃ niṣedhasyetyavagamyate, śrutiprakaraṇābhyāmekavākyatayā niṣedhe kratuyuktaḥ puruṣo'ṅ‌gitvena samarpyata iti yāvat| tathā ca kratusaṃyuktapuruṣakartṛkānṛtavadananiṣedha iti bodhānniṣedhaḥ sākṣātpuruṣasyāṅūge, kratostu paramparayā niṣedho'ṅgamiti| yathā svayaṃ guṇabhūtaḥ sevako rājānaṃ pradhānaṃ manyate, tasyāpi rājño yadguṇabhūtaṃ putrakalatrādi tadapyasau svapradhānamiti manyate tadvadityarthaḥ| nanu yadyayaṃ niṣedhaḥ kratuyuktapuruṣārthaḥ syāttārhi kratau karturyajamānasya mukhaayatvāttenaivānṛtavadananiṣedhaḥ saṃlagno bhavediti yajamānenavānṛtavadaniṣedhaḥ paripālatīyo bhavennartvigādibhirityanuṣṭhāne vaiṣamyaṃ syādityanusaṃdhāyā''haanuṣṭhāne viśeṣābhāvāditi| puruṣasya kratuyuktatvena viśeṣaṇātkratuyuktaḥ kratusaṃbaddho yaḥ puruṣastatkartṛkaṃ yadanṛtavadanaṃ tasya niṣedha ityarthādyathā yajamānaḥ kratunā saṃvaddhastathartvigādirapi kratunā saṃbaddha iti kratusaṃbaddhatvāviśeṣādyajamānavaṭṭatvigādibhirapyanṛtavadanaṃ varjanīyamityanuṣṭhāne viśeṣābhāva ityarthaḥ| yadi tu yuktaśabdasthāne kartṛpadaṃ prakṣipya kratukartṛpuruṣakartṛkānṛtavadanaviṣedhaḥkratoryaḥ kartā puruṣo yajamānastatkartṛkānṛtavadananiṣedha ityucyeta tadā yajamānavyatiriktartvigadināmanṛtavadananiṣedhāprasaktyā yajamānenānṛtavadanaṃ varjyaṃ na tadanyairṛtvigbirityanuṣṭhāne viśeṣaḥ saṃjāyeta, tathā viśeṣo mā bhūdityākalayyaiva kratuyuktapuruṣetyuktaṃ mūla iti bhūṣaṇasārakarturabhiprāyo bodhyaḥ|
ekasyaiva niviyoge prasaktayordvayorviruddhapramāṇayoravirodhasaṃpādanena kratuyuktapuruṣadharmatvasamarthane mīmāṃsakābhimataṃ dṛṣṭāntamāhajañjabhyamāno'nubrūyāditi| jañjabhyamāno'nubrūyānmayi dakṣakratū iti darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ śrutam| jañjabhyamāna ityatra jabhadhātorbhāvagarhāyāṃ yaṅ, tataḥ kartari śānac| `jabhī jṛbhi gātravināme' iti pāṇinismṛtergātravināmena vidāritamukha iti tadarthaḥ| tatra kimayaṃ mantrapāṭhaḥ puruṣamuddiśya vidhīyate'thavā kratumuddiśyeti saṃdihya vākyapramāṇena tāvajjajjabhyamānapuruṣadharmatvenāyaṃ pratīyate, śānacā kṛtpratyayena kartuḥ prādhānyenābhidhīyamānatvāt| prakaraṇapramāṇena tu kratvaṅ‌gatvena pratīyate, vākyaṃ ca prakaraṇād‌balīyaḥ, tasmātpuruṣadharmo'yamiti pūrvapakṣayitvāvākyaprakaraṇābyāmaviruddhābhyāṃ kratuyuktapuruṣasaṃkāradvārā kratvartho'yamiti siddhāntitaṃ jaiminīye tṛtīyādhyāye caturthapāde pañcame jañjabhyamānādhikaraṇe| na ca prakaraṇādvākyaliṅge śrutiṃ ca kalpayitvā tayā śrutyā caturthakṣaṇe viniyogaḥ kartavyaḥ, tataḥ prāgeva vākyālliṅgaṃ śrutiṃ ca kalpayitvā tayā śrutyā tṛtīyakṣaṇa eva viniyogasya kṛtvātpuruṣārthatvanirṇayena kva viniyoga ityākāṅkṣāyā virahānna kratāvapyanvayaḥ sidhyatīti vācyam| tathā sati pramāmayorvirodhaḥ syāt| virodhe ca balavatā durbalaṃ bādhanīyam| tacca na nyāyyam| avādhenopapattau bādhasyānyāyyatvāditi nyāyāt| tasmādvākyapramāṇena yadetanmantrānuvacanaṃ jañjabhyamānapuruṣāṅgatvena vihitaṃ tatra so'ṅgī jañjabhyamānapuruṣo nāsaṃbaddhaḥ, kiṃ tu kratusaṃbaddho grāhya ityetatprakaraṇapramāṇasāhāyyena pratipādyate| tena iti vaiyākaraṇabhūṣaṇasāravyākhyāyāṃ śāṃkaryaṃ dhātvākhyātayoḥ sāmānyārthasya nirupaṇam|| 1 ||
raṅgabhaṭṭatanūjasya śaṃkarasya vinirmitau| pūrṇaḥ sārīyaṭīkāyāṃ dhātvākhyātārthanirṇayaḥ|| 1 ||

atha lakāraviśeṣārthanirūpaṇam||
viśeṣārthajijñāsāyāḥ sāmānyārthajñānapūrvakatvaniyamādākhyātasāmānyārthe nirūpite'vasarasaṃgatya lakāraviśeṣārthanirūpaṇamarabhata ityāha-pratyekamiti| ekaikasyetyarthaḥ| ekamekaṃ pratīti saṃgamayati-pacatītyādāviti| adhiśrayaṇāditi| adhiśrayaṇaṃ-cullyupari sthālīsthāpanaṃ, ādiryasya, adhaḥśrayaṇaṃ-cullyā, sakāśātsthālyavatāraṇaṃ, anto yasyeti bahuvrīhidvaye kṛte sati karmadhārayaḥ| kriyāsamūho'nyapadārthaḥ| karmadhāraye'pi sa samūha eva viśeṣyaḥ| tādṛśasamūhāntargatamadhye ityarthaḥ| tattatphalānukūlavyāpārārambhakṣaṇasamāptikṣaṇayorantarāle iti yāvat| tat-uktarūpaṃ vartamānatvamastīti laṭh‌prayogo bhavatītyarthaḥ| nanvātmā'sti parvatāḥ santītyādau laṭ‌prayogānupapattiḥ| tatrā''tmadhāraṇānukūlavyāpārasya nityatayā sthityādirūpāstāsāmanityatayā-utpattidhvaṃsaśālitayā tadviśiṣṭasya-anityarājakriyāviśiṣṭātmadhāraṇānukūvyāpārasyotpattyādikaṃ-utpattisamāptabhūtādikālabhedamādāya-ātmādiniṣṭhātmadhāraṇānukūlavyāpāre grāma-caitraitadubhayaniṣṭhatvāviśeṣe'pi grāmasaṃyogasya dvitīyāprakṛtyarthagrāmāpekṣayā paro yaścaitrastanniṣṭhavyāpārajanyatvena parasamavetakriyājanyaphalaśālitayā grāmasya karmatayā dvitīyā bhavati, caitrasaṃyogasya caitramiti dvitīyāprakṛtyarthacaitrāpekṣayā kartuścaitrasya paratvābhāvena parasamavetakriyājanyaphalaśālitvābhāvāt(svasamavetakriyājanyaphalaśālitvāt) na caitrasya ṅarmasaṃjñeti dvitīyā'prāpterna caitraścaitramiti prayogāpattiriti bhāvaḥ| tathaiva kāryakāraṇeti| dvitīyāvācyaparasamavetatvaprakārakaśābdabodhe jananīye dhātvarthakriyāyāḥ viśeṣyatayā dhātujanyopasthitiḥ kāraṇamityevaṃ kāryakāraṇabhāvārntarasvīkriyate| tena parasamavetatvaviśeṣaṇasya viśeṣyatāsaṃbandhena dhātvarthakriyāyāmanvayoktiryukteti bhāvaḥ| paratvaṃ ceti| dvitīyāvācyaparasamavetatvaghaṭakaparatvaṃ cetyarthaḥ| pratyāsattyā dvitīyāprakṛtyarthagramādyapekṣayā paratvaṃ gṛhyata ityarthaḥ| tataśacaitrastaṇḍulaṃ pacatītyādau taṇḍulasya karmatvasiddhyā yādṛśaḥ śābdabodho jāyate taṃ spaṣṭayati-taṇḍulānyeti| dvitīyāprakṛtyarthataṇḍulādyapekṣayā'nyo yaścaitrādiḥ kartā, tasminsamavāyasaṃbandhena vidyamāno yo vyāpārastajyanyaṃ, dhātuvācyatvasamānādhikaraṇaviśeṣaṇatāviśiṣṭaṃ ca yatphalaṃ viklittirūpaṃ tadāśrayatvāttaṇḍulasya karmasaṃjñā bhavati| caitraścaitramityatra tu dvitīyāprakṛtyarthacaitraniṣṭhasaṃyogānukūlavyāpārasya caitrānyaniṣṭhatvābhāvānna tādṛśaḥ prayogaḥ| tathā ca-taṇḍulasamavetetyādi śābdabodhākārapradarśanam| tadarthastu saṃkṣepata evam-taṇḍulaniṣṭhā, dhātuvācyā ca yā viklittistādṛśaviklittyanukūlastaṇḍulānyacaitraniṣṭho yo vyāpārastādṛśavyāpārānukūlā yā kṛtistādṛśakṛtimāṃścaitra iti| ayaṃ ca śābdabodho naiyaiyikamatena bodhyaḥ| tanmatavarṇanasyaivopakramāditi bhāvaḥ| prathamāntamukhyaviśeṣyakaḥ śābdabodhaḥ, phalānukūlo vyāpāro dhātvarthaḥ, lakārārthaśca kṛtiriti hi tatsiddhāntaḥ| tadetannaiyāyikamataṃ gauravagrastatvādayuktimityāha-tanneti| parasamavetatvāderiti| sūtrākṣarāsaṃspṛṣṭasyāta eva svakapolakalpitasya parasamavetatvasya dvitīyāvācyatvakalpane gauravādeḥ spaṣṭatvānna tasya dvitīyāvācyatvakalpanaṃ yuktamiti bhāvaḥ| nanu parasamavetatvasya gurūbhūtatve'pi dvitīyāvācyatvaṃ vinā dūṣaṇanirāsāsaṃbhavāttādṛśagauravasyādūṣakatvādityata āha-atiprasaṅgaḥ kimiti| dvitīyāyā iti| caitraścaitramiti prayogāpattirūpo'tiprasaṅga ityarthaḥ| nā''dya iti| parasamavetatvasya dvitīyāvācyatve kalpite caitraścaitramiti prayogāpattyasaṃbhave'pi anyatra dvitīyāpattirūpātiprasaṅgasya tadavasthatvāditi bhāvaḥ| tamevānyatrātiprasaṅgaṃ pradarśayati-pācayati kṛṣṇamiti| kṛṣṇenetyasya sthāne kṛṣṇamiti dvitīyāpatterityarthaḥ| atra prayojyaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ, prayojako gaupaḥ| tathā ca dvitīyāprakatyarthakṛṣṇāpekṣayā paro yo gopastatsamavetavyāpārajanyaṃ, ṇijantadhātuvācyaṃ sat ṇijarthavyāpāraviśeṣaṇātmakaṃ yatphalaṃ viklittayanukūlavyāpārarūpaṃ, tādṛśaphalaśālitvarūpakarmatvasya prayojye kṛṣṇe sattvātkṛṣṇapadād‌dvitīyāpattiḥ syādityarthaḥ| tataśca dvitīyāpravṛttau karmasaṃjñaiva nimittaṃ, na tūktaphalaśālitvamityaṅgīkaraṇīyam| yadi tu pācayatyādiyoge gatibuddhītiniyamāduktaphalasālinaḥ karmasaṃjñā na bhavatītyucyate tarhi tata eva dvitīyāpattivāraṇasaṃbhave'laṃ parasamavetatvasya dvitīyāvācyatvakalpanayeti bhāvaḥ| gokulaṃ kṛṣṇamiti dṛṣṭānte prayojyasya kṛṣṇasya prayojakaniṣṭhanijarthavyāpārajanyaphalaśālitvena yathā kṛṣmapadād dvitīyā bhavati tathā pācayatyādiyoge kṛṣṇamiti dvitīyā syādityartho bodhyaḥ| nanu parasamavetavyāpārajanyadātvarthatāvacchedakaphalaśālitvarūpameva karmatvaṃ dvitīyāpravṛttau nimittaṃ, na tu karmasaṃjñā| pācayati kṛṣṇena gopa ityatra dvitīyāprakṛtyarthakṛṣṇānyagopasamavetavyāpārajanyaghātvarthatāvacchedakaphalaśālitvarūpakarmatvasya prayojye kṛṣṇe sattve'pi gatibuddhīti sūtreṇaitatsūtropāttagatibuddhyādidhātuprakṛtika eva ṇijante parasamavetaietyādyuktakarmatvasya vivakṣā kartavyā, na gatyādyatiriktadhātuprakṛtikaṇijante pācayatyādāviti bodhanānna pācayati kṛṣṇaṃ gopa iti dvitīyāpattiḥ, karmatvādivivakṣayā eva vibhaktyutpattau nimittatvādata āha-taṇḍulaṃ pacyate svayameveti| karmakartari dvitīyāpattiḥ syādityarthaḥ| tatra dṛṣṭāntaṃ pradarśayannāha-taṇḍulaṃ pacatīti| dvitīyāprakṛtyarthataṇḍulāpekṣayā paro yaścaitrastatsamavetavyāpārajanyadhātvarthatāvacchedakaviklittirūpaphalaśālitvāttaṇḍulasya karmatvāttato yathā dvitīyā bhavati, viklittyanukūlavyāpārasya pac‌dhātvarthatvāt, phalavyāpāraitadubhayoḥ pacadhātuvācyatvāditi yāvaditi bhāvaḥ| evaṃ taṇḍulaḥ pacgate svayamevetyatra karmakartustaṇḍulasya, dvitīyāprakṛtyarthataṇḍulāpekṣayā paro yo'gnistatsamavetasaṃyogarūpavyāpārajanyadhātvarthatāvacchedakaviklittirūpaphalāśālitvād karmatayā tato dvitīyotpattau taṇḍulaṃ pacyate svayameveti prayogāpattiḥ syādityarthaḥ| tathā cātra viklittyanukūlāgnisaṃyogaḥ pac‌dhātvartho vivakṣitaḥ| viklittyagnisaṃyogaitadubhayoḥ pac‌dātuvācyatvaṃ vivakṣitamiti bhāvaḥ| tadāha-viklittyanukūlataṇḍulānyetyādi| dhātvarthāśrayatvāditi| agnisaṃyogarūpadhātvarthajanyaviklittirūpaphalāśrayatvādityarthaḥ| tasmād‌dvitīyāvibhaktyutpattau karmasaṃjñaiva nimittaṃ, na tu parasamavetetyādyuktarūpaṃ phalaśālitvamityaṅgīkartavyam| vibhaktyupattau karmādisaṃjñāyā nimittatve svīkṛte taṇḍulaḥ pacyate svayamevetyatra karmakartustaṇḍulasya karmasaṃjñāyāḥ prāptāvapi parayā kartṛsaṃjñayā tadvādhānna dvitīyāpattiḥ, kiṃ tu prathamaiveti na kaściddoṣa ityāśayaḥ| atrāgnisaṃyogo dhātvarthatvena vivakṣita ityāśrityaivedaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ bodhyam| yadi tu karmakartari viklittyanukūlataṇḍulamātraniṣṭhavyāpārasya, phalamātrasya vā dhātvarthatvamucyate tadā nedaṃ dūpaṇaṃ bhavatīti jñeyam| nanvevaṃ caitraścaitramiti prayogāpattirūpadoṣāsaṃbhave'pi caitro gacchatītyataścaitrakartṛkaṃ caitrakarmakaṃ gamanamiti śābdabodhāpattiriti cedāha-śābdabodhātiprasaṅgopīti| uktarītyaiveti| tathā vyutpannānāṃ, ucyatāṃ vā---kāryakāraṇabhāvāntaram, ityādyuktaprakārerṇaiva nirasta ityarthaḥ| kiṃ ca parasamavetatvasya dvitīyāvacyatve'ṅgīkṛte'pi dvitīyāprakṛtyarthapratiyogikameva paratvaṃ, nānyapratiyogikaṃ, parasamavetatvasya dhātvarthakriyāyāmevānvayaḥ, na phale, ityevaṃ niyamadvayalābhāya tādṛśatādṛśakāryakāraṇabhāvāntarakalpane gauravādhikyasyānivāryatvātsarvathā'yuktaṃ tārkikamatamiti bhāvaḥ|
vākyapadīyoktaṃ karmaṇo vibhāgamāha-etacceti| dhātvarthavyāpārajanyaphalāśrayarūpaṃ karma cetyarthaḥ| saptavidhamiti| saptaprakārakamityarthaḥ| tāneva sapta prakārān darśayati-nirvartyaṃ yetyādinā| yat-īpsitatamaṃ karma, tat-nirvartyaṃ, vikāryaṃ, prāpyaṃ ceti tridhā matamityanvayaḥ| anyattviti| īpsitatamabhinnaṃ tvityarthaḥ| caturdheti-caturvidhamityarthaḥ| caturvidhatvameva
