saṃjñāntarairanākhyātam-apādānādisaṃjñādibhiravivakṣataṃ, akathitaṃ ceti sūtravihitaṃ karma, tattṛtīyamityarthaḥ| anyapūrvakamiti| anyasaṃjñāprāptau satyāṃ karmasaṃjñakam| yathā krūramabhikrudhyatītyatra krudhadruherṣyeti saṃpradānasaṃjñā prāptā krudhadruhorupasṛṣṭayoriti vihitakarmasaṃjñakam| taccaturthamityarthaḥ| atra caturvidhatvapradarśanamātre tātparyaṃ, na tu prathamadvitīyādikramavarmane| nirvartyādikarmatrayasya lakṣaṇamāha-yadasaditi| naiyāyikamate utpatteḥ prāgasata eva ghaṭādikāryasyotpattirjāyate iti tanmatenedaṃ nirvartyakarmalakṣaṇam| sāṃkhyamatenā''ha-sadveti| tanmate hi sata eva ghaṭādikāryasya janmanā prakāśo jāyate| prakṛtyacchedeti| dvividhavikāryakarmamadhye kiṃcidekaṃ prakṛtibhūtasyā''tmanaḥ kāṣṭhāderityarthaḥ, ucchedaṃ-nāśaṃ, saṃbhūtaṃ prāptaṃ, bhūprāptāvityasmātkartari ktaḥ| kiṃcittu guṇāntarotpattyā''kārāntarotpattyā jāyate, tad‌dvitīyaṃ vikāryaṃ karmetyarthaḥ| prāpyakarmaṇo lakṣaṇamāha-kriyākṛteti| kriyā dhātvartho vyāpāraḥ, tatprayojyo viśeṣo darśanādanumānādvā yatra na pratīyate tatprāpyaṃ karmetyanvayaḥ| krameṇodāharaṇānyāha-ghaṭaṃ karotīti| ādyaṃ nirvartyam| asatkāryavādo naiyāyikānām| satkāryavādaḥ sāṃkhyānām| vaiyākaraṇānāṃ tu sāṃkhyasaṃmatasatkāryavāda evābhipretaḥ| kāṣṭhaṃ bhasmeti, suvarṇaṃ kuṇḍalamiti ca| atra kṛdhātorvikāranukūlavyāpārapūrvako'tpattyanukūlo vyāpāro'rthaḥ| ata eva kāṣṭhabhasmayoḥ, suvarṇakuṇḍalayoścetyevaṃ pratyekamubhayoḥ karmatvanirvāho bhavati| kāṣṭhaṃ vikurvan bhasmotpādayatīti pratīteḥ| ādye kāṣṭhaṃ bhasmetyatra prakṛteḥ kāṣṭhasyocchedarūpo vikāraḥ, antye suvarṇaṃ kuṇḍalamityatrā''kāraviśeṣātmako vikāra ityubhayatra vikāryakarmatā| tṛtīyaṃ-prāpyamityarthaḥ| atra ghaṭe pratyakṣādanumānādvā nakaścitkriyākṛto viśeṣaḥ pratīyate| nirvartye svarūpalābhātmako viśeṣaḥ, vikārye'pi kvacitsvarūpalābhaḥ, kvacid‌guṇāntarotpattyātmakaḥ| anumānādyathā-putraḥ sukhamanubhavati| atra hi mukhaprasādena sukhānumānaṃ bhavati| tṛṇaṃ spṛśatīti| asya grāmaṃ gacchannityādiḥ| etadudāsīnam| dveṣyaṃ tu viṣaṃ bhuṅkte iti| ubhayatrāpi `tathā yuktaṃ ca' iti karmasaṃjñā| gāṃ gogdhīti| goniṣṭhāpādānatvāvivakṣayā akathitaṃ ceti kramaprāptaṃ tṛtīyārthaṃ pratipādayati-tṛtīyāyā iti| kartṛtṛtīyāyā ityartha-| āśraya iti| āśrayamātramityarthaḥ| karaṇatṛtīyāyāstvaśrayavyāpāro vācyāviti vakṣyate| kartṛtṛtīyāyā āśrayārthakatve pramāṇamāha-tathā hītyādi `nāgṛhītaviśeṣaṇābuddhirviśeṣya upajāyate' iti nyāyena svatantrapadārthagata| svātantryasya puruḥsphūrtikatvena buddhisthatvādāha-svātantryaṃ ceti| svātantryasyetarānadhīnatvarūpasyā''śrayaṇe caitreṇa pācayati maitra ityādau prayojakādhīnatayā caitrasya kartṛtvānāpattirityāśaṅkya vivakṣitārthamāha-dhātvartheti| dhātūpāttetyarthaḥ| dhātvartheti| yatkiṃciddhātūpāttavyāpārāśrayasya kartṛtve kāṣṭhaiḥ sthālyāṃ pacatītyatra pacadhātusamabhivyāhāre'pi kāṣṭhādīnāmapi kartṛtvaṃ syāt| kāṣṭhāti jvalanti, sthālī prakāśate ityādau kartṛtvam| atra dvitīyo vyāpāro viśeṣyabhūtaḥ, sa ca caitraniṣṭhaḥ| prathamastu vyāpāro dvitīyavyāpārasya viśeṣaṇabhūtaḥ, sa eva cājāniṣṭha iti nājāyāḥ kartṛtvamiti bodhyam| na ca karmasaṃjñayā bādhānnājāyāḥ kartṛtāpattiriti vācyam| karturīpsitatamamiti karmasaṃjñāyāścaitrastaṇḍulaṃ pacatītyādau sāvakāśatayā'pavādatvābhāvātparatvābhāvācca, pratyuta paratvātkartṛsaṃjñaiva bādhikā syāt| svatantrapadasya niruktārthakatve kiṃ pramāṇamata āha-dhātunokteti| dhātunoktakriye kārake kartṛtā nityamiṣyata ityanvayaḥ| yanniṣṭhā vyāpārātmikā kriyā dhātunoktā tatkārakaṃ karteti vākyapadīyāddhātvarthavyāpārāśrayatvaṃ kartṛtvamityeva phalatīti bhāvaḥ| nanvetādṛśasvātantryāśrayaṇe sthālyāṃ pacatītyādāvapi sthālyādeḥ kartṛtvāpattiḥ, pacadhātūpāttadhāraṇādyātmakavyāpārāśrayatvād, viklittyanukūlataṇḍuladhāraṇādyātmakavyāpārasya pac‌dātvarthatvena vivakṣitatvādata āha-ata eva yadeti| ata eva-nirūktodāharaṇe sthālyādāvativyāptereva| na ca niravakāśābhiradhikaraṇādisaṃjñābhiḥ kartṛsaṃjñāyā bādha iti vācyam| kartṛsaṃjñāviṣaye'pyadhikaraṇasaṃjñā prāptā, tasyā api niravakāśatayā paryāyatāpattiḥ syādityāśayāt| yo yadā dhātūpāttavyāpārāśrayaḥ sa tadā karteti svīkārādevāgniḥ pacatītyādi saṃgacchate ityāha-sthālī pacatītyādi saṃgacchata ityantam| nanu yadā yanniṣṭho vyāpāro dhātunā'bhidhīyate tadā sa karteti svīkāre, vivakṣayaikasyāpi kartṛtvakarmatvayo saṃbandhasya saṃbhavāt `kartṛkarmavyapadeśācca'ityadhikaraṇe bhagavatā nyāsenaikasya kartṛtvakarmatvobhayasaṃbandho viruddhatvādayukta ityuktaṃ tadvirudhyetetyāśaṅkate-nanvevamityādin| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ-sa kratuṃ kurvītetyanenopāsanaṃ vidhāya tādṛśopāsanavidhiviṣayatayā `manomayaḥ prāṇaśarīraḥ' ityuktam| tatra manaḥprāṇādisaṃbandhasya jīvātmanyāñjasyena saṃbhavādihopāsyatvena manomayādiśabdavācyo jīvo nirdiṣṭa ityāśaṅkya, yadi manomayādiśabdapratipādyasya jīvatvaṃ syāttadā vākyaśeṣe-`etamitaḥ pretyābhisaṃbhavitāsmi' ityatra manomayādiśabdapratipādyasya jīvasyaikasya prāptikarmatvena prāptikartṛtvena ca kṛtaḥ kartṛkarmobhayavyapadeśo viruddhaḥ, itaḥ-asmāccharīrāt, pretya-niḥsṛtya, etaccharīraṃ parityajyetyarthaḥ, etaṃ-manomayādiśabdapratipādyaṃ prakṛtaṃ jīvātmānaṃ, abhisaṃbhavitāsmi-prāptāsmi, iti tadarthāditi| atra etamityanena prakṛtamanomayo jīvātmā prāptikarmatvena nirdiṣṭaḥ, abhisaṃbhavitāsmi-prāptāsmīti luḍutamena puruṣeṇa upāsakaḥ śārīraḥ prāptikartṛtvena vyapadiṣṭaḥ| samupasṛṣṭādādhṛṣīyād‌bhū prāptāvityātmanepadino vyatyayena luṭaḥ sthāne parasmaipadam| atha vā ṇic‌saṃniyogenaivā''tmanepadamityekīyapakṣe ṇijabhāve vyatyayantaraivotsargata eva parasmaipadamiti jñeyam| atra śāṃkarabhāṣyam-`na ca satyāṃ gatāvekasya kartṛkarmavyāpadeśo yuktaḥ' iti| atra satyāṃ gatāvityuktyā ātmānamātmanā hantītyādivadaupādhikabedakalpanā'gatikagatirūpā na yukteti sūcitam tatra taṇḍulasya taṇḍulaḥ pacyate svayameveti vākye kartatvamiti na yugapatsaṃjñādvayamityucyate cettannetyāha-yagādyāpattiriti| nanu luṭaḥ karmakartṛtve'pi tāsaḥ sārvadhātukatvābhāvānna yagāpattirata āha-yagādīti| ādipadācciṇvadbhāvātmanepadādergrahaṇam| tathā ca ciṇvadbhād‌vṛddhirātmanepadaṃ cā''padyeteti bhāvaḥ| śabdavirodhadvāreti| ekasya yugapatsaṃjñādvayakāryāsaṃbhavātmakavirodadvāretyarthaḥ| saḥ yugapadekasya saṃjñādvayāsaṃbhavarūpo virodha ityarthaḥ| bhedaheturiti| upāsyopāsakayoḥ paramātmajīvātmanorbhedaheturbhavatītyarthaḥ| tathā ca manomayādiśabdena paramātmaiva nirdiṣṭaḥ, na prayojakatvakarmatvavyadhikaraṇavyāpāravattvācchuddhaḥ kartā| dvitīyodāharaṇe karoterṇijantātkarmaṇi laṭ, yak| atra hariḥ prayojakakartā| tṛtīyodāharaṇe kṛṣṇasyāṇau karturṇyante gatibuddhītisūtreṇa karamatṛtīyāyā vyāpāraviśiṣṭaśrayo vācya ityāha-karaṇatṛtīyāyāstviti| nanvāśrayavyāpārayoḥ karṇatṛtīyāvācyatve na mānaṃ, sādhakatamasyaiva karaṇasaṃjñāvidhānādata āha-tathā hīti| sādhakatamaṃ hi karaṇaṃ, tatra tamabarthaḥ prakarṣaḥ| sa cāvyavadhānena phalajanako yo vyāpārastadvattā| tādṛśaprakarṣaśca kārakāntarāpekṣo grāhyaḥ, na tu karaṇāntarāpekṣaḥ| kārakasāmānyavācinaḥ sādhakaśabdādvihitena tad‌dṛḍhīkaraṇārthameva `śaktiviparyayātityaparo heturuktaḥ| tadarthastu yadi vijñānaśabdavācyā buddhireva kartrī syāttarhi `tadeṣāṃ prāṇānāṃ vijñānena' iti śrutau tṛtīyāvibhaktyā niruktamadhikaraṇaṃ trividhamityāha-etacceti| trividhamiti| triprakārakamityarthaḥ| sāmānyasya bhedako viśeṣaḥ prakāraḥ| tadeva viśadayati-aupaśleṣikamityādinā| upaśleṣaḥ saṃyogādisaṃbandhastatkṛtamadhikaraṇamaupaśleṣikamityarthaḥ| viṣayatāsaṃbandhakṛtaṃ vaiṣayikam| sakalāvayavyāptikṛtamabhivyāpakamityarthaḥ| krameṇodāharaṇānyāha-kaṭe śete, iti| devadatta iti śeṣaḥ| atra sākṣāddevadattātmakakartṛgatāṃ śayanakriyāṃ prati kaṭasya saṃyogasaṃbandhaṃ puraskṛtya devadattadvārā tadādhāratvādadhikaraṇatvam| idaṃ kartṛdvārakaupaśleṣikādhikaraṇasyodāharaṇam| paramparayā kaṭābhinnāśrayakaḥ śayanānukūlo vyāpāra iti bodhaḥ| evaṃ gurau vasatītyapi kartṛdvārakapraupaśleṣikādhikaraṇam| upa-samīpe śleṣaḥ saṃbandhastatkṛtamaupaśleṣikamiti vyutpatteḥ| paramparayā gurvābhinnāśrayako vāsānukūlo vyāpāra iti bodhaḥ| karmadvārakaupaśleṣikādhikaraṇodāharaṇaṃ sthālyāṃ pacatītyādi bodhyam| atra sākṣāttaṇḍulātmakakarmagatāṃ pākakriyāṃ prati sthālyāḥ saṃyogasaṃbandhaṃ puraskṛtya taṇḍuladvārā ādhāratvādadhikaraṇatvam| paramparayā sthālyabhinnāśrayikā yā viklittistadanukūlo vyāpāra ityevaṃ bodha ūhyaḥ| vaiṣayikādhikaraṇamudāharati-mokṣaicchā'stīti| aupaśleṣikābhivyāpakabhinnamadhikaraṇaṃ vaiṣayikam| atra sākṣātkartṛbhūtecchāgatāṃ sattākriyāṃ prati mokṣasya viṣayatāsaṃbandhapuraskāreṇa icchādhāratvādadhikaraṇatvam| paramparayā mokṣābhinnaviṣayakaḥ sattānukūlo vyāpāraḥ| mokṣaviṣayakecchāniṣṭhasatteti vā bodhaḥ| abhivyāpakamadhikaraṇamudāharati-tileṣu tailamiti| atra sākṣāttailarūpakartṛgatāṃ sattākriyāṃ prati kṛtsnavyaptiṃ puraskṛtya tailadvārā sattādhāratvāttilānāmadhikaraṇatvam| paramparayā tilābhinnāśrayakastailaniṣṭhasattānukūlo vyāpāra iti bodhaḥ|

pratyayaniyamaḥ| yata evakārastato'nyatra niyama ityabhiyuktokteḥ| prātipadikārthādanyatra prathamā na, karmārthādanyatra dvitīyā na, ityarthāntare prathamādvitīyayorvyāvṛttiparyavasānāt| niyamo vyāvṛttiḥ| karmaṇi dvitīyaiva, prātipadikārthe prathamaiveti arthaniyamaḥ| yata evakāra iti pūrvoktayukteḥ| karmaṇi anyā neti anyāsāṃ karmārthasaṃbandhasya nivṛttiparyavasānāt| tatra dvividhamayatyayaniyamamadhye yadi prātipadikāccetprathamā tarhi karmādiyogyatadrahita prātipadikārtha eva, na tu prātipadikārthatvasamānādhikaraṇakarmatvādyādhikye, ityevaṃ sāmānyāpekṣapratyayaniyama āśrīyate tadā avyayārthe liṅgasaṃkhyākārakatvānāmabhāvādavyayānāṃ karmādiyogyatvābhāvādavyayebhyo vibhaktirna prāpnotītyāha-niyama iti| arthaniyamaḥ prasiddha ityarthaḥ| tatra karmādyarthayogyaprātipadikāccetkarmaṇi vibhaktistadā dvitīyaṃva, karmādirahite tadyogyaprātipadikārthe prātipadikāccedvibhaktistadā prathamaiva, ityarthaniyamapakṣe karmaṇi dvitīyaiva, prātipadikārthe prathamaiveti niyamena hi yatra karmādyarthasaṃbhavastatraivānyāsāṃ nivṛttiḥ saṃpādyata iti pratyāsattyā karmādyarthayogyetyasya lābhaḥ| tathā ca karmādyarthaśūnyārthakāvyayādapi vibhaktiḥ sidhyati| karmādyarthayogyāccedvibhaktiḥ karaṇīyā tadā amukārthe prathamā, amukārthe dvitīyā kartavyeti niyamākāraḥ saṃpannaḥ| tataścāvyayānāṃ karmādyarthayogyatvābhāvena niyamākāre praveśābāvānniyamāpravṛttau sāmānyasūpeṇāvyayātsaptāpi vibhaktayo bhavantīti bhāvaḥ| evaṃ pratyayaniyamapakṣe'pyavyayādvibhaktisiddhyarthamāha-niyamaḥ prakṛteṣu ceti| prakṛteṣvartheṣu niyamaḥ, prakṛtārthāpekṣaḥ pratyayaniyaya iti yāvat| atra pakṣe karmādyarthayogyaprātipadikācced‌dvitīyā tadā karmaṇyeva, na kāraṇādau| karmādiyogye tadrahitaprātipadikārtha eva prathamā, na karmādau| saṃkhyāvadarthayogyaprātipadikādekatvādāvekavacanādi, na dvitvādāviti niyamākāraḥ| atrāpi pakṣe'vyayānāṃ niyamākāre praveśābhāvānniyamāpravṛttau pratipadikātsvādayo bhavantīti sāmānyasūtreṇāvyayebhyaḥ saptāpi vibhaktayaḥ sidhyanti| kevalaṃ sāmānyāpekṣapratyayaniyamapakṣe'vyayādvibhaktirna prāpnotīti avyayādāpsupa iti jñāpakātsā sādhyā| yadyapi supāṃ saṃkhyākarmobhayārthakatvena karmaṇyeva nānyatra, prātipadikārtha eva nānyatreti vaktumaśakyaṃ tathāpi karmaṇyeva, na tu tadabhāve, prātipadikārtha eva, na tu tadabhāve, ityākāro vaktuṃ śakyaḥ| tadabhāve, ityasya karmatvābhāvasamānādhikaraṇārthantare karaṇādau, prātipadikārthābhāvasamānādhikaraṇārthāntare kartrādāvityarthaḥ| na ca prātipadikārthābhāvasamānādhikaraṇārthāntarasyāprasiddhyā niyamavyāvartyāprasiddhiriti vācyam| prātipadikārtha eva prathamā, na tu nirarthake, iti tad‌vyāvṛttereva phalatvāt| na ca nirarthakāprasiddhaḥ| cavaituhītyādipādapūraṇārthakānāmanarthakanipātānāṃ ca sattvāt| teṣāṃ svārthadravya(pravṛttinimitta-tadaśraya)rūpaprātipadikārthābhāvavattvāt| na cānarthake vibhaktivyāvṛttiriṣṭaiveti vācyam| dhārmiko'si vai tvā sukhaṃ prāpnotītyatra `sapūrvāyāḥ prathamāyā vibhāṣā' iti tvādeśapravṛttereva phalatvādanarthake vibhaktivyāvṛtteraniṣṭatvāt| `avyayādāpsupa' iti jñāpakasattve tu anarthakanipātebhyaḥ prathamāyā aprāptirūpo doṣo na bhavati| evaṃ ca prakṛtaślokavārtikāttatsthabhāṣyātkamādervarmiṇo vācyatā, tathā karmādyarthaniyamaśca labhyate| tathā ca dvitīyāyā viṣayatvādyarthe lakṣaṇāṅgīkaraṇaṃ naiyāyikānāmuktabhāṣyavārtikaviruddhatvādayuktamityaśayenā''ha-ubhayathā'pi śiddhaniyamaviruddhamiti| tatra karmaṇyeva dvitīyetyādipratyayaniyamavirodho dvitīyāyā viṣayatā lakṣaṇāṅgīkāre spaṣṭa eva| viṣayatāyāḥ śeṣatvāccheṣe ṣaṣṭhyeveti niyamavirodho'rthaniyamapakṣe'pīti jñeyam| tathā ca niyamaviruddhalakṣaṇādikamasādhuvaprayojakamiti kṛtvā viṣayatāyāṃ niruktakarmatvātmakatvābhāvāttatra kāraṇaṃ na bhavatītyata āha-ata eveti| vibhaktipravṛttau lakṣaṇāyā nimittatvābhāvādevetyarthaḥ| vyavahāra iti| vibhaktau lakṣaṇā na kartavyeti prācīnanaiyāyikānāṃ vyavahāra ityarthaḥ| tādṛśavyavahāre'yamevābhisaṃdhiḥ-yat-lākṣaṇike'rthe śāstreṇa tattadarthe vihitā vibhaktirna pravartata iti| tathā ca naiyāyikanavyānāṃ na kevalaṃ vyākaraṇavirodho'pi ta svīyavṛdvaprācīnanaiyāyikasiddhāntavirodho'pīti navyanaiyāyikoktirupekṣyaiveti bhāvaḥ| digiti| divagarthastu-viṣayatvāpattyanukūlavyāpārasya ghaṭaṃ jānātītyādau jñādhātvarthatayā || atha nāmārthanirṇayaḥ ||
sakalanāmamūlabhūdhātvarthāṃstatprakṛtikatiṅarthāstatprasaṅgena subarthāṃśca nirūpyāvasarasaṃgatyā nāmārthānnirūpayatītyāha--nāmārthāniti| prātipadikārthānityarthaḥ| nāmārthāśca--ekaṃ dvikaṃ trikamiti| ekādi śabdānāṃ sādhāraṇatayā'nabhamatārthaparatvaśaṅakānivṛttaye prakṛte vivakṣitānarthānāha-ekaṃ jātirityādinā| jātipadenātra tattatpadārthagatāsādhāraṇo dharmo vivakṣataḥ, na tu nityatve sati ekatve ca satyanekasamavetatvarūpā jātiḥ asādhāraṇatvaṃ ca tatpadārthetarāvṛttitve sati tatpadārthavṛttitvam| tenā''kāśatvābhāvatvādīnāmanekasamavetatvarūpajātitvābhāve'pi nāvyāptiḥ| tattatpadārthagatāsādhāraṇadharmasyaiva śāstre svārthaśabdena vyavahāraḥ| ayameva ca pravṛttinimittamityucyate| jāteḥ śabdaśakyatve pramāṇaṃ tu `savarṇe'ṇ‌grahaṇamaparibhāṣyamākṛtigrahaṇātsiddham' iti jātyākhyāyāmiti sūtrasthaṃ vārtikaṃ, `ākṛtiṃ vājapyāyanaḥ' iti sarūpasūtrasthaṃ bhāṣyaṃ ca bodyam| ayaṃ ca jātiśaktivādo mīmāṃsakābhimametaḥ te hi-śabdānāṃ jātau śaktirlāghavāt| jāterekatvenaikaviṣayiṇyāḥ śakterapyekatvena lāghavāditi bhāvaḥ| nanu śaktigrāhakaśiromaṇinā vyavahāreṇa vyaktāvevaśabdānāṃ śaktyavadhāraṇātkathaṃ jātau śaktisiddhiriti śaṅkāyāṃ--vyaktīnāmānantyena tatra śaktau gauravāt| bhūtabhaviṣyadvartamānānāṃ govyaktīnāmanantatvādekadoṣasthityasaṃbhavena tāvatīṣu śaktigrahāsaṃbhavāttattadāśrayabhedena nānāśaktikalpane gauravāt| nanu śaktigauravaparihārāyaikasyāmeva vyaktau śaktiḥ kalpyatāmiti cenna|| vyaktyantare śaktyabhāvena tad‌bodho na syāt| ato jātāveva śaktirnirdhāryate| nanvevaṃ gāmānaya vrīhīnavahantītyādau kathamanvayaḥ? jātāvācanayanāvahananayorasaṃbhavāditi cet-tatra svāśrayalakṣakatvenānvayanirvāhaḥ| evaṃ ca sarvatra lakṣaṇayaiva svāśrayatvasaṃbamdhena vyaktibhānasaṃbhave tatra śaktikalpanaṃ niṣphalameveti prāhuḥ| etanmatānusāreṇa jāteḥ śaktyatve yuktiṃ pradarśayati-lāghaveneti| jāterekatvenakaviṣayakaśakterapyekatvasaṃbhavena lāghavāttasyā eva vācyatvasyocitatvādityarthaḥ| gauravāditi| śaktigrāhakeṣu mukhyasya nayanānayanādivyavahārasya vyaktāvevā''ñjasyena saṃbhavād vyaktāveva śabdaśakterucitatve'pi vyaktīnāmanantatvātsarvāsāmekadoṣasthityasaṃbhavena sakalavyaktiṣu śaktigrahopadeśāsaṃbhavādekasyāṃ vyaktau śaktigrahe, śaktyaviṣayasya vyaktyantarasya śābdabodhe bhānānāpattyā prativyakti śaktikalpane śaktīnāmapyanantatvena gauravānna vyaktau śabdaśaktiḥ kalpayituṃ yujyata iti bhāvaḥ| nanu jātiśaktivāde jātervācyatvena tādṛśajātigatagotvatvādidharme śakyatāvacchedakatvaṃ svīkāryaṃ, tataśca tasya(gotvatvarūpaśakyatāvacchedakasya)samavāyasaṃbandhena gavetarāvṛttitve sati sakalagovṛttitvarūpasya śakyatvamāvaśyakaṃ, śakyatāvacchedakatvasya śakyaikadeśe prakāratvarūpatvāditi viparītaṃ gauravamiti cenna| alakṣyasyāpi lakṣyātāvacchedakatvavadaśakyasyāpi śakyatāvacchedakatvasaṃbhavācchakyatāvacchedakasya śakyatvāvasyakatve mānābhāvāt| apare tu yathā vyaktiśaktimate gotvādyaṃśe śaktiḥ, śakyatāvacchedakatā vā niravacchinna(viśeṣaṇībhūtadharmāntarāghaṭitā) tathā jātiśaktimate'pi sā śaktirniravacchinnā, nāmaviśeṣaṇībhūtadharmāntarāghaṭiteti prāhuḥ| yathā'yaṃ ghaṭa ityādau ghaṭajñānasya ghaṭatvaprakārakatvena gotvatvarūpadharmāntarāghaṭitatvena niravacchinnatvānna gauravamiti bhāvaḥ| nanu vyaktīnāmānantye'pi pratyekaṃ vyakterekatvādekaiva śaktiḥ| tathā ca jātiśaktivyaktiśaktipakṣayoraviśeṣājjātiśaktivāda eva kathaṃ pakṣapāta iti cet| ekavyaktiśaktipakṣe sakalavyaktīnāṃ tādṛśaśaktau saṃgraho na bhavatīti| nanu jātiśaktipakṣe'pi śaktyā jāterūpasthitāvapi vyaktau śaktyabhāvenaikasyā api nivṛttirityuktirayukteti ceducyate| arthe kāryasyāsaṃbhavādārtho viśeṣaṇaṃ, śabde kāryasya saṃbhavācchabdo viśeṣyamityarthādarthavati śabde kāryaṃ karaṇīyamityarthaḥ| iyameva hyarthasya nivṛttirnāma yattasya viśeṣyatāparityāga iti| naca jñāne sarvatra śabdabhāne sarvaparyāyāṇāṃ bhānāpattirvinigamanāvirahāditi vācyam| athaṃbodhānukūlatvena prathamapratītatvarūpakāraṇatvāduccaritasyaiva śabdasya bhānenādoṣāt| tathā ca-tasmādarthanivṛttirityasya-arthavācakaśabdāntaranivṛttirityartha ukta udyota iti bodhyam| loke tu yatra śabde itarapadārthānvayarūpakāryāsaṃbhavastatra śabdasya viśeṣaṇatā'rthasya ca viśeṣyateti śabdopasthite'rthe kāryaṃ kartavyam| yathā nīlo bhramaraḥ, ityukte nahi nīlimā śabde'nveti, bhramaraśabde nīlimno'saṃbhavāt| kiṃtu bhramaraśabdavācye ṣaṭ‌pade kīṭe'nveti, tatraiva tatsaṃbhavāt| yatra cārthe kāryāsaṃbhavastatrārthasya viśeṣaṇatā, śabdasya ca viśeṣyateti tadarthavācake śabde kāryaṃ karaṇīyam| yathā viṣṇumuccārayetyatra viṣṇupadārthe caturbhuje uccāraṇakriyānvayāsaṃbhavāttadarthavācake viṣṇuśabde samabhivyāhṛtakriyānvaya iti bodhyam| nanu sāmānyataḥ padajanyopasthitiviṣayasya śābdabodhe bhānāṅgīkāre samavāyasaṃbandhena ghaṭādiśabdajanyopasthitiviṣayasyā''kāśasya ghaṭo'stītyādivākyajanyaśābdabodhaviṣayatvāpattirata āha--atiprasaṅgeti| vāraṇāyeti| niruktāpattirūpātiprasaṅganirasanāyetyarthaḥ| padopasthitireveti| padārthopasthitirevetyarthaḥ| anukāryaśabdaprasaṅgāttu padopasthitirityuktam| sā padārthopasthitiśca vṛttijanyeti viśeṣaṇād‌vṛttijñānajanyā'pekṣitetyarthaḥ| tathā cā''kāśasya ghaṭapadatsamavāyasaṃbandhonopasthitāvapi vṛttyā ghaṭapadādupasthityabhāvena ghaṭo'stītyādivākyajanyabodhe na tasya bhānamityarthaḥ| evaṃ gavityayamāhetyādāvabhedapakṣe'nukāryābhinnānukaraṇasya padādupasthitāvapi vṛttyā padādupasthityabhāvenānukāryasya śābdabodhaviṣayatvaṃ na saṃbhavatīti tātparyam| āśrayatayā vṛttimattvasyeti| anukāryānukaraṇayaurabhedapakṣe'nukāryasya yatkiṃcidarthavācakatvād‌vācakatārūpā vṛttiranukārye'sti| sā ca vṛttirarthanirūpitatvādāśrayatāsaṃbandheneti vṛttimattvasyānukārye sattvānnānukāryasya śābdabodhaviṣayatvānupapattiḥ| āśrayatāsaṃbandhena vṛttimato'rthasya śābde bhānāṅgīkārāditi bhāvaḥ| nanvāśrayatāsaṃbandhena vṛttimattvasyaiva śābdabodhaviṣayatvaniyāmakatve nirūpakatāsaṃsargeṇa vṛttimato'rthasya śābdayodhe bhānaṃ na syādata āha-nirūpakatāśrayatānyatareti| nirūpakatāsaṃbandhenā''śrayatāsaṃbandhena vā vṛttimato'rthasya śābde bhānaṃ svīkriyate| na tabhayorekenaiva saṃbandhena vṛttimata ityāgraha iti bhāvaḥ| śaktirūpāyā vṛtternirūpako'rthaḥ, tatra nirūpakatā, āśrayastu śabdaḥ, tatra āśrayatā| tathā ca nirūpakatāsaṃbandhena śaktirūpavṛttimān arthaḥ| āśrayatāsaṃbandhena ca tādṛśavṛttimāñ śabdaḥ| satyevaṃ ghaṭamānayetyādau vākyārthabodhe nirūpakatayā vṛttimataḥ kambugrīvādiviśiṣṭārthasyaiva bhānaṃ pāmarajanairanubhūyate, tathā'pi na so'sti pratyayo loke, viṣayatvamanādṛtyeti cābhiyuktatamavākyapadīyakṛddharyanubhavabalādāśrayatayā vṛttimataḥ śabdasyāpi bodhe bhānaṃ svīkriyata ityāśayenoktamanyatarasaṃbandheneti| ata eva gāmānayetyatra gotvastrītvaikatvaviśiṣṭa-gośabdavācyagokarmakamānayanamiti sarvatraivopasthāpakaśabdaghaṭitaṃ śābdabodhavarmanaṃ saṃgacchate| evaṃ cānukaraṇasthale bhedābhedobhayapakṣe'nukāryasya śabde bhānasattve'pi bhedāpakṣe'nukaraṇasyānukārye śaktiḥ| sā ca śaktiranukārye nirūpakatāsaṃbandhenānukaraṇe tvāśrayatāsaṃbandhena vartata iti kṛtvā śaktirūpavṛttinirūpakār‌thapratipādakatvādanukakaraṇasya prātipadikasaṃjñā, nirūpakatāsaṃbandhena vṛttimattvādanukāryasya śabdasya śābdabodhe bhānaṃ ca sidhyati| arthavatsūtrasya vṛttinirūpakārthapratipādakaśabdasya prātipadikasaṃjñā bhavatītyarthaḥ| vṛttyā'rthapratipādakasya saṃjñeti yāvat| ata evānukāryānukaraṇayorabhedapakṣe bhedamūlikāyā vācyavācakabhāvāparaparyāyakavṛtterasaṃbhavenānukāryāṃnukaraṇayorvṛttimattvasya vaktumaśakyatvādanukaraṇasya vṛttyā'rthapratipādakatvarūpārthavattvābhāvena prātipadikasaṃjñā na bhavati, tataśca subutpattyabhāvātpadasaṃjñāyā abhāvena gavityayamāhetyatrāpadāntatvādvakārasya lopaḥ śākalyasyeti lopo na| prātipadikasaṃjñāyā abhāvādeva ca bhuvo vugityatreva bhū sattāyāmityatra vibhaktirna kṛtā| nanvevamabhedapakṣe'nukāryānukaraṇayorvṛttimattvābhāve satyanukāryasya śābde bhānaṃ na syāt, śābde śabdabhāne vṛttimattvasya niyāmakatvāditi ceducyate-abhedapakṣe'nukāryasya kiṃcidarthavācakatvācchabdatadarthayorvṛttirasti| tatrārtho vṛtternirūpakaḥ, anukāryaśabdastvāśrayaḥ| tathā ca nirūpakatāsaṃbandhenārtho vṛttimān, anukāryaśabdastvāśrayatāsaṃbandhena vṛttimān| tatrānukāryeṇābhedamāpannasyānukaraṇasyāpyāśrayatāsaṃbandhena vṛttimattvādanukāryasya śābde bhānaṃ bhavati| anukaraṇasya prātipadisaṃjñā tu na bhavati| vṛttyā'rthapratipādakatvarūpārthavattvābhāvāt| na cānukāryasya vṛttyā'rthapratipādakatvarūpārthavattvasattvāttadabhedamāpannasyānukaraṇasyāpi tādṛśārthavattvasya durvāratayā prātipadikasaṃjñā syāditi vācyam| abhedapakṣe'nukāryasya kiṃ cidarthavācakatve'pyanukaraṇasya tadarthavācakatvābhāvāt, anukaraṇādanukāryārthāpratiteranubhavasiddhatvāditi bhāvaḥ| abhedapakṣe'anukāryasya kiṃcidarthasattve mānaṃ tu `bhūsattāyām' ityādyarthanirdeśa eva| nahi tatra sattādyartho'nukaraṇasyetyevaṃ ko'pyavagacchati? kiṃ tvanukāryasya bhūdhātoreveti sarvānubhavaḥ| bhedapakṣe tvanukaraṇānna kasyacidapyarthasya pratītirbhavati kiṃ tvanukaraṇācchaktirūpavṛttyā'nukāryaśabdarūpasyārthasya pratītirjāyate| tatra nirūpakatāsaṃbandhena vṛttimattvādanukāryasya śābde bhānaṃ, anukaraṇasya tu anukāryaśabdarūpatādṛśavṛttimadarthapratipādakatvātprātipadikasaṃjñā ca sidhyatīti bodhyam| nanvanukaraṇasya kathaṃvṛttyāśrayatā? anukāryanirūpitā vṛttyāśrayatā'nukaraṇasyeti cet-nirūpyanirūpakabhāvasya bhedamūlakatvenānukāryānukaraṇayorabhede tadasaṃbhavādanukaraṇasyānukāryanirūpitavṛttyāśrayatā vaktumaśakyā| na cābhedapakṣe'nukāryasya kiṃcidarthavācakatvād‌govyaktyāditattadarthanirūpitavṛttyāśrayatā'nukārye yā'sti saiva vṛttyāśrayatā tadabhedapanne'nukaraṇe'pyastīti vācyam| anukaraṇādanukāryārthagovyaktyādipratīteḥ kathamapyanubhavābhāvāttādṛśārthanirūpitavṛttyāśrayatāyā apyanukāryābhedamāpanne'pyanukaraṇe vaktumaśaktyatvādata āha-saṃbandhasyobhayeti| saṃbandhasya saṃbandhinau dvau, tau ca saṃbandhanirūpakau, saṃbandhaśca saṃbandhidvayanirūpyaḥ, ataḥ saṃbandhibhyāṃ bhinno dviṣṭhaśca saṃbandha ityucyate| ghaṭaśabdatadarthayoryaḥ saṃbandhastasya nirūpakau saṃbandhinau ghaṭaśabdastadarthaśceti dvau| saṃbandhasya sarvatrobhayanirūpyatvameva loke prasiddhaṃ, na kvāpyekanirūpyatvaṃ dṛśyate| śabdārthayostādṛśasaṃbandhaśca bodhyabodhakabāvarūpaḥ| etenāsau saṃbandha eva śaktiriti sūcitam| tatra bodhakatārūpā śaktiḥ śabdaniṣṭhā, bodyatārūpā tu śabdārthaniṣṭhā| tathā ca śabdatadarthau dvāvapi vṛttyāśrayau| evaṃ ca bodhyatārūpavṛttyāśrayatvādyathā śabdārthasya śābde bhānaṃ jāyate tadvad‌bodhakatārūpavṛttyāśrayatvācchabdasyāpi sābdabodhe bhānaṃ saṃbhavet| anayā rītyā sarvatraiva śābde śavdabhānamupapādanīyam| anukaraṇasthale'bedapakṣe'nukāryasya govyaktyāditattadarthanirūpitavṛttyāśrayatvāttadabhedamāpannasyānukakaraṇasyāpi tādṛśavṛttyāśrayatvaṃ, śābde jāyamānānukāryarūpaśabdabhānānubhavabalādevāṅgīkāryam| tathā cānukaraṇasyāpi vṛttyāśrayatvād vṛttijanyapadopasthiteḥ satvānnānukāryasya śābde bhānānupapattiriti bhāvaḥ| bhedapakṣe tu govyaktyāditattadarthanirūpitavṛttyāśrayatvamanukārya eva nānukaraṇa ityanukaraṇenānukāryopasthityarthe tatra śaktyantarakalpanamāvaśyakamiti bhāvaḥ| evaṃ ca śabdasya svasvarūpopasthāpakatvācchabde upasthāpyatvopasthāpakatvayoḥ samāveśaḥ sidhyati| nanu niruktarītyā'nukaraṇasya vṛttyāśrayatvaṃ vaktumaśakyam| anukaraṇād govyaktyāditattadarthapratītarenanubhavāt| tathā ca vyaktyādyarthaniṣṭhabodhyatānirūpitabodakatārūpaśaktyāśrayatvābhāvenānukaraṇasya vṛttyāśrayatvamasaṃbhavi| iti ceducyate-bodhakatāśaktiḥ śabde prasiddhā, bodyatāśaktistu govyaktyādyarthe| tatrānukaraṇasya śabdatvāttasminbodhakatāśaktirastyeva| tathā cānukaraṇaśabdaniṣṭabodhakatānirūpitabodhyatāyā arthatvena prasiddhe govyaktyādau bādhādanukaraṇaśabda eva sā kalpyate| svaniṣṭhabodhakatānirūpitabodyatārūpasaṃbandhāśrayatā svasminneveti yāvat| tataścānukaraṇasyāpi vṛttyāśrayatvāda padajanyapadārthopasthiteḥ sattvānna śābde śabdabhānānupapattirityāhuranye| evaṃ ca bodhyatābodhakatayorekatra samavasthitiḥ kalpyata iti bhāvaḥ| nedaṃ bodhaayatābodhakatayorekāśrayatvaṃ kevalaṃ svakapolakalpitaṃ, kiṃtu śāstrakṛtsaṃmatamapīti haryuktipramāṇena spaṣṭayati-uktaṃ ceti| grāhyatvaṃ-bodhyatvaṃ grāhakatvaṃ-bodhakatvam| tejasaḥ-dīpādeḥ| ete-grāhyatvagrāhakatvarūpe dve śaktī ityarthaḥ| sarvaśabdānāṃ pūrvokte dve śaktī staḥ| paraṃ tu pṛthagavasthite-pārthakyena samavasthite iti bhāvaḥ| etenaitayoḥ śaktyorasamaniyatatvaṃ pradarśitaṃ bhavati| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ--ghaṭādidravyasya cākṣuṣapratyakṣe dīpādyālokasaṃyogo heturiti nirvivādam| anyathā'ndhakāre'pi ghaṭādicākṣuṣapratyakṣasyāpyāpatteḥ| tathā ca ghaṭadīpādyālokasaṃyoga eva ghaṭasyeva svasyāpi pratyakṣaṃ janayati| viṣayasaṃnidhāne sati dīpāditejasi śaktidvayasya loke pratyakṣasiddhatvāt| evamarthagocaraśabdaniṣṭhaśaktisahakṛta eva śabdo'rthasya svasvarūpasya ca pratyakṣaṃ janayati| yathā ca viṣayāsaṃnidhāne tu sa evā''lokasaṃyogaḥ kevalaṃ svasyaiva pratyakṣaṃ janayati, na ghaṭādeḥ| tathā'rthe tātparyābhāve śabde ca tātparye sati sa eva śabdaḥ svaniṣṭhatādṛśavṛttyaiva svasyaiva pratyakṣaṃ janayatīti| svaṃ rūpamiti sūtrabhāṣyādapi etadeva labhyata iti tadarthakaṃ pramāṇabhūtaṃ ślokāntaramudāharati-viṣayatvamanādṛtyeti| śabdaiḥ svātmano jñānaviṣayatvamanādṛtyāsaṃprāpya nārtho bodhyate, kiṃ tvātmano jñānaviṣayatvaṃ saṃpādyaiva śabdairartho bodhyate| jñātasyaiva śabdasyārthabodhajanakatvāditi bhāvaḥ| ghaṭādiviṣayasaṃnidhāne tejoniṣṭhagrāhakatānirūpitagrāhyatā ghaṭādau pratyakṣasiddhā, ghaṭādiviṣayāsaṃnidhāne tu tejoniṣṭhagrāhakatānirūpitagrāhyatāyā viṣayāsaṃnidhānena ghaṭādau bādhasattvāttataḥ parāvṛttā pratyāghātanyāyena svasminneva yadā paryavasyati tadā svaniṣṭhagrāhakatānirūpitagrāhyatāyā āśrayaḥ sva eveti kevalaṃ tejasa eva pratyakṣaṃ bhavati, yathaitattadvanukaraṇasthale'bhedapakṣe'nukaraṇaśabdaniṣṭhabodakatānirūpitabodhyatāyā govytyādyarthe tātparyābhāvena bādhāttataḥ parāvṛttā satī anukaraṇaśabda eva pratyāgateti kevalaṃ śabdasvarūpasyaiva pratyakṣaṃ bhavati| evaṃ ca śabdaniṣṭhabodhakatānirūpitabodhyatāyāḥ śabdāśrayakatvaṃ śāstrakṛtsaṃmatamiti tātparyam|| 26 ||
prasaṅgāditi| śabdasya nāmārthatvena vicāraprasaṅgādityarthaḥ| abhede sādhakamiti| anukāryānukaraṇayorabhedopapādakamityarthaḥ| āhṛ-brūte-ata eva gavityāhoti| ata evetyasya vyākhyānaṃ-gavityāhetyādi| na bhidyanta iti| anukāryādbhinnatvena na vivakṣyanta ityarthaḥ| evaṃ cānukaraṇaśabdānāmarthavattvābhāve'nukāryeṇa saha teṣābhabhedavivakṣaiva heturiti bhāvaḥ| ityādyapravṛttāviti| vṛttyā'rthabodhajanakatvarūpārthavattvābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ| sādhutvamityupapadyata iti| vakṣyamāṇarītyā'sādhutvābhāve śiṣṭaprayuktatvādinā sādhutvamabādhitamiti bhāvaḥ| nanvabhedābhāve'pi tasya sādhutvaṃ kuto netyāśaṅkāyāmāha-anyatheti| bhedasyaivāṅgīkāra ityarthaḥ| pratyayaḥ, paraśceti| pratyayavidhau pañcamīnirdeśātṣaṣṭhyaṃśavikalāyāḥ `tasmādityuttarasya' iti paribhāṣāyāḥ pravṛtyaiva pratyayasya prakṛtyavadhikaparatvasya lābhe siddhe paraśceti sūtraṃ niyamārthaṃ-pratyayaparikaiva prakṛtiḥ prayoktavyeti, etadāśayenaiva paṭhyate-na kevalā prakṛtiḥ prayoktavyā, nāpi kevalaḥ pratyayaḥ prayoktavya iti| tathā ca niyamaśāstrāṇāṃ niṣedhamukhena pravṛttiriti pakṣe niṣedhollaṅghanaṃ spaṣṭameva| vidhimukhena pravṛttiriti bhāṣyasiddhānte tu ārthikaniṣedhollaṅghanamiti bodhyam| abhedapakṣe, uktarītyā prātipadikatvābhāvena pratyayavidhāvuddeśyatāvacchedakākrāntatvarūpaprakṛtitvābhāvena na kevaleti niṣedhasya pratyayavidhānāvadhitvayogye pravṛttyā, padatvayogya eva padatvarahite `apadaṃ na prayuñjīta' iti niṣedhapravṛttyā ca niṣedhadvayānavatāra iti bhāvaḥ| abhedapakṣe vṛttyā'rthabodhajanakatve'pi śaktinirūpakārthabodhajanakatvābhāvānna prātipadikatvamiti bodhyam|| 27 ||
iti vaiyākaraṇabhūṣaṇasāravyākhyāyāṃ śāṃkaryāṃ nāmārthanirṇayanirūpaṇaṇ|
raṅgabhaṭṭatanūjena śaṃkareṇa vinirmite|
sārīye'bhūdvivaraṇe nāmārthānāṃ nirūpaṇam|| 4 ||

|| atha samāsaśaktinirṇayaḥ ||
samāsāniti| samāsatvaṃ ca-vyākaraṇaśāstrapraṇetṛpāṇinyādimunikṛtasaṃketasaṃbandhena samāsapadavattvam| yasminsamudāye padadvayaṃ parasparaṃ samasyate sa samudāyaḥ samāsa iti yāvat| samāsaśabde halaścetyadhikaraṇe ghañ| vibhajate-vipūrvakabhajadhātvartho'vāntaradharmaṃpuraskāreṇa kathanam| tathā ca samāsatvāvāntaradharmapuraskāreṇa kathayati-supāṃ supā, tiṅā, nāmneti| padadvayamīti| apinā padatrayādisaṃgrahaḥ| tena dvyahnajātaḥ, citrājaradguḥ| hotṛpotṛneṣṭodgatāraḥ, ityādisamāsānāṃ nāsaṃgrahaḥ| tathā cānekasubanthaghaṭitatvaṃ samāsatvāvāntaradharmaḥ| anekasubantaghaṭitasamāsodāharaṇamāha-rājapuruṣa ityāditi| supāṃ tiṅeti| etadvivaraṇaṃ pūrvapadaṃ subantamityādi| tathā ca subantatiṅantātmakapūrvottarapadaghaṭitatvamavāntaradharmaḥ| evaṃ rotyā'gre'pyavāntaradharmaḥ svayamūhyaḥ| udāharaṇaṃ-paryabhūṣat, anuvyacaladiti| gatimatodāttavateti| upalakṣaṇamidaṃ, saheti yogavibhāgasyāpi| devo devān kratunā paryabhūṣaditi ṛksaṃhitāyām| anvityasya vyacaladityanena, vītyasya cācaladityanena yugapatsamāsaḥ| ubhayatrāpi saheti yogavibhāgena samāse sati `na samāse' iti śākalaniṣedhādyaṇādeśaḥ samāsodāttatvaṃ ca sidhyati| anye tu tatra subityekatvasya vivakṣitatvādveḥ pūrvaṃ samāsaḥ paścādanoḥ| tatra śākalapratiṣedhādyaṇādeśe'pyantodāttatvaṃ na bhavati, tiṅṅatiṅa iti nighātāt| anorgatirgatāviti nighātaḥ| veryaṇādeśa || atha nipātārthanirṇayaḥ ||
nipātaviśeṣanañarthanirūpaṇaprasaṅgena taditarasakalanipātānāmarthaṃ nirūpayan‌prādayo dyotakāścādayo vācakā iti naiyāyikamatamayuktamiti sūcayan bhūmakāmāracayati-prādayo dyotakā ityādi| atha nipātānāṃ vācakatvaṃ samarthayitumāha-nanviti| anvayavyatirekābhyāmiti| candra iva mukhamityādau nipātasaṃjñakevādipadasattve sādṛśyādyarthapratīterivādyasattve sādṛśyādyartāpratīteśca nipātānāṃ ghaṭādipadavadvācakatvameva yujyata ityarthaḥ| nanu nipātānāṃ vācakatve tatra śaktikalpanāprayuktaṃ gauravaṃ syādata āha-bodhakateti| bodhakatārūpā yā śaktiḥ, tasyā bādhābhāvādityarthaḥ| bodhakatetyupādānādīśvarecchādirūpāyāḥ śakterbādhaḥ sūcitaḥ| tathā ca tadarthabodhakatvameva tadvācakatvamiti ghaṭādipadānāmiva nipātānāṃ vācakatvamevetyarthaḥ| nanu ivādinipātasamabhivyāhāre samabhivyāhṛtapadasyevādidyotyārthaviśiṣṭasvārathopasthāpakatvamasamabhivyāhāre tu kevalasvārthopasthāpakatvaṃ yad‌ dṛśyate tadanvayavyatirekasiddham| tathā hi candra iva mukhamityatravaśabdasattave vācakatvamiti pakṣāntaramāha-nipātānāṃ vācakatvamiti| anvayavyatirekayoḥ-tayoḥ satoḥ| ayaṃ bhāvaḥ-tiṅādiprayogasattve kartṛkarmādyarthapratitiḥ, tiṅādiprayogābhāve kartrādyarthapratītyabhāva ityanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ yadi kartrādyarthavācakatvaṃ niścīyate tiṅādeḥ, tarhyanvayavyatirekābhyāṃ tiṅādīnāṃ vācakatvavannipātānāmapi tattadarthavācakatvamastviti| mīmāṃsakāstu vācakā evaite nipātāḥ, atha vidheye bhedakaṃ tantramitikārikāmavatārayituṃ bhūmikāmāracayati-nanvityādi| vidheyaviśeṣaṇeti| vidheyaviśeṣaṇasyaikatvasyetyarthaḥ| tādṛśaikatvasya vivakṣāvaśyakatvameva darśayitumāha-anyatheti| tasmātsaṃbhavati sāmānādhikaraṇye vaiyadhikaraṇyasyānyāyyatvāditi lāghavamūlakā hi saḥ| satyam| mṛtyoḥ sa mṛtyumāpnoti yaiha nāneva paśyatīti bhedanindāpūrvakābhedapratipādakaśrutirmānm| na ca tatrāpi tūpalakṣaṇaṇ| asamin pakṣe na ko'pi doṣaḥ| yadvā yathā nānārthasthale saṃyogādinā'bhidāniyamanaṃ tathā bhedānvayānuroghādviśeṣya evābhidhāniyamanam| astu vā lakṣaṇā sā ca jahallakṣaṇā tayā ca naukā bhavantīti vākye sakhaṇḍākhaṇḍatve pūrvavadeva bodhye| atra tārkikāḥ-gṛh‌ṇāti vācakaḥ saṃkhyāṃ prakṛtervikṛternahīti vacanāt prakṛtyarthavṛkṣagatamekavacanameva bhūdhātūttaraṃ bhavatītyāhuḥ| tadayuktam| gṛh‌ṇātītyasya cvayamtaviṣayatvāt yathā saṃghībhavanti brāhmaṇāḥ tvad‌bhavāmhayaṃ madbhavasi tvamityādau vacanapuruṣayoḥ prakṛtigatayoreva darśanāt| nanu saṃkoce kiṃ mānam| suvarmapiṇḍaḥ khadirāṅgārasadṛśe kuṇḍale bhavata iti mahābhāṣyaprayoga eva| uddeśyavidheyabhāvasthalai tu uddeśyagatā saṃkhyā''khyātapratyaye śāstrāṇi cetprāmāṇaṃ syuḥ, ityādiṣu| punarapi vākyaṃ dvidhā| kāvyātmakamakāvyātvakaṃ ca| dvitīyaṃ tūktam| ādyaṃ tu tadadoṣau śabdārtho saguṇāvanalaṃkṛtī punaḥ kvāpi ityanena lakṣitam| atra yāvaddoṣābhāvo vaktumaśakyaḥ| asaṃbhavāt| yatkiṃciddoṣābhāve
